name: Yonrohs
description:
Rank: Father of the Gods

Yonrohs was unlike his counterparts Cronus & Odin as he didn't want to be king but the opposite; he wanted to be a child that could play forever in his grandfather's palace as he called it. Yonrohs was tall, muscular, and intelligent as most deities were, very strong, and very adventurous. While with his siblings he served as their servant and assistant. Although he was the most powerful in strength he was the weakest in power. Like many Elitsyian Gods he had mystical powers that could grant him anything he wished but youth wasn't one of them. As for those times immortality wasn't possible and anything that would die would just return moments later as them wasn't yet an afterlife nor any beginnings. So in the meantime while the idea wonders the universe, Yonrohs played in a garden known simply as Gardenia a place where him and his siblings sat and balanced the universe in the day and where he played a night. Gardenia was beautiful and every galaxy, moon, sun, and planet could be seen just by standing on its lowest point. But like most children, Yonrohs grew bored of his siblings not playing with him so he created a playmate out of stardust or as called by the Elitsyians as a feather from a Domaedian.

name: Elshack
description:
Rank: Creator of Light, Chaos, Creation, Balance, and Cosmic Energy

When there was complete darkness and only Anka, Elshack was the first light to appear. Spreading across the vast void that Anka occupied. Elshack would then give birth to the Misokune Egg which birthed Chaos, Creation, Balance, and Cosmic Energy. While these forces grew, Elshack watched over them, providing guidance albeit without their knowledge. Elshack taught them the first words, the meaning and purpose of thought, how to utilize their powers, and how to turn the light that it created to their advantage. Only Balance or The Neither had the ability to see Elshack and to hear and know of Anka’s presence.

name: Anka
description:
Rank: Creator of Dark Matter and the First One

Anka is a powerful being that was born from nothing and appear as a large dark void that makes up the dark matter throughout all things. When it started to ponder its own existence and why it was alone in silence and in darkness, Elshack was born as the first spark of light. Although Anka is all knowing and powerful, only Elshack and The Neither knows of its existence. It can appear in all places at once and from its body grew Eden the first Realm.

name: Belckus
description:
Rank: King of Hell

Serving as the youngest of the Ho’zares, Belckus was intelligent, a giant, powerful, and the strongest of his brethren. One day as Creation was creating the Primordial Ones and thus the birth of Heaven, Belckus grew highly upset that his parent was creating what appeared as more loving and beautiful creatures. One day to showcase his powers, Belckus created the Belki from his sperm and granted them the power to rival the Primordial Ones. Believing destroying the Primordial Ones would get the love and respect he demanded. Belckus went to war against the Primordial Ones and Heaven. Angered by these actions, Creation banished Belckus and the Belki to the lowest part of all things alongside Chaos and the Leviathans. It is believed that at the end of all time, Belckus would rise alongside Chaos and devour all creation.

name: The Ultimate Power
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of GOD
Note: GOD, Creation, Allah, etc

The Ultimate Power in Elitsyian Mythology is a powerful being that is nor angel, demon, god, goddesses, or a living and or dead entity. Born at the same time as Chaos and Balance. The Ultimate Power desired creation amid the darkness surrounding them. So with a plan, they created Heaven at the 12th pillar in Eden. Filled with beautiful large towers, cities of angels, and its Ho’zares sat at the foot of their thrown. Throughout the earliest times, The Ultimate Power had several conflicts with its “family” members including Chaos in a fight that was the first betrayal, first war, and first banishment which resulted in Chaos and their creations the Leviathans being banished into eternal darkness. Later, Belckus their son an Ho’zare betrayed them and was too banished, followed by Lucifer, and later others including humans and gods.

name: Misokune Egg
description:
Rank: Creator of the New Earth

Powerful structure resembling an egg, many believed that the Misokune Egg was an object sent to a new time to birth all things again after the previous reality came to an end. Many others believe that the egg was the product of Elshack to birth Balance, Creation, and Chaos for life to be born. Once Balance, Creation, Chaos, and cosmic energy was  born from the egg, the egg disappeared with its shell pieces serving as the tallest mountains of Eden.

name: Chaos
description:
Rank: Elitsyian embodiment of all evil

Originally a peaceful and mild-mannered being, Chaos grew to dislike The Ultimate Power’s constant noise and creations that interrupted its silence and peace. Pleading for peace and silence, Chaos was unheard, feeling as if they had no other option, Chaos created the Leviathans to destroy creation. After an all out war, Chaos and the Leviathans lost the battle against Creation, the Ho’zares, and the Akuma and was banished to eternal sleep at the lowest peak of Eden.

name: The Neither
description:
Rank: Elitsyian embodiment of all balance

The only one of the Creation Trio that were always mentioned as a woman. The Neither was a powerful figure and at times considered more powerful than the other Creation Trio Chaos and The Ultimate Power. Often staying away from the rest of existence, instead taking a more indirect approach. The Neither carries a large staff with a libra scale. She serves as the mother to Shecknurd, the god of time, Olerta, the goddess of beginnings and gates, the guardians of Fate, Angels of Destiny, Granjun, and many other important figures throughout history. The Neither is the only one of the Creation Trio that can speak and see Elshack and to be able to hear Anka. She also is the only being outside of Anka that knows of the times before and after their current existence. It is believed that when all things come to an end, even when Elshack is no more, that The Neither will become the new Anka and birth the void for a new existence.

name: Ananaka
description:
Rank: Creator of Dreomede

Ananaka was creator of Dreomede and worshiped around the world as deity over the other gods that ruled there. With his many faces he was also a great wizard and gave the world their first taste at practical magic. His mother was Bewithia. Pictured fully clothed in all white and orange Ananaka stood high on his giant white elephant. Later after created the lands of dreams, Ananaka gave food to the sleeping and masked the real world so that those entering could sleep easier without waking. Every where he turned, Ananaka spit out food which humans later took back to their waking world, of which came golden fish, rice, pudding, cakes, and fruit cake. Of these the fruit cake and rice was his sacred meals, if those who wanted good dreams wanted to sleep easily would leave these special meals at their bedsides. Ananaka would then collect them as the person slept.

name: Myonar
description:
Rank: Creator of Illusions & lands of Dreomede

Myonar created his children, the gods of Dreomede out of childhood imaginations and gave them immortality after seeing how the shared idea of special guardians of dreams with mortal children. In honor of children everywhere, Myonar developed cities of ice, rivers of peach water, mountains of rainbow rocks, towers of glass, and playful gardens feel with magical entities. After Myonar's father, Ananaka created Dreomede, he would build its wonderful environments along with create the gods and goddesses that controls it. Myonar played an important role in Elitsyians Myths and gave many mortals gifts if they honored him while awake. He honored them with sweet dreams and they honored him with food and jewelry which were left by rivers or windows as both were open gateways to Dreomede. Myonar created the Imaginarium and its connecting bridges to Dreomede and Nigerikarte.

name: Onarosh
description:
Rank: God of Sleep

Onarosh at night covers the world with a blanket of night and shining stars. With his magical viewing globe, he can spy on the dreams of others and control them. He created the Sand People servants to his sister, Vena to help her guide innocent mortals through Dreomede. His appearance was that of a wiseman covered in magical chains which represented how a dream sometimes bounds us even when we're awake. He was God of Sleep and during the time when people are awake he plays with their minds by giving them what the Elitsyians called Day Spells or the common Daydreams.

name: Ogede
description:
Rank: Spirit of Dreams & River of Dreams

Ogede was the river that flowed gently into Dreomede and separated it from life and death and on its boundary was Nigerikarte “land of nightmares”. Ogede was represented by the spirit that disguised himself as a beautiful swan with magical powers that could heal those that are harm in their sleep. Ogede was product of Ananaka.

name: Croptes
description:
Rank: Spirits of Sleep & Guides throughout Dreams

Croptes or the Sand People were mystical beings that graced human dreams. Their name meant “dream people” and from them came knowledge of the dreamlands which helped people get around this mysterious world. They were servants to Vena and children of Onarosh. Individually they protected a human or animal and guided them through Dreomede. In some parts of the world, they are represented as spirits in the forms of dolls that whatever happened to the doll happened to the person the doll was modeled after.

name: Tonik
description:
Rank: King of Nightmares & God of Illusions

Tonik was King of Nigerikarte and guided demons or demonic spirits into the waking world to taunt people. These spirits were called human nerves and were responsible for headaches and migraines. Tonik was God of Nightmares and often played cruel jokes on his twin brother, Onarosh. His realm was considered a prison to those who didn't know of its true nature and that it was mere illusions constructed of mortal thoughts. Tonik was also considered God of Illusions and to the people of the Islands of Lostasia he was a destructive deity that hated all things and cast onto them haunting images. Until the day they would find out that his tricks couldn't hurt them, the people of the Islands of Lostasia feared the deity and sacrificed their children for their safety.

name: Deptoose
description:
Rank: God of Sleeping Thoughts

Deptoose was God of Sleeping Thoughts, like his siblings he managed to interact with mankind by giving them pleasant but sometimes dangerous thoughts. This was to help make life easier although sometimes made things in the real world harder. Images formed in the dreaming state were his magic at work.

name: Mok’itu
description:
Rank: Guides souls into Eternity

Mok'itu guides the souls of the underworld into Eternity, together they bring the end of suffering for those who are dying and or are in battle. During the Mostibik they were one of the several deities that came together to protect mankind and help restore balance to life.

name: Arcalites
description:
Rank: Female Warriors

Arcalites were several beautiful female warriors that seduced dying men to ease their pain, afterwards they guided their souls to Misearth a place where dead warriors who died from a great battle. They were similar to the Norse Valkyries. They had white shining armors that lit up the skies and flew on magical white and golden armored horses. Their swords could kill demons and their magical pendants could open doorways or gateways into several magical realms. Of all, Arilla was the most famous more so because she once was a Lazaron.

name: Jacko
description:
Rank: Shadow Creature

The Jacko is mischievous creature that taunts children at night and steals their souls if their presence is revealed.

name: Hellsmiths
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

Creatures that live under rocks and will take anyone nearby to their realm if caught without blessing from a pure hearted individual. They are usually only found in non-religious regions.

name: Shadows
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

Shadows are similar in appearance to those they imitate although they believe that their existence was before those that they imitate. The true origin of the shadows has long been debated by people living in the Shadow Realm.

name: Shadow Demon
description:
Rank: Shadow Creature

Often called the Boogeyman, this creature appears as dark smoke that has a sinister voice and will steal the voices and life force of those that aren’t able to resists its angry urges.

name: Shadow Dolls
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

Dolls that appear to be almost human in appearance and take on similar personality traits. These beings are varied in their personalities and are often not as evil as other shadow creatures in the Shadow Realm. They are almost hollow in appearance and has small sparks of life that appears almost entirely to keep them alive indefinitely unless they are broken. The Mirror King created replicas called the Porcelain People for his Mirror Realm.

name: Derrick the Christmas Killer
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

Derrick was a serial killer that killed nearly 100 people in his life. When he died, he was supposed to go to Hell, instead his soul entered the Shadow Realm as directed by Tonik. When the Akuma opened doors between the various realms and universes, Tonik sent Derrick to another universe to continue his deadly killing spree. He is the murder for the Christmas series of stories.

name: Micha Ryland
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents
Note: the Dream Killer

A serial killer that haunts peoples dreams after learning how to enter Dreomede and Nigerakarte. Although, her presence is known by Tonik, the residents of Dreomede including Onarosh goes unknown.

name: Hellshadow
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

Often seen as Tonik’s most loyal shadow resident, this creature has an almost human appearance. The pins that come out of its body has connections to all its victims. Each pin contains the energy drained from its victims allowing Hellshadow to grow almost godlike in power. He has since taken control over the lower kingdom of Nigerakarte and was sent to Universe 62 to steal more souls.

name: Ginji
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

Demonic creatures that appear like fairies, with their dark broken wings, deadly acidic blood, and dark natured attitudes. They are fast and appears in almost every bedtime story to scare children into obedience. Once a part of the Black Forest, these creatures were banished to the Shadow Realm by the first fairy because they killed hundreds of fairies for their fairydust.

name: Inorog
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

A black horse seen with a hundred dark fired tails engulfed in a potent acid. If touched this creature could drain the energy of anyone including gods and send their souls to Hell. This creature was created by Tonik to control and govern the residents of Shadow Realm.

name: Skin Demon
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

A convicted killer that wears the skin of his victims. Brian Willworth was a socialite that went insane when he was outed by his parents. His money was stolen by his friends, and his best friend was killed by his boyfriend. His life was destroyed and no one to turn to, except the devil. He gained the ability to steal the skin of his victims and murdered almost everyone in his life. After his initial mission was over, he was killed and sent to Hell. Here his soul was taken by Tonik to become a Shadow Resident. He was later sent to Universe 64 to murder that universe’s version of his family and friends to gain more power.

name: Truth Stealer
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

The Truth Stealer feeds on lies, in Universe 65, he stole everyone’s lies except for a few residents of that universe’s Earth. In fear of his return, the residents of this Earth live in a perpetual state of truth and cannot lie even if they wanted to. One day a man changes that by telling a lie, when the Truth Stealer appeared to him, the man killed the demon and banished him back to the Shadow Realm. Here Tonik made the Truth Stealer one of his Shadow Guards.

name: Shadow Guard
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

A group of elite warriors capable of creating dimensional gateways to many parts of the Shadow Realm. A feat previously only capable of by Tonik himself. This power allows the guards to watch and intervene in illegal activities in the Shadow Realm. These guards are bestowed incredible power and are stronger than any other Shadow Resident and Shadow Creature.

name: Hell Dolls
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

Deadly dolls that contain the souls of previously deceased murderers. Each of these dolls appear almost animated until they are defeated by someone pure of heart. So far collectively these dolls have murdered over 500 people of Earth in Universe 67.

name: Shadow Realm Ferryman
description:
Rank: Shadow Resident

The ferryman that transports souls between the Shadow Realm and Hell. Because the two realms appear almost side by side of each other, separated by a large black river. The ferryman can freely go between both. On one end, there is fire with cities made up of bones and the other a place of shadows although appearing almost like our own Earth. The ferryman often stays in the Shadow Realm because its more appeasing appearance. The ferryman is the sibling to the ferrymen of Eternity and Onur “the Underworld”.

name: Gate Watchers
description:
Rank: Shadow Residents

Gate Watchers are large golem like creatures with almost impenetrable armor. Their only function is to protect the Shadow Realm from invaders from either of its eight entry points. Also, their objectives are to stop those from freely escaping the Shadow Realm without Tonik’s permission.

name: Fear Demons
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

A scarecrow like creature that eats bats and humans. Originally a creature of Hell, Tonik convinced these creatures to take residents in the Shadow Realm of which they agreed unanimously.

name: Arminoids
description:
Rank: Shadow Creatures

Half demon, half insect, half human parts. These creatures are powerful and varied in appearance and personalities. Some remember their previous lives, while others don’t allow them to become even more dangerous. They are children to Jegeru and Tonik.

name: Vomir
description:
Rank: God of Prayer & Silence

A silent god of the Shadow Realm that watches over its residents. It keeps their prayers and deliver them appropriately to their god of worship. Although he barely speaks, his whispers are translated as words to the god Tonik providing council to the deity.

name: Tur’
description:
Rank: God of the Earth

Tur' God of the Earth took shape under his mother Santiyline's dress as a trembling boy who could make flowers grow and glow with just a touch. As he grew older his roots burned off and he then took his first step on the grounds that he nourished for hundreds of years before. Now out and about onto the world, Tur' made his contributions first he gave the uninhabitable Earth sweet green grass and beautiful flowers plucked from his hair. Then he spit onto the ground and out came lakes and ponds. From his tears came the nature spirits the Nareids or Earth Maidens. With his fingernails broke off the first magical creature the unicorn. From his sperm came a legion of magical creatures. Now with a world of magical creatures he created them a home separate of the Earth but in its exact image and named it the Other World. Tur' then with his daughters the Nareids gave birth to the satyrs, centaurs, camel, frogs, crocodiles, alligators, and the elephant. For Tur' love life he fell in love with his aunt Adv and when her love was returned the two committed in intercourse. But because his mother Santiyline thought that her sister was taking advantage of her son, she pulled the two apart and placed Adv in the sky and Tur' as the ground of the Earth. But Adv was falling in love and so was her body the sky with her, so to make sure the sky wouldn't collapse on the ground below.

name: As a guide on Earth
description: During the battle in Mostibik, Tur lost most of his powers. Sent to Earth for protection by his mother, Santiyline. He built a robot named Beta 6 and the two created a base under the Earth to create and guide numerous super powered individuals on Earth against the rising demonic forces. He took the powers of his fellow gods and placed them inside of crystals calling the Earth Crystals and scattered them across the world. He collected them again when he needed to form the Earth Raiders, a team of young individuals who will save the world from the oncoming rise of Santaniel.

name: Losia
description:
Rank: Creator of Lostasia

Losia was founder and sometimes referred to as the creator of Lostasia. He was the first man but when he became to smart, the gods took him to the heavens and made him a god. From there he watches over Lostasia and serves as their protector.

name: Ku’
description: Ku' Flame eared snake headed deity that never reveals himself to anyone not even the gods unless they threaten nature. Sent to Earth by Santiyline, this deity uses its ears to listen out for intruders and hides in the deep woods with its ears covered by grass.

name: Cresha
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Sacred Gardens

In the sacred garden demons and spirits could not enter, as for gods they had to have permission by the Elitsyians and Cresha before entering. Cresha protected the lands until the final day when the mysterious but beautiful garden disappeared. In Christian Mythology this garden is called the Garden of Eden.

name: Den Vao
description:
Rank: Gods of Doors & Entrances

Den Vao was Door Protectors and Land Gods. Protective spirits, the Den Vao live inside doorways and come out at midnights. Their true forms are similar to thousands of shape shifting little creatures both half dwarf and half gremlin. Sometimes very sneaky and pranksters they were also very loving guardians of families and young children. The only ones to see them are those they protect and magical deities.

name: The Dog
description:
Rank: Godly Warriors

The Dog is the most powerful deity to the upper North Lostasia and he contains the head of a dog, paws, a tail, and human body. The Dog separated himself early on from other myths because he believed that his importance should stay in secret. His goal is to protect humanity and is consider high priest over all other Earthly warriors and while in the afterlife, spirits of dead warriors slain in battle go to his kingdom, Kinvalla, where they eat and celebrate their deaths for eternity. Here the Dog live in honor and peace, where he also watches over war battles and judge those slain in them. Those worthy enough go to his kingdom to rest in peace for eternity and those not worthy go to his Field of War, Copria, where they train for the Final Battle.

name: The Cat
description:
Rank: Goddess of Balance & Order

The Cat Goddess of Balance and Order is cat headed and have feline attributes. Opposite to The Dog, she uses her magical powers to keep balance, order, and peace in the world. The stars sit at her footsteps and at the end of her magical halls in her kingdom, Polltotum, lay very giants cats that gave birth to the cosmos and its many wonders. She was worshiped only in Upper Lostasia where she was more powerful of all else and is consider Queen of All Things as for Crienta is celebrated elsewhere. Even though she argued constantly with Dog she created the Field of War for him so that fallen warriors could prepare for the final battle.

name: Sayr
description:
Rank: God of Agriculture & Farming

Sayr the God of Agriculture and Farming. Sayr is product of Sonos and the Nymph, Smu. Whenever he was sad he planted hundreds of fruits and vegetables at a time. His home was the first barn and from clay he made the first sheep, boars, crow, beaver, and owl. He had the lower torso of a chicken and the upper body of a teenage boy. His daughters and often companions are the Dynameids.

name: Elexan
description:
Rank: God of Travel & Roads

Elexan concord of thieves and God of Travel and Roads created the first road and village to help trade secrets back into the rest of the world. Although a trickster and the counterpart to the Norse god Loki he had no decent chain of story. His child was the first thief and the first pirate and like Crochen he had a concord of thieves and pirates who roamed the world searching for priceless items. In the war against Atlantis, Elexan led the war and nearly conquered the island if not for his own greed to still its treasure and technology. This act caused him his life and major damage to Lostasia's eastern and southern coast.

name: Smod
description:
Rank: Goddess of Harvest

Smod Goddess of the Harvest is the most beloved Goddess in all of Elitsyian Myths. Because of mankind's love for her she was granted a position with the Royal Circa deities but denied it to remain among mortals. Temples, ritual sites, cities, and festivals were built in her honor. Festivals are thrown in her honor across Lostasia and she attends each and when hearths above fireplaces are lit in her honor she grants the household safety through the night. With her blessings the home is protected from demonic spirits that plague the homes of newborn children.

name: Onys
description:
Rank: God of Wine & Festivals

Onys is God of Wine and Festivals and son to Smod, unlike his counterparts from other myths he is very polite but with more than often lazy behavior. In his many forms he took various other acts such as huntsman, Omire God of Hunting and Fishing. In this form he gave the world fish and the sport of hunting, but when he was angered by a tribe he gave the tasty and beautiful fish scales and bones. In his original form he honors his mother by playing instruments at festivals, he is responsible for magical beer that can cause the drinker to become intoxicated. From his sacred garden he mixes grapes and other fruits with water to make his beverages that hes known for. His creations are the grape, beer, wine, and festivals.

name: Illara
description:
Rank: Goddess of Hunting, Animals, & Archery

Illara goddess of Hunting, Animals, and Archery is daughter to Omire, but like her father she is only worshiped in Western, Northern, and Central Lostasia. With the absence of hunting in the other parts of Lostasia, the Elitsyians gave her a counterpart and named her Aralli which is Illara backwards. Unlike Illara, Aralli was evil although she protected animals and hunters, she had little to care about anyone else. Illara founded Archery and presented it to the Indians and Aztecs in honor of her husband Well. Together they gave birth to Morch.

name: Jakilen
description:
Rank: Volcano & Mountain God

Jakilen is the Volcano and Mountain God and eldest son to Siphnu. His older brother is Volkanos in which the word volcano derives from. He is one of avatars to Khani and after Khani being banished to HELL, Jakilen was born from rock and fire to curse the world with erupting mountains. His kinder brother Volkanos hated his brother's temper so much that he sealed him beneath the earth forever. Whenever he sneezes or laughs volcanoes erupts.

name: Xesir
description:
Rank: God of Construction

Xesir son to Volkanos, he was born of steel and dead skin. Xesir provided the first steel structure and erected the first mountain. His main worship is in Mountainville and is the God of Construction. Golems were his children and gremlins were his guardians all made of rock and crystal.

name: Sesir
description:
Rank: Goddess of Statues

Sesir daughter to Xesir and Frisk. Sesir is Goddess of Statues and would serve later on as mother to other deities such as Tolen and Sole the first shaman. She built the first statues in honor of the gods and erected them high above all else.

name: Tolen
description:
Rank: God of Cities, township, & industries

Tolen god of cities, township, and industries is the proud son to Sesir. Born from her left nipple he is also considered a warrior of the city he is worship, Mountainville. Following in his grandfather's footsteps, Tolen built the first city and town in honor of Xesir. In every new city a pile of rocks were found at the entrance and with this offering, the newborn city will experience long wealth and protection.

name: Li
description:
Rank: God of Earthquakes

Li is God of Earthquakes and father to the Serpent and Hydra. With his children, Li travels the underworld torturing the living world above. Seen as half bull and half cyclops, Li is very powerful and with the help of his wife, Jegeru they dominate parts of the underworld and occasionally protects the Gates of HELL. His creations are the serpent, hydra, bull, and the Kraken.

name: Bornude
description:
Rank: God of Corn

Bornude god of corn is a minor Earth god that only his protection of corn made him somewhat of a legend in Lostasia. His father is Tur' and his mother is the nymph Kos.

name: Nusuwaka
description:
Rank: Earth Goddess

Nusuwaka originally worshiped as a water goddess because of her association with a magical fountain that from it came the rich honey of the immortals. Found near the sacred garden of Santiyline this deity came along way from a water deity into a mature Earth Goddess. Nusuwaka was born from the waters of the biggest blossom tree in Lostasia. Along with her brother Hoshiume she dances among the gods and grants them with chalices that hold the golden honey.

name: Hoshiume
description:
Rank: Earth God

Hoshiume originally worshiped as a water god because of his association with a magical spring and wishing well. From the wishing well was the golden honey which collapsed into the magical spring that flowed quietly into the Sea of Time. Hoshiume gave important notice that he was an Earth God with his contribution of the first well, waterfall, forest, and he created the valley. Molded out of a blossom tree's magical river, Hoshiume was brother to Nusuwaka.

name: Red Grape
description:
Rank: None

Red Grape was given his name because of his red face and grape shaped head. Worshiped primarily in Western Lostasia and on the Islands of Lostasia where he also was believed to create the islands from the seeds of giant grapes that fell from the Heavens. When the lands became harden, he gave them the first fruit trees and animals to enjoy them. In his sacred garden hidden far away from all else in the now Antarctic Ocean he enjoyed playing an ancient form of soccer and planting.

name: White Maiden
description:
Rank: Supreme Goddess

White Maiden was worshiped on the Islands of Lostasia as their sacred supreme goddess. She made men and women and gave them the gift of fire and grew plants for them to eat. Their homes she made straw and stones to protect them from harsh weathers. Although she was always seen happy and very loving, this deity also was associated with war and death. When angered by those who dare hurt animals or her many wonders of nature, she would bring war to their homes or cities. After the death of someone she would carry their souls to a temple where she burned them so they could be reborn. Fires are lit along with burning the bodies of the dead so that those who die could be reborn. Once reborn children are given the names of those once passed away to not just honor them but to give them similar traits that they had. Her real name is unknown but because of drawings on wet sap paper caused her to become the now name White Maiden.

name: Shiannona Noon
description:
Rank: Earth Goddess of Grain & the Unicorn

Shiannona Noon was a minor Earth Goddess of the Grain and Unicorn. Represented as avatar to Shiannona, Shiannona Noon had a magical horse name Will adopted from Elitsyian Mythology which showed their brief connection. While on Will, Shiannona Noon gave good fortune to those who left her pastures of corn and wheat both which were sacred to her. Goddess of Grain, Harvest, Wheat, and the Unicorn, Shiannona Noon was a beautiful, middle age, and old woman throughout the day and was reborn to youth in the morning to show the respected turning of nature. Shiannona Noon wore robes of gold and silver leaves hanging from her belt made up of wheat.

name: Ooh
description:
Rank: God of the island Mo

Ooh meant “hurt” to the Elitsyians and from this name they created the idea of the great force that sunk their once capital city, Mo. Ooh was God of this island and when the city refuse to worship him one day, he sunk it in retaliation. After this he would go unworshiped and slowly disappear from further stories.
affiliates: Elitsyian Gods; Earth Gods; Water Gods

name: Castle Gods
description:
Rank: Earth Gods of Kite Island

Castle Gods were rock and Earth Gods that made castles for royalty. Their works were imported into several surrounding islands including Lostasia. They help make the home to the Elitsyian Royal Circa Gods. Often seen as bulky and loud men with rude attitudes always laughing and playing, the Castle Gods are rarely told apart as they felt like brothers and remain as such in their followings.

name: Gardena
description:
Rank: Goddess of Flowery Pastures and patron of gardens

A beautiful maiden of Santiyline who planted beautiful gardens across Lium for her. She never interacted with humans however her gardens have been much subject by them. Believing that they were so beautiful as told by a passenger saying he had saw them. The residents of Elitsyia created replica gardens and dedicated statues to the deity.

name: Sontarti
description:
Rank: Balancer of Life

Sontarti balanced life with his glowing orbs. Instead of arms and hands, Sontari had magical crystal globes floating where his arms should be. To balance life, his globes would stay at equal length, but at the end of time at the battle of Mostibik they fell and time stopped.

name: Malkit
description:
Rank: Guardian of the Gates of Life

Malkit is the lion like god that guards the gates of Life. His name is invoke on whenever someone nears death. His magic and a sacrifice can promise the spirit a safe journey through the dangerous underworld.

name: Titani
description:
Rank: Guardian of Heaven

Titani is the frog headed god that guarded the heavens. He was rarely seen on earth and when he was he moved so fast jumping from mile to mile that many couldn't remember how he looked. Seen as a deity that only was seen in his own domain he wasn't worshiped much and the mystery of why he was included at all in Elitsyian Myths is unknown, so his actual role in the myths is still unsolved.

name: Selbi
description:
Rank: Spiritual Guide of Creation

Caped in wires of plants and metal, this goddess used her magical lantern in creation to guide spirits into the land of the living so they can be born. She also assists in childbirth and protects mothers and wives. Her name is called on by women to become pregnant when in other ways they cannot.

name: The Names
description:
Rank: Watchers over Eternity

The Names are deities that keep watch over Eternity. From their realm hidden away from all else they were created by Elshack to tend to the future. Before and after the Final Battle they existed and to the response of the High Council, they reset time and created a new world, with more exciting things for mankind. They took powder from fallen stars and sealed away all living things in it and then they restore all else and placed mankind in the new world. Here mankind learn to live with the help of gods and had no memory of their lives before.

name: Santare’
description:
Rank: Caretaker of Heaven

Santare' took precious care of the gardens of Helliholm “heaven”. Around it laid several beautiful gardens that were not to be harmed or ever tarnished by evil. She grew giant trees and from their limbs were giant fruit. This process took 10,000 years and in that time, Santare' tended to the gardens like they were her children and so the Elitsyians called her Mother Nature before they created Santiyline. Once the fruit were ripe, Santare' held massive parties for the gods and goddesses of Elitsyian Mythology and they ate the fruits which allowed them eternal youth and great strength for another 10,000 years.

name: Barwick
description:
Rank: Creator of the Book of Life

Barwick made a book from wood and called it the all knowing book of the people. It read all things and from its contents he learned how to create the milky way in which the gods also bathe in to remain immortal. He created the Book of Life of which the Lazarons uses to fight against dark forces.

name: Shiannona
description:
Rank: Queen of Eternity

Shiannona was Queen of Eternity, her presence with the Islandia Elitsyians were even greater than Crienta. She existed above all else and had no use for immortality and thus lived with humans. But one day a wrath of demons fled the Earth looking for immortality and her power was needed so she swept to the skies and become the deity that she is today. With the Jonireres she is worshiped as their version of the Creation Mother a deity in mythology that created all things. From her necklaces carried many things, four jewels that represented the moon, sun, Earth, and the Underworld and wrapped around it was a iron disk that was the universe. Her hair was golden and came the roots of the Earth. Her skin was the milky way. Her home was on top of a giant phoenix that flames bought heat to the gods while the sun brought heat to the humans. Her wings blew wind down to earth. The Jonireres thought that Shiannona laid 4 eggs. When they hatched the heavens were made from the yolk, from the white milk around the yolk was the milky way, and the whites became the stars. The liquid from the yolk was the rivers of the world. From her tears came the first man and woman. Like an animal, Shiannona could shed her skin like fur and came the grounds of the Earth. To show her cultured around the world, her chariot was led by Sphinx from Egypt. In her giant palace stood hundreds of halls, in each lied different worlds that offered valuable things. At one of the main hall, lied the sun and the other end the moon. In its center lied the Earth floating above rocks representing the underworld. She brought the sun across the hall over the Earth and set it next to the moon. Then she took the moon across to the other side and back across to the other side at dawn. At the end of time, the Jonireres knew Shiannona would grow angry at them and throw the world into the rocks killing all things. So to make Shiannona happy they merged her with Crienta in stories to widen her worship. In the New World Order which was set after the prophesied Mostibik, Shiannona would rule all things.

name: Ferryman of Eternity
description: Along with the Ferrymans of the Underworld and Ferryman of the Shadow Realm, the Ferryman of Eternity is a spirit that takes souls to a different realm. It appears in the form of a woman with a long veil and skeletal face. She can easily move between Oblivion transporting once immortal souls to their afterlife and can appear also in Heaven, Hell, the Underworld and is the oldest of her siblings existing before even Shecknurd and Death (Time and Death).

name: Ikna’ra
description:
Rank: Primordial of Eternal Death

A powerful entity that appears before all gods before they die. Like the Primordial One Death. This being is a large, cloaked figure with long flowing red hair and sharp nails. When waiting for death, she appears in her plane alongside Olerta and is an often accomplice.

name: North Star
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Northern Lights

A cosmic star that can appear almost human and was once considered the Northern Light. A passing deity that can glide across the night sky blessing the children of those that worships her.

name: Jesus
description:
Rank: Messenger of GOD

A human that was blessed by GOD before their birth. On the night of Jesus’ birth, three angels came to visit her, on that night they foretold of Jesus power, mission, and for the sake of humanity told the mother that he would unite the world. Jesus’ power consists of Transmutation which allows him to turn items into another form. After death, Jesus’ ascended to Heaven where he became an angel that sits next to GOD in Araboth.

name: Arcota
description:
Rank: Spirits of Time

Arcota are gentle spirits of time that live in Andvom a place existing out of space and time. From here all things are recorded and the Arcota keep the records up to date. Because there are so many no one Arcota is described separately. They are pictured as white maidens with long hair and sharp fingers. There screams are so loud that when heard on earth it can shatter glass and crumble mountains. They come before someone that is near death and they write down the person or animals history.

name: Timpo
description:
Rank: God of Time

Timpo was the elephant God of Time, lower body of an elephant and upper body of a man, Timpo could see in the dark and predict the future. His name was translated into Time.

name: Postia
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Past and Reincarnation

The goddess of the past, she was mother to the Arcota and with her and Shecknurd, they birth the cosmic balance that represented past lives and reincarnation. She was highly worshipped in the northern and eastern parts of Elistia.

name: Dedilus
description:
Rank: God of the Future and Prophecies

Representing the future, Dedilus was a disfigured deity that was once human until Shecknurd shocked of the man’s will to live and extensive knowledge granted him immortality and the post to guard the Gates of Time. It is believed that the Greeks created the god Chronos after him.

name: Volkanos
description:
Rank: God of the Forge, Fire, & Blacksmith of the Gods

Born deform his father Born' banished him from the Heavens. While wondering the Earth, he came across Jakilen and the two befriended each other and Volkanos built hundreds of weapons to battle against the other gods. But once Volkanos found out about Jakilen's true plan to destroy the world to free his true form Khani, Volkanos sealed Jakilen beneath the Earth and left for the Heavens again. This time awaiting him was the gods and they granted him place among them for his efforts. While in the Heavens he makes magical and indestructible weapons for the gods and sometimes for other entities. In the final battle, Volkanos made the Key of Humanity and gave it to Kanos to protect the world from the Final Battle.

name: Akudrum
description:
Rank: God of Smoke

Akudrum was the fire headed god of smoke. Although he played no major role in Elitsyian Mythology he was however worshiped at camp fires for protection of campers. It was believed that his smoke from fires could guide those lost in the darkness or in the forests.

name: Jagnur
description:
Rank: Iron God & Blacksmith

Jagnur was Iron God and Blacksmith of armor and weaponry. A minor earth and fire deity, Jagnur was a wolf with armor and vast knowledge. He watched over the forest and howl when intruders threaten it. His tears could heal and his fangs could kill immortals, with his fur could make someone or something indestructible. His eyes were the moon and suns of the magical world and he protected it with all his power. He was assistant to Volkanos and created weapons for mortal kings and magical armies for cities whom made peace offerings to him.

name: Muda
description:
Rank: Wife to Con

Muda took precious jewels from the Earth and carved them into 5 beautiful goddesses. While they grew and sprouted into the 5 goddesses, Muda left their side and rode off into the winds. Here she would come across the god of Light, Con and the two caught each other's attention so much that love was shared. Con instantly married the goddess and brought her to his kingdom hidden deep in the sun. Marrying them off was the Sun God, Ohn, but he too adored the deity and thus he challenged, Con to battle for her love. Con not one to fight gave into the proposal of which Ohn won. Muda who didn't agree with this denied but offered one of her daughters, Mua, Goddess of Fire to Ohn instead which Ohn accepted. Muda return to her daughters with Con and Con named them the elements and of which they also protected. On the islands of Lostasia women worship her for standing up against the powerful god, Ohn and to this day many women pray to her for inner and physical strength.

name: Mua
description:
Rank: Volcano Goddess of Fire

Mua was the Volcano Goddess of Fire that sent lava to harden into the many islands of Lostasia. Of the 17 islands she is greatly worshiped on 16 of them as the creator goddess. She was daughter to Muda and was married off to Ohn as a present to the Sun God. Her anger was often and she wanted all things as part of her domain, to get what she wished she sent flames down to villages and threaten to destroy all. As presents, villages sent baskets of jewelry and food to her temples of those she visited often. Her breasts were the volcanoes, her heart the Earth's core, and her hair was the lava that rested on her breasts and flowed onto the grounds of her once husband Tur'. Story of Tur' and Mua lasted only one chapter and stated that the two gods loved each other so much that they made the Earth and gave it wondrous features. But because of her temper, the earth god Tur' fell out of love from her and the two went their ways. To punish him, Mua threw thick flames onto Tur' and burned his wondrous fields and precious forests.

name: Antient
description:
Rank: God of Fire

Antient held as one of the 20 forms of Si'unduru,opruma was God of Fire and brought it to mankind to light their way into life. Antient grew so old after revealing his secret that he turned to ashes and from those ashes he was reborn as the Sun God.

name: Fire Spirit
description:
Rank: God of the Forge

Fire was God of the Forge; this spirit gave light to humans and taught them how to build objects. Also the God of Light and Inventions, Fire was probably the most well known god on Memorai. Fire was blacksmith of the other gods and with his muscular appearance he was adored by all goddesses and women alike. With long hair of molten lava and broad shoulders that were the mountains of the earth and teeth that protected the underworld, he was of massive size but had the heart to match. Although appearing sometimes as an angry giant, Fire was gentle and often clumsy setting things ablaze.

name: The Dentehigh
description:
Rank: Gods of Nomodia Isle

The Dentehigh were a significant race of supreme deities, almost a thousand in counting these gods were both male and female and brought the human race to share their wisdom with and pass down their many beliefs. But unlike most deities, the Dentehigh were no more immortals than the mortals they created, they were ascended race of humans that lived before the creation of our current world. When they came back to Earth they created Nomodia Isle to be their home. Some of the prime figures were Nute, Chit, Repere, Conni, Spare, and Dow who all created the world. Denmore, Lost, History, Unova, Jinger, and Weeze all created the universe and were very wise. Donmore and Xstrophe created eternity and the heavens. Doshi was evil and he created Hell and the underworld for evil spirits to roam. To the Nomadians belief system, the Dentehigh made a powerful spark of light that would create all things and with the help of their powers man would create everything that was needed for life on Earth. Overtime the world formed and new things came to life and men grew wiser to their surroundings.

name: Denmore
description: King of the Gods, God of Carpentry & Crafts

name: Lost
description: Queen of the Gods, Goddess of Toys, Cuttery, and Blessings

name: History
description: God of the Past, Recordings, and Lectures

name: Wicked
description:
Note: Deaf, Lazy, & Blind

Personifications of Wicked, Lazy, Deaf, and Blind

name: Unova
description: Goddess of the elements

name: Jinger
description: Blacksmith of the gods, God of Strength, Courage, and Wisdom

name: Weeze
description: God of War, Sacrifice, and Disorder

name: Donmore
description: God of Eternity and Death

name: Xstrophe
description: Goddess of the Heavens

name: Doshi
description: Creator of Hell and the Underworld

name: The Unvin
description:
Rank: Spirits of the Underworld

The Unvin are a creative collective that roam the underworld in black sheep skinned cloths. Unseen by anyone these beings once lived on Earth until members of the Dentehigh banished them beneath the ground. Because of their beliefs, many Nomadians refuse to believe that these beings were the first race of humans, although many other societies state that they were. These creatures guarded dreams, protected the underworld, guided and tortured the dead, the Unvin also help spirits travel to Eternity for peace.

name: Dontings
description:
Rank: Shape shifters

Residents of Kite Island believed in house spirits known as Dontings, shape shifters that were usually harmless unless angered because they were not left presents. Not liking to be seen, the Dontings wore long robes and covered their faces with their long hair, very fast they were also great cooks and even greater shoe makers.

name: Mirror Spirits
description:
Rank: Creators of the Reflection

Mirror Spirits were creators of the reflection and unlike other deities; they were spirits of tense light and could burn the pupils of anyone that’s not an immortal. They took many forms and could control the dreams of the sleeping.

name: The Tikes
description:
Rank: Fertility Gods

The Tikes were fertility gods rarely seen and written about, the Tikes were less worshiped then their brethren the War Gods, Tionide. The Tikes were numbered in the hundreds and each human person including animals had their own Tike which blessed them with reproduction, good wealth, and sense of direction, knowledge, great sight, and good luck. Also the Tikes were love gods and helpful servants to Jessana of Elitsyian Mythology.

name: The Tionide
description:
Rank: War Deities

The Tionide were powerful war deities, seen in numbers of thousands, these sometimes giant gods all sat around a magical spinning round table. At its center was the world and together they split the world up so they could rule. In each part of the world, the Tionides created wars to conquer other nations and build their own. Then they made languages and taught stories, poetry, art, battling, and magic to their new followers. The Tionide also was known to mostly men with the exception of the female goddess, Bolgride.

name: Bolgride
description: Bolgride was so beautiful that her brothers protected her at all cost. At the end of time, Bolgride was killed by a dart shot from across the oceans, and the Tionide raged war against the Earth destroying all things even themselves.

name: Enkidia
description:
Rank: Love, Peace, & War God/Goddess

Enkidia was a love, peace, and war deity. He was both a male and female and shared consorts for both forms. In his male form he was the Love God, Enchris and as a woman he was the War and Peace Goddess, Enkidi. The two forms met under the tallest apple tree, once here they met and kissed. The kiss brought love to human hearts, war to their minds, and peace to their lives. The consort of love and war was shared in cultures around the world as the two was constant lovers. Enkidia was then formed out of their love making and the gods merged them together.

name: Enchris
description:
Rank: God of Love

Enchris was the handsome God of Love and Fertility. His heart was shared as the first heart of the first man. With his skin came their clothing and pieces of his hair came their weapons to hunt. All of these things were associated with him and he was classified as God of Hunting and Fashion. So captivating by the goddess, Enkidi that the two later fell in love and mated given birth to the first man and woman. They were so passionate that the gods merged them together.

name: Arte-Mode
description:
Rank: Ancient Creator Gods

The Jonir Gods are a legion of great deities worshiped mainly on the Islands of Lostasia. Each island believed in these 12 deities as their creators and protectors. One in particular created all evil and unleashed onto the world. From the darkness came the universe and with the stars were born the gods. The eternal light from each star gave the gods their immortality and ultimate powers. The Jonir Gods made their home, Jonira from ice and rock made by the once cold sun. Jonira had many temples, cities, forests, and beautiful land features that made all that saw it want to live there. The gods sat in their meeting hall high above all else. In this sacred place all fates were decided by ancient spirits. Arte-Moda were so ancient that they were first created from the darkness. With exceptional knowledge these deities reigned over all as wise angels. They drunk from the milky way believing that it could give immortality. High above the Heavens they sat and sung heavenly songs that could control the minds of all even the gods. They were supreme gods that were associated with rain, thunder and lightning, Earth and its landforms, nature, great cities of rock and metal, and the waters of the world. Although, rarely associated separately these deities existed as 15 high ranking gods and goddesses.

name: Lthrenta
description:
Rank: Supreme Creator God

Lthrenta was supreme creator god and was associated with War and Death; he created the underworld from shattered rocks brought to Earth after its creation. He then constructed a war plan to take over his sibling’s kingdom and rule over all creation. Lthrenta was old and very wise and the people from the Islands of Lostasia associated him with Wisdom and Power. His left eye was cut out by a warrior wolf demon that he would later slay and placed him into the sky as the moon. His hammer, Omptguild was so fierce that when stroked on the ground caused earthquakes, when he spiked the clouds rain spilled out, and he then threw thunderbolts from the sky. In all, Lthrenta was referred to as God of Thunder, War, Death, Wisdom, and Power. In his room he held the book of all knowledge and from it came the wisdom of humanity. Lthrenta was the all powerful and one of the strongest Jonir Gods that also carried the dead off into his second home the underworld.

name: Umetrah
description:
Rank: Supreme Goddess

Umetrah supreme goddess made grain and rice from the rain. She planted them on earth to grow vegetables, fruits, and several trees. Although all powerful, this deity was only seen when the Earth cried for her and even at that moment she would appear more as a whisper in the winds.

name: Rem
description:
Rank: God of the Sky & Sea

Rem doubted that he would ever become king after the Arte-Moda gave the throne to his brother Lthrenta, so he took the skies instead. He gave man gracious winds and he controlled the seas. His daughters the Nu were several maidens that pushed the waters of the sea to make waves. Rem was the elder God of the Sky and Sea.

name: Nu
description:
Rank: Parents of lakes, rivers, streams, waterfalls, & the oceans

Nu was 5 elegant maidens who moved the waters and gave birth to lakes, rivers, streams, waterfalls, and the oceans. They were fathered by Rem who constructed them out of icy rain called snow. Seen as warriors made of water these beautiful goddesses rode on chariots pulled by ice and fire horses.

name: Deam
description:
Rank: God of Magic & Protection

Deam body was covered in white ash with skin of blue and white metal. Deam was so powerful that the other gods banished him behind giant doors made of golden rock and steel. Deam at one time was God of Magic and Protection, but while in his tomb, Deam sends his soul to the Heavens to carry the sun across the sky at dawn and the moon across after he settles the sun in the ocean. Deam does this deed to hopefully be freed, with a hidden agenda to rule over all things.

name: Pinikuhwa
description:
Rank: Supreme Goddess & Goddess of the Sun

Pinikuhwa was Mother Sun, she was so powerful and beautiful that the gods granted her with a shining crown. She ruled the heavens with Lthrenta and mothered his children but not all of them. From her crown shined bright light that was the sun's rays. Pinikuhwa sat on her throne the sun and like a queen she rode it while Deam carried it around the Earth.

name: Manetfyre
description:
Rank: Giants that ruled Maye Island

The Maye Island was controlled by several kings and queens and each took portions of this fairly big size island and made into Lostasia's capital. When the Elitsyians begun to move from this island to a bigger and better environment, they left behind stories of giants, gods, great battles, and creatures that wondered their world. They believed that the world was flat and giants ruled them. These giants were called the Divine Creators or Manetfyre. Manetfyre were powerful giants that roamed the world in their chariots pulled by the 5 elements. Jontihilm was king of the Manetfyre and he ruled over the Earth and its precious minerals. Knowing nothing of his creators and where he came from, Jontihilm created the other giants and seized the world as his kingdom. Montihorah was queen of the giants, ugly and rude was her description. She had control over all waters of the world and from them came the first people of the world. Since the people of Maye Island believed that they came from the sea, they credited Montihorah as their creator mother. Jepsipere, was high ruler over the skies. His tears became the rain and from it came the flowers and trees. Then from his sweat after making the sky out of rocks and water, he made grain and gave the world the first animal. Jepsipere also is responsible for giving authority to hunting and sports. Ontiheilm was the support giant that built weapons for his families and mankind out of fire and steel. He built the world, the heavens, the underworld, and home to the giants out of stardust. He then took ownership over the dead believing them to be quieter than his family and mankind. He was God of Fire, Metal, and the Underworld. During the 31 day of October believe to be sacred to the dead, skeleton bones and mummies dance and sung songs of ancient times to amuse the living. At the daybreak of November 1st the dead went back to rest. Ambriham was the wisest, from his fort he predicted the future and wrote down stories of the past in his book. His book had all knowledge of the world and with he destroyed his siblings and took control over Heaven. From his magic he created the new race of giants more powerful than the last and named them the Hoshtars.

name: Hoshtars
description:
Rank: 6 Giants that ruled Maye Island

Hoshtars are 6 giants that took control after the fall of the Manetfyre. Out of their ashes, Ontiheilm ruled over all, he was associated as the God of Wisdom and all Creation. The Join were the three siblings that took control over destiny and fate. Issuril watched over all beings while in heaven and brought them to the living to be born. Yobusubit was seen as a young girl that made and threads the weave of all life, she often cut individual threads to end life. Xhanticolm was old and could see the future, hidden away from all else, she was seer of the Inevitable. KimKim was the two headed watchmen that patiently watched over the world and its people. The Nox was the protective one eyed, six armed watch guard that stood at the gates of the underworld. La Bere had no children unlike many other giants, taking over the sky, earth, oceans, and all plant life, La Bere was wife to Ambriham.

name: Deities of Island of the Peon People
description:
Rank: None

Hares, the Peons, & Caole, the Hares protect the household and its surrounding lands, if threatened they could become very dangerous. The Peons named after the people who worshiped them, looked after the house storeroom and food supply. They were honored food and baskets of flowers, if not then they would mess up the home and rot the food. Caole were spirits that existed in all things inanimate and living things, when the living thing dies or the inanimate object is destroyed the spirits enters new host. In living things, the Caole lived in humans as their souls, guided them, watch over them, and recorded their history. All of these spirits were honored at temples around the island of the Peon People. The Hares, Peons, and Caole also were worshiped on the mainlands in Lostasia and with each individual task they were grouped together and called Gentiies. The Gentiies were named after similar spirits of Roman Mythology.
