name: Nicolih Natale
description: Spirit of Wrongdoing, spitefulness, trickery, and the night

name: Es
description:
Rank: Supreme God over the North Island

Es was supreme deity over the North Island; his troops made of stone were his constant bodyguards. He created angels and demons to control the fates of good and evil and create balance in the world. He grew from the sea and with the help of his talking pigeon he became the Supreme God.

name: Moose
description:
Rank: Supreme Father God of the Indians

Moose was sacred to the Indians and the Africans because he was their supreme father. But when Moose sold their lands to other supreme deities for immortality, he was banished to the West Island of the Four Corners. He then made the lands, waters, sky, and invented fire from rocks so he could have a home to rule.

name: Aa
description:
Rank: Wisdom Goddess

Aa was sister and wife to Es. Born at the same time from the universe, Aa and her brother split of two islands, North and South and pushed them far from each other so they could rule over them. Aa was divine and gave order and great wisdom. She created man and from her breasts came food and rain.

name: Tear
description:
Rank: Crying Goddess

Tear was the crying goddess bound to a tree because the other gods couldn't bear her loud crying in the heavens. Once the goddess was visited by a young girl who was then turned to stone by the sound of the goddess' cries. A dog later became immune to the crying because of its acute hearing; it release the goddess by biting at her chains. For his reward, Tear gave animals voices although heard from humans are just whimpering sounds similar to the goddess’ cries. Tear would then take the dog and give him immortality and since then Tear is pictured as a beautiful woman that stood next to a dog.

name: Senda
description:
Rank: Warrior of the Four Corners

Senda had no fears and was worshiped as the great warrior of the Four Corners. He was high in power and worship that he was given the title of supreme god. He gave the world animals and built cities for mankind. Senda ruled over the East island.

name: Ware
description:
Rank: Three War Gods

Ware was three War Gods of the north and south islands. One planned and directed war, the other decided the outcome, and the third took control over the dead warriors trained them and sent them to his sacred halls in heaven to feasts.

name: Aero Optus’
description:
Rank: Man made Gods

Aero Optus' were several gods made by man from stone and plants. From the rivers of Immortality which flowed freely throughout the Eastern Island, man gave these statues immortality and they came to life. For their lives, these collections of deities made the chariot, mirror, beer, and brought peace to the islands.

name: Nuni
description:
Rank: Member of the Ware

Nuni warlord that was granted immortality from the Ware for saving them from the Neckless Serpent. Nuni is described to being a tyrant that rode across the sky with thunder being made from his laughter and rain from the sparks of his chariot's wheels. Nuni would later be inducted into the Ware and made their third deity, but of the other two, Nuni is still worshiped separately.

name: Neckless Serpent
description:
Rank: None

Neckless Serpent was seen across the world in various forms, the Elitsyians called it the Black Brocken that could eat ships and rip apart islands. This serpent was so long that its dead skin made the oceans floors. Nuni killed it and used its teeth to protect the world from the demons of Es; its skin was turned into the veil that separated the heavens, hell, and Earth. From its blood drew the rivers, oceans, streams, and lakes.

name: Si’unduru
description:
Rank: Creator Deity
Note: opruma

Si'unduru, opruma was the unified all powerful deity that created all things, it founded Elitsyian Mythology and was spoken of by the Islands of Lostasia and with the Elitsyians as the original force that existed before even Anka. It was the nothingness and throughout time it would take 20 different forms in the shape of male and female gods. Si'unduru, opruma means “all important fathers of all” and its name was given by the first original settlers that founded Lostasia and later the Islands of Lostasia. These people were believed to have been uncivilized cavemen.

name: Anthrita
description:
Rank: Goddess of Childbirth, Motherhood, & Fertility

Anthrita was a spider looking goddess and one of the 20 forms of Si'unduru, opruma that married Nuni and gave guided mothers into childbirth and protected spiders and all insects.

name: Apushra
description:
Rank: Goddess and Commander over Water

Apushra had over 100 arms and in each held the stars. She was also a water god after assisting, Nuni in killing the Neckless Serpent by building his mighty sword. From this Apushra took over the oceans and seas and named Goddess and Commander over water. She hid in the Indian Ocean and took home in the many seas, lakes, and rivers of the world.

name: Barwata
description:
Rank: Mortal King of West Island

Barwata the 15th form of Si'unduru,opruma appeared in the book, The Lost Adventures as somewhat of a naive king from the West Island. The book said that once the king fell in love with a beautiful maiden and after knowing the maiden was a snake witch in disguised, he still remain in love. The snake witch bit him and he died of poison. His spirit cast to Hell for his ignorance. This was one of the only mortal forms of Si'unduru,opruma.

name: Casa
description:
Rank: Chief commander of the Rosh Empire

Casa was the form of Si'unduru,opruma and served as Chief commander of the Rosh Empire, a group of farmers who tried to take over the kingdom of the Western Island. When the farmers took control they appointed Casa with the vile of immortality and she shared it with her farmers transforming them into immortal gods. Casa sits on a white sea surrounded by floating orbs, she could pass through realms at ease, and she is recognized as a Warrior Goddess.

name: Vaginarah
description:
Rank: Supreme Deity

Viginarah the half phoenix and half man were godly enough to be called supreme deity. Depicted as to have 8 wings and 7 tails that are the rainbow, Viginarah another form of Si'unduru, opruma could heal, speak in all languages, and carried the spirits of his other forms on his back so they can all become one at the top of the tallest mountain. Viginarah was associated with great wisdom and incredible strength.

name: Juatamumu
description:
Rank: Prince of the Northern Island

Juatamumu was prince of the Northern Island; he learned of his peoples suffering from being poor and granted them safe passage to a mysterious city just beyond the walls that sheltered the island from intruders. In this city was the treasure of the world and food for the immortals. Juatamumu was one of two only mortal forms of Si'unduru,opruma.

name: Monk
description:
Rank: Father of the Monks

Monk gave birth to the first monk that took his name; he was the 10th form of Si'unduru, opruma and would invent religion and sacrifice. His first priority was to save his children the monks from an evil reign of demons that took mortal forms. Staggering over the lost of some of his children, Monk created eternity and allowed his children safe passage to enjoy the afterlife; he gave them loads of food, beautiful gardens, and built temples for them to sleep.

name: Hindum
description:
Rank: Supreme God

Hindum was the original supreme god who became a fish so he could sleep in peace beneath the waters. He was once God of battle, storms, all sea life, and the Sun. One of the less important forms of Si'unduru,opruma.

name: Foe
description:
Rank: War God of the Southern Islands & Father of the Ware

Foe could not resist a fight; he fought trees, plants, other gods, animals, air itself, and humans. Although fare and shed his abilities to make equal fights out of his opponents, Foe was not very sensible. It would be at once that Si'unduru,opruma swallowed him in hopes give birth to a more pleasant boy. But like all instances, he returned the same this an immortal and form of Si'unduru,opruma so he also had mounts of his powers. Foe was closely and in almost all expects the War God to the people of the Southern Islands. His children were the Ware.

name: Title
description:
Rank: Chariot driver of the Gods

Title was chariot driver of the gods and from his temple found on the Eastern Island, he built many weapons and constructed armor for his brethren. He was another form to Si'unduru,opruma and when ask why the mighty deity took this such unimportant form, Title replied “it was not my choice that I appear this way, my original state decided to come back to this world lesser than before to learn of the ways of the people who he rule”. This was token from a page found in the Black Fire Scriptures, a book that told of the many forms of Si'unduru,opruma and their adventures. He was the 7th form to appear on Earth.

name: Karuts
description:
Rank: Creator of Storms

Karuts were children that played so loudly in the heavens that they made rain and brought crackling thunderstorms. Their laughter can be heard in the dreams of children and mothers.

name: Tequinique
description:
Rank: Goddess of Good Luck, Abundance, Beauty, & Honor

Tequinique goddess of good luck, abundance, beauty, and honor ship graced the world with books of love called the Irontones. These books were so big that it took years to read only one page. One of the final pages told of how Tequinique would reveal a sacred valley feel with beautiful terrains, love, and rivers of pure water. People throughout history had read the books and past down what they read to their children and so forth so that one day a generation would finally find this place. Tequinique was the first writer and author, her book the Irontones was rewritten by human hands and appeared in museums as the first class of history books.

name: Shacloom
description:
Rank: None

Shacloom took the form of a golden swan to interests the army of the castle that guards the Western Island. When she returned to her normal states she slain the army and destroyed the castle. In the ashes grew serpents and snakes of which she later ruled.

name: Il
description:
Rank: Personification of Death & Healer

Il had two faces, one looked ahead of him and the other saddened looked behind him. He had a monkey like appearance and great physical attributes. Il brought disease, sickness and would later bring happiness and wealth. He was both a healer and the personification of Death. Because of his two faces many tribes told of how he also had two personalities. In one form he took as a bull and later killed the king of the Western Island where he later returning to his true form claiming the thrown. In another form he guides travelers on their journeys, guards roads and castles. In his last form he is a pottery maker and with his often cruel remarks he would get in fights often. He was the 4th form of Si'unduru,opruma and only appeared to mock humanity for their shifting personalities.

name: Swariviti
description:
Rank: Guardian of the Universe

Swariviti came to Earth to save it from her true form, Si'unduru,opruma after finding out that he would destroy it because of his dissatisfaction at how the world became. So she instructed the gods to build a boat big enough to fit two humans and the animals of the world. Swariviti held enormous powers and was considered guardian of the universe from her more stronger form Si'unduru,opruma. So beautiful, Swariviti rides a black swan across the milky way waiting for Si'unduru,opruma to come to Earth.

name: Robabababa
description:
Rank: Creator of Parallel Universe

Rababababa the thousand headed, two hearted, million armed, 7 legged demon was as big as the Earth and to insure mankind's death it swallowed the planet whole. Swariviti threatened the demon with death if it didn't return the Earth. Swariviti knew that Rababababa was a warning sign from Si'unduru,opruma so she built multiple universes each with a different  conflict. Scientists called this theory, Parallel Universes. So confused at to which Earth was the one he was sent to destroy, Rababababa declared war on all but after going to one world, he was slain by the humans who were all warriors that worked together, something that surprised the giant demon.

name: Bones
description:
Rank: Leader of the Undead Soldiers

Bones is a powerful soldier that used his skeleton soldiers and mummies to hold up the sky. His place is unknown but one written line was that hes the final stage of Si'unduru,opruma. Swariviti would destroy him and enslave his minions. This caused Swariviti to be the only form of Si'unduru,opruma to remain on Earth. In Lostasia bones meant “death”.

name: The 7 Goddesses of Izunukepe
description:
Rank: Wives of Kings of the Four Corner Gods

The Seven Goddesses of Izunukepe were beautiful wives of kings. In almost all stories they were the wives of the many male forms of Si'unduru,opruma. In one special story they reunited after a thousand years to guard the temple of Izunukepe until their father, Si'unduru,opruma came forth and reclaimed the world. Akekeke was wife to Rababababa and when he was killed by Swariviti she threw herself into the fires from his bones. Bunquisha was wife to Bones and through magic they gave birth to his undead army. My was so self involved with her own image that her husband, Title turned her into a spirit that lied at the bottom of the now known Nile River. Nele'pupu could speak in all languages and married Monk and gave birth to the first civilization. Ninirara was sun goddess that ruled the Earth before all else was born. From her home came her daughters, Shade, Dawn, and Cool. She was wife to Il. Tiran danced to amuse her husband Foe and to take his attention from fighting. But when it failed she threw herself into a fire. Unka was Goddess of the North Star, she guided travels to their destination and was wife to Hindum. She was worshiped on all the islands of Lostasia and in Lostasia. Although not much an important figure, Unka was very beautiful and married several great rulers of Lostasia.

name: Huan Chow
description:
Rank: City Gods

To start off the Huan Chow were City Gods who were normal guards of Emperor Chung, but once entering the underworld Chow's dead daughter who became mistress of the underworld asked them if they wanted to protect their wonderful cities and they accepted. From the heavens these gods protect, watches over, and create the cities of Chung Island. Chung Island sat somewhere northeast of Lostasia and took the image of a bluish serpent.

name: Chi Fow Chung
description:
Rank: Princess of Chung Island

Speaking of Low Chung's daughter, she was once young, cheerful, and very curious. Her intelligence was limited outside her kingdom so her curiosity easily got the best of her. One dark day, Chi Fow Chung traveled outside of the forbidden gates of her kingdom and sat north on discovery to finding out what lied beyond her captivity. Worried about his daughter, Emperor Chung sent over 100 warriors to find her, years later the warriors return with the dead body of his daughter. Crying with grief, Emperor Chung used his wiseman to contact the spirits of the afterlife, the Doa qua. To bring his daughter back from the dead. But when they denied his request, he offered them his kingdom for her safety in the afterlife. One Doa qua told Emperor Chung that if he offered his riches along with his kingdom, that they would make his daughter immortal and their queen over the underworld for a thousand years. Emperor Chung accepted and Chi Chung became empress of the underworld. Stories tell of how, Chi Chung greeted her father in his sleep to tell him of all her wonderful journeys in the afterlife and the many places that existed. Emperor Chung later told his daughter's stories of surrounding cities inspiring the first belief system of most part of Asia.

name: Doa qua
description:
Rank: Ancient Spirits

Doa qua are ancient spirits that existed before all else, they created 7 levels of existence, the Heavens, Earth and its wonders, the underworld, the Other World where spirits dwell, Hell, Kuan the home of the gods and ancient entities, and the Emperor's palace where all the emperor and his followers lived. They were eight immortals with legendary status among the Asians. When Emperor Chung came to Lostasia, his work went uninspired as the Elitsyians already had their gods and idea of the afterlife. So Emperor Chung left for the islands where he took control over one of the islands and injected his beliefs into the people that lived there. The Doa qua had great powers, they could walk across water, and they represented the many conditions of life: masculinity, femininity, age, youth, poverty, wealth, nobility, and commonness. Parts of Chung Island stated how the Doa qua while on Earth protected the Emperor hence his persuasion over them and they were protective door spirits.

name: Emperor Low un Chung
description:
Rank: King of Chung Island

Emperor Low un Chung was the king of most of Asia before the Asians broke apart and formed several smaller groups. From then on, Emperor Chung went unimportant and so he left in search of some enlightenment and understanding. While somewhere in the lower parts of the Indian Ocean near present day Australia, Emperor Chung came across the Elitsyians. He instantly tried to spread his old worship and myths onto them but the Elitsyians denied it as they already had their own belief system. Again Chung left to finally settle on one of the islands found around Lostasia. Here he conquered the island and became Emperor, he sent message to some of his old followers now living in China. The followers came to his new home presented him with gifts and stories of his beliefs to influence his new kingdom. From that moment, his followers told stories of gods, creation, the many wonderful creatures, life, and death. At the center of these myths, Emperor Chung made himself the powerful Emperor that was immortal and high supreme God that created all existence. Influence by his story, the people of the island followed him and built numerous temples, palaces, chariots, and even sacrificed to him to spare their families, lands, and to give them rain. In these stories, Emperor Chung was the God of War and patron of literature, he was born of mortal decent and became a famous warrior figure that had a red face. This story spoke of how, Chung fought numerous beasts and how he married his wife that was a demonic empress all to save his kingdom. Another story spoke of how Chung was also God of the northern star and how he guided his army to victory against the Japanese empire. Becoming more and more influenced, his people begun writing their own ideas of how the Emperor was all powerful and matched the equal status of the Chinese Jade Emperor of Chinese Mythology. Emperor Chung had several children from several mortal women and once by a man in disguise. One of his most important children, Bow Dun overthrew him and became emperor and the first Lord of Heaven. This story was so important that his people started to relate it with how Emperor Chung no longer needed by his people left in search of a new home and enlightenment. Another one of his children was Chi Chung, Mistress of the Underworld “see Chi Chung”.

name: Bow Dun
description:
Rank: Prince of Chung Island

Bow Dun the eldest son to Emperor Chung overthrew his father and took over his kingdom. He then sat out on enlightenment to better rule his people; in one of the Himalayan Mountain tops he found a Buddha and the two shared stories and secrets. Here the Buddha offered him the plum of immortality of which Bow Dun eagerly accepted and became the first Lord of the Heavens and ruler over the angels and gods.

name: Len Fuma
description:
Rank: God of All Knowing Wisdom

Len Fuma was one of the most famous philosophers of Elitsyian History. His stories however started with Chung Island and he wrote down the stories of Emperor Chung in great detail. He works were so loved by Chung's people, that they demanded more until he would write thousands of stories about history, fantasies, the gods, and the afterlife. He preached the code of ethical behavior for public and private life. He was a local officer and administers the first prime moral integrity of the district of his emperor. Len Fuma died 15 years after his most important work was discovered and later made immortal. He became God of All Knowing Wisdom and taught that people should live simple lives in harmony with nature.

name: San Kowa
description:
Rank: Ruler of the Sun

Of all of Emperor Chung's children, San Kowa was the most beautiful. He was ruler of the sun and granted wealth onto his father's people. He had gray and blond hair that lit up the day and night skies. He plucked his gray hair and balled the strands up to make the moon where he lived at night. His blond hair started to shed toward the end of the night and came forth the sun where the strands fell. San Kowa then became the “ball headed god with three eyes” because under his hair laid his third eye which could predict the future and read the auras of people. He was advisor to the gods and from the waist down he was a dragon. His mother was the dragon queen, Don Luan Mi.

name: Don Luan Mi
description:
Rank: Dragon Queen

Don Luan Mi was dragon queen. One night while in heat, she invited Emperor Chung to her palace disguised as a beautiful spirit. Don Luan Mi seduced the emperor and that night after the two made love, she gave birth to the first dragon and serpents. Her dragon sun pulled the sun and her serpent daughter created and watched the waters. Her other children were San Kowa, God of the Day and Night, and Chi Chung, Goddess and Queen of the Underworld. So disgusted for her children the dragons and serpents, Emperor Chung sent his army to destroy her children, but Don Luan Mi fought back slaying the entire army in a single moment. From this moment the vicious but loving creatures, the dragon, begun hating all humans and was intent to destroy all of mankind. Their stories shed so far west that cultures around the world started speaking of mythical dragons and serpents.

name: U Owan
description:
Rank: God of Light

U Owon was the dragon son to Don Luan Mi; he pulled the sun across the sky and was to many the God of Light and bringer of the Sun. His brother San Kowa was the God of the Sun, Moon, Day, and Night. Don Luan Mi lays eggs of magical creatures mostly dragons every winter and they hatch every summer around the time of the Chinese New Year where they are celebrated.

name: Jow hung Fat
description:
Rank: King of Hell

Jow hung Fat was King of Hell and unjust king of the Chung Island. Before Emperor Chung took control over the island, King Jow ruled. His word was so unjust that when Emperor Chung overthrew him, Jow's people followed easily and banished Jow. Jow so furious at his people and Emperor Chung fell from mortality to Hell where he ruled over its 7 levels. At his new thrown, Jow hung Fat split himself into 7 lords over Hell in which each would decide the punishments of those that came to their respected levels. It is said that Jow hung Fat himself sat the doors of Hell where he examined the register of recorded human deeds and sent their souls to either Heaven or one of the 7 levels of Hell depending on how they behaved in lives. Other stories circle around Jow hung Fat and how each ruler of Hell was indeed the several gods of Hell from the islands of Lostasia and Lostasia with Montum and Belckus being two.

name: Kwu Ku
description:
Rank: Father of the Cosmos

Kwu Ku made the universe after being bored living alone in the darkness that surrounded him. For thousands of years, Kwu Ku wondered how he came about until one day he stopped wondering and thought it best to create a place where he could share with other beings. With so many ideas in his mind, Kwu Ku cough up an egg known as the Divine Order or Creator of the Universe and from it burst out dark and light. From the light came the Heavens, Stars, and the sky. From the dark came Earth, Hell, and the grounds. He created the gods from the egg shells and molded time from its yolk. Kwu Ku became so tired from creating the universe that he fell into an eternal sleep. From what they thought was his dead body, the gods made the sun, the moon, and many of the Earth's wonders. It was stated that Emperor Chung is the direct reincarnation of Kwu Ku and or his first child.

name: The Tang Dynasty
description:
Rank: 9 All Knowing & Powerful Deities

The Tang Dynasty were 9 all knowing, incredibly strong, and all powerful deities that ruled the Heavens after Emperor Chung left to rule over mortals. Once his councilmen, these generals sought out greater intelligence and enlightenment, this would result in them becoming immortals.

name: Hu Mama
description: Hu Mama was Goddess of Mercy and patron of children. She guarded children and guided mothers before, through, and after childbirth. She brings children into life from eternity.

name: Niki Ho
description: Niki Ho was a strange heroic warrior that existed before 10 b.c.e where he defeated the dragon army of U Own. From his heroic efforts he was bestowed immortality and became the God of war and patron of literature. His manuscripts told of great wars to come and how mankind would go through obstacles and overcome them in the end. This inspired humanity so much that their center ideas took over their fears.

name: Twon Emperor
description: Twon Emperor was a lesser known emperor that was always witnessed drunk and lazy. But whenever his people were in danger or sought his wisdom, he presented to them miracles and gave great wisdom. From his works he became immortal and one of the 9 members of the Tang Dynasty.

name: Bushuitiwontha Kiwuodabuddha
description: Bushuitiwontha Kiwuodabuddha was a skilled warrior, she was so brave that her feats in her life granted her immortality after death. Once an immortal she would guard the 7 courts of Hell, here she helps the needy and suffering of the world and lead souls from the underworld to Heaven.

name: Doman Hu
description: Doman Hu were twins one represented the evil and good of the world. One could remember how Shen How stole the plums of heaven which he later return but not before turning himself into an immortal. His brother Doman Hu however was an avid reader and stayed at home in their shed in the forests. He read of enlightenment which he gained after forty years of praying and meditating.

name: Anatisu
description:
Rank: Sun, Moon, & Earth God

Anatisu was the eldest and most powerful of the rest. He was always born immortal to mortal parents who were nonetheless farmers. He was a great warrior that saved the world from the sun falling burning everything by punching it back into the skies and then with his magical lasso placing it along with the moon and stars into their positions in the sky. He was Sun, Moon, and Earth God, from his home he spanned a will that he created from soil and worm intestines that told, created, and ended the lives of all living things. He had several animal body parts and guarded each respected animal. He was God of the Sea as well building the seas and forming into what they are today. He could heal and was considered a powerful Buddha as he could heal anyone and anything from the brink of sickness and death. As well, Anatisu was a popular God of Wealth, Prosperity, and Happiness that gave good fortune to those that believed and followed him. He was worshiped as God of Work, labor, and wisdom, he invented archery, hunting, and inspired teachers and priests. From his home he also made hills, mountains, the fox, and the first winged animal and sat them loose on the world. He was supreme god that in other cultures like Japan and China he took various forms and was called by many names. The Elitsyians didn't just worship him on his home of Chung Island but as well in almost every place in Lostasia. Anatisu always was cheerful and known as the laughing Buddha and whenever he was not he slept with his dreams shared with mankind as visions. God of Agriculture and rice Anatisu gave the world many wonders but wasn't always worshiped or even seen as a good deity. One and only one story spoke out of Anatisu becoming a demonic spirit every several hundred years and when in his good state he made up for his terrific behavior he gave the world all most noticeable wonders. As a demon, it spoke that Anatisu bathe in a river and from his clothings that he placed on the ground as he bathed came the evil gods, demons, and evil of the world. While he bathe he sung songs which the lyrics gave birth to gods and mythology. His home was centered in the Heavens and one side lied Heaven and the other was Hell. His home stood as the gateway that separate living from Heaven and Hell and from it he chose where souls were to go while in the afterlife. He was also worshiped mostly again as a Buddha that protected all those that have sinned and suffers pain by cleansing their souls in a practice very much similar to Baptism. Anatisu from his pool of thought hidden in his backyard gave the gods and several other creatures immortality and gave mankind long life if they prayed to him as their only god. He was also invoked upon to protect sailors at sea and was drawn by them in ancient parts of Asia as a man seen riding on the backs of sharks and whales. The dolphin was his secretary and wrote down the history of the world on the ocean floors. To finish off his great legacy the people of Chung Island made him ultimate emperor and merged him with the idea of Emperor Chung. Finally before his ascension to the Heavens for eternity which stated the end of all things. Anatisu was God of Medicine, Food, Storms, Mt. Punukien, and Self Reflected Images. So appeased with his own image, Anatisu made mankind from his body parts, man from his penis and women from his breast and gave them the mirror to look upon their great images. He brought great storms both terrific and others brought great tragedy to pirates and sailors. To make up for the bad storms, Anatisu gave the first sailors medicine of which they passed on to cities they visited. Anatisu was worshiped greatly and to present his power, the people of Lostasia placed him high above all else and built him a palace that sat at the top of Mt. Punukien their tallest mountain that could see as far as Europe. Some say that he was King Barbus in mortal form and in this state sent hundreds to thousands of soldiers in search of food which he planted in his immortal status. The soldiers brought back food and scattered it across the world to feed world hunger. Anatisu was very beloved and in his own right could do many things and was near perfect if not for his thousand year inner sleeping demon.

name: Forms of Azu Atif
description:
Rank: None

Of the nine deities that make up Tang Dynasty, Azu Atif was creator of religions and a great warrior god. In his many forms he both protected and sometimes taunted the waking world. One form after another will be described here starting with Twan Du. Twan Du disguised as a dragon saved the world from demons, in honor his image was placed on the handles of all swords in Lostasia. Kru Dwane was worshiped also as a hero that rode on the sun with his magical lance and created the light for the once dark world. Bu was a fat god that created the Islands of Lostasia by cutting off pieces of his fat and he harden it with lavas from the Earth. Ju Ju Rath was a jaguar God that had the head of a Jaguar and a lower body of a man, he taught men how to grow rice, wear clothes, archery, hunting, and how to make fire. Sin Lac Hwa Wa was a great blacksmith that was killed by a evil huntsman, in his honor homes hold up candy skulls and at the eve of night, his spirit returns eating the skull and building gifts for the home. Riptin Aga was a nasty form represented as a serpent that brought men civilized behavior but also would eat them at the end of time if they did not follow with these behavior conducts. Kroagers are neutral spirits that the Elitsyians and the people of Chung Island believed in the sea, air, humans both alive and dead, the heavens, Hell, the underworld, and roamed the lands. They were the souls of people who were sacrificed and died violent deaths. Forms of Azu Atif, the Kroagers could appear human, animal, inanimate objects, or various things depending on their lives, their true purpose were unknown but some people believe that they could protect or destroy depending on what the person or persons do in their lives. Azu Atif was also a wizard that could do almost anything, he was considered counterpart to wizards like Merlin of Celtic Mythology and Pawang Pukat of Malayan Mythology. Azu Atif also was patron of Black Magic and Sacrificial Practices, along with having several female forms to trick the other gods. His form Dunga Ada was a evil witch that used black magic to pay off her debts and kill her family to sacrifice them to the gods for good fortune and immortality. Ru-set was a farmer who killed her husband in attempts to sell their animals to buy a boat. On this boat she would find half of the Western World including Central, South, and North America. Onru Hepth was a she demon who 3 heads spoke of Justice, War, and Lies. Each head represented their spoken diaries and each told the world of their many stories. Not to forget, Azu Atif was a wonderful world that was sent by the other gods to battle the demonic serpent, Jshu Tang to make the Earth safe again. He fought Montum in the final Battle and won and was one of the 10 gods that remained to recreate the Universe. In his remaining years now with immortality, Azu Atif would live out his days building picture like statues that told stories of the deceased members of a family. His work was so inspired that tribes begun creating similar portraits to tell the stories of the dead family members. These portraits were hung high in sight of all.

name: Jshu Tang
description:
Rank: None

Jshu Tang was the original tenth member of the Tang Dynasty but with his dark magic and evil ways he was banished to the underworld. Jshu Tang was sculpted with body parts of several animals, head of snakes, tails of dragon heads, body of a elephant, claws of a lion, fangs of a wolf, ears of a peacock, and wings of a vulture. From his blood grew poison which he placed in several animals and insects for revenge of his banishing. So powerful that the gods couldn't defeat him and so when Jshu Tang returned they fought against him in the Final Battle, Mostibik.

name: The Central Council
description:
Rank: Supreme Deities

The Central Council called by another name back then were several supreme deities who wrote down Anka's words and spread them throughout time. They looked over the rivers, suns, moons, stars, lands, and all living things. They gave birth to the Heavens and the many Hells. There were no underworlds and all living things almost never died as the Phillinias believed that all creatures had immortality. The Central Council each had heads of animals; there were 7 in all Jaguar, Lion, Tigress, Frog, Falcon, and Snake. The Snake took over the many Hells, Jaguar was the Moon God, Lion was the Sun God, Tigress was the Goddess of Wisdom, Hunting, Prosperity, Civilization, and Life, Frog was the Sea God, and Falcon ruled the skies.

name: Demons of Darqua Island
description:
Rank: Underworld creatures of Darqua Island

In the midst of everything several creatures taunted mankind. The Cublicon was a mountain giant that once swallowed the suns putting the world in complete darkness, he was slain by Jaguar and the suns returned. Hodrinix was a bat with female human features, she was afraid of the light and stayed in Hell where she sent her half human half bat children “vampires” above ground to bring back food “any living thing”. The Phillinias thought of a way to stop her children by creating several weapons and placing them on their weak points “their hearts”. Umon hated all things and fearful of his black magic, the Phillinias made gold spears and placed them on their doors before midnight which was his strongest hour. Umon was a patron of War, Famine, Destruction, and creator of storms. A God of all these things, Umon went unmatched and would later rule over all the gods. Dugawugawugawu had a thousand faces and millions of arms and over hundred brains. It was so smart that not even the gods could outwit it, it lived deep in the caverns of Humla Mountain where it created the aged old book of Prophecies. Dugawugawugawu was a blood thirsty demon that arose from heaven and gave birth to all monsters, one fateful day, Lion slain the beasts and turned its many heads into the lands, its arms were bridges connecting them all, and its brains given to humans as their brains.

name: Hosempta-anus
description:
Rank: 4 Gods of the Dead

Hosempta-anus was several patrons of the dead and war. Over a thousand in all the most important were the 4 Gods of the dead and the Underworld. Ucha was a evil hag that controlled the dark forces and wore a dress made of snakes with a tail of a serpent, she ruled over the dead and taunt them every night. Munka was a deadly but very king giant that laughter caused earthquakes and deadly storms. Munka was the forefather of the Hosempta-anus and loved to play sports which he taught to mankind. Unjsha was the Time God who restored the world after it was ate by Dugawugawugawu. Unjsha had a wife, Dinga who together ruled over the center of the Earth. Frits were spirits that played tricks on the gods, in punishment, the Frits were banished to Hell were they became the first demons. Dinga was parent of the Frits and wife to Unjsha, she brought light to the world in efforts to gain peace her family and the gods after her children were banished.

name: Ellardia
description:
Rank: Mother of the Hydra & Serpent

Ellardia was the Mother of the Hydra and Serpent. She had the lower body of a poisonous serpent and the upper body of a beautiful woman with 8 heads each a different animal. Each animal she depicted she gave birth to and from them came 8 civilizations of humans. Each civilization was given a piece of land and each land was a different continent with the 8th one being Lostasia and its surrounding islands. To protect her civilizations, Ellardia threw a sword into the sea and out swum 2,400 heroes.

name: Asteta
description:
Rank: Ancient Spirit of the Future

Asteta was the most ancient of ancient spirits and she existed so far in the future that she saw the destruction of the world. Asteta came to the past to warn the world of its impending future. Asteta was dressed in fine leather and had metal placements around the edges of her body. Her bodyguards were made of metal and futuristic gadgets. Some believe that her knowledge of the future and its gifts inspired the people of Atlantis to build their magnificent technological devices and buildings.

name: Apuphu & Tresseru
description:
Rank: Creator of all living things

Apuphu along with Tresseru created all living things although it took those about 30,000 years to complete. Apuphu and Tresseru both protected the Sun and the Moon and created them from the sea and the Earth. They were also the God of Pleasure, Sin, Rain Gods, and supreme protectors of the paradises found in Heaven. Supreme deities, Apuphu and Tresseru were so powerful that they created Fenrita “a place for slain warriors in battle and women who died in childbirth” and placed it in the center of Heaven.

name: J & Aspol
description:
Rank: God/Goddess of the Four Chapters, Fire, Time, & Fertility

J and Aspol were both Gods and Goddesses of the Four Chapters, Fire, Time, and Fertility. They are aspects of the creator warriors, Trickamutu and Frunrock and were placed at the center of the world forever watching over it and controlling the elements through the trees and the wind.

name: Deitus
description:
Rank: Devourer of Worlds

Deitus was a monster bird that devoured the world at the end of time and from its stomach came the warriors, Trickamutu and Frunrock who killed the beast and recreated the world.

name: Trickamutu & Frunrock
description:
Rank: Two Heroes of the last Earth

Trickamutu and Frunrock were two heroes of the last Earth that was swallowed by the bird Deitus. From the inside they built the mighty Kumlah Sword “it can kill immortals and demons” and killed Deitus. From its caucus they recreated the world.

name: Aspel
description:
Rank: Goddess of Flowers, Beauty, & Physical Love

Aspel was Aspol's wife and daughter. She was Goddess of Flowers, Beauty, and Physical Love. She is patron of silversmiths, sculptors, painters, and fishermen. She had the head of a cat. Every 100 years the Muonch People revives their time cycle by sacrificing a virgin and placing a sacred bowl of snake's skin and lit with the fire brought from the god’s ages ago. Aspel is worshiped at this ceremony.

name: Daughta
description:
Rank: Mother of All

Daughta was the daughter and mother of all. She was a dog shaped goddess with a big black nose that was considered the forever spinning black hole. She was Goddess of the Merchants, she was killed by one of her merchants which stabbed her with a rock from the sea. The rocks from the sea are said to be lethal to the gods of the land. Born a mortal from sea fairing people, she died at sea after drowning. She was then reborn after her parents sacrificed their lives to the seas for her safe return. From this Daughta flooded the world and remade the lands from rocks allowing the spirits and gods to not step foot upon it and then remade man kind from melted clay.

name: Whurashain Gods
description:
Rank: Gods of Whurasha

There were several warriors who were either treated like gods, spirits, or great warriors that saved the world. They were apart of the Nardian Kingdom. To start Arvata was a great leader and led his Tibetchian army against the great Lions and Vultures. Arvata was later killed and his spirit founded the underworld and from their he released the spirits of great warriors and led his army once again against the Great Lions and Vultures where they then defeated the Lions and Vultures. The Lions and Vultures while in the underworld enslaved all things there and took control over various parts. They became the high rulers over the Underworld and Hell. Arvata then became ruler over the Nardaians. Arboth and Emenson were two magicians who magic felled them often. A team who performed for armies of both the dead and the living. Their magic created the people of today by reviving their ancestors from the dead and reshaping their bodies into current appearances. The Wareins (Amazons) were highly worshiped in Nardia. They were skilled women who were either great fighters or spirits who protected women and children. Amazon warriors were powerful enough to overthrow the gods, a feat that drove the immortals underground forever. The Amazon spirits were spirits that protected, guided, and fought alongside women and children.  Tilaneid was the first man and ruled all things, but when the first woman was born she stole his power and killed him after giving her a child. From his bones, she used magical tricks to create the first civilization. Tawatcha “birth mother” was the first woman. She was the hero of the Nardaians, she brought her people the fires and sacred waters from Heaven to Earth. She taught animals how to survive believing them to one day become her protectors. Himtowa was a gifted warrior who killed the powerful Frog spirit and stole daylight and nighttime from the spirit and gave it to people. Silidie, Cromich, Alligator, and Who Who were all spirits of people who died at one time, they were brought back to life to still the sun, moon, and stars from the gods and gave it to the world. These four warriors used magical tricks to make the Earth, sky, and animals. They built communities everywhere they went and told mankind how to worship the spirits and to survive. They made clothing, temples, and they brought rain when ever angered or sleepy.

name: The Wareins
description: Note: Amazons

name: Chinbuca & Dachue
description:
Rank: God of Laborers & Merchants and Protector of Crops

Laborers built stone spears and placed them in a pattern that if seen from the sky would resemble crop circles. They then invoke the assistance of the gods, one in particular was the god, Chinbuca, the God of Laborers and Merchants. Chinbuca assisted in the formation of most of the island of Whurasha. Dachue was the mother imp, a goddess worshiped on by those who followed her teachings of witchcraft. Dachue was protector of crops, guide to the Atlantians, protector, and she created their new beautiful world for them. When the the gods from Elitsyian Mythology started to take away their law over the island, Dachue gave birth to several new deities.

name: Nerekka
description:
Rank: Creator God

Nerekko was the creator god who's body was made entirely of crystals and iron. His brain was the world and it lied the 7 chambers in which civilizations were built on. Whenever angered rainstorms came and from his mind he constructed the other gods and mankind from his bones. He filled the world with his blood to make the rivers, streams, seas, and oceans. He made the plants and told his sons to name them and tell mankind which ones to eat, use for medicine, and for other reasons.

name: Dail & Uko Dail
description:
Rank: Twin Farmers

Dail and Uko Dail were twins who each took the high lands and the low lands spreading word to mankind of which plants were to be used for what. They named all things, from the mountains, hills, plants, humans, and animals. He brought the names of men to them when they were born.

name: Supreme Gods of the Islands of Lostazia
description:
Rank: Supreme Gods

The many supreme gods worshiped on the Islands of Lostasia varies with importance and some predate others. But none were less important that the Atlantians belief of their creators. Because you see, the Atlantians were scientists so they didn't really need an explanation of gods and creation through myths as they studied rocks and the way the world moves to determine how things were created. But of the most skeptic, a few gods were imagined. They were Taki and Tumone who were two chieftains who persuaded the land animals who were called the Onduris to give up their lands. The Onduris conquered Taki and Tumone and enslaved them both. Taki and Tumone escaped and later founded three tribes, the Uchawatis, the Ics, and the Resumes. Of these three came three other supreme deities after Taki and Tumone left in search of other lands. Mucaramdan was supreme deity that created the lands of the Uchawatis and with their help he made grain, animals, and invented magic to guard them. Omedian was supreme deity of the Ics and one day when Omedian thought his people deserved a better life than living under stars for eternity in silence. He created from the seas, the sun, moon, and stars. He then created rock like people and placed them around the Ics to make multiple civilizations. He brought the rock people to life and ordered them to worship him as their first and only supreme deity. Cipia, Doward, and Dug were the three sisters who settled in the city of the Resumes and later overruled them. Through their magic they became supreme deities and founded over 10 cities found in Whurasha. Doward found no luck in finding a new city to make just her own so she made one out of children toys which in return was made of rock, clay, and straw. She used the fallen straws to make the people and then ruled over these small people and their toy city of clay and rock. Cipia founded three cities, Uta, Howae', and Mune. Of the three Cipia gave birth to two warriors, the Patheons of which saved the world over and over from demonic animal spirits. The Patheons later founded the city of the Mukkukku People called Sune. Dug was also lucky and founded the city Hisar and from this city she ruled in supreme but she was very arrogant and her people banished her with spells and charms inside a mountain to spend eternity in stone. OF all these supreme deities, Ramadan, Culan, Siki, and Oprid founded several cities of which they served as the storm gods who protested against damaging the lands, love gods who talked against adultery, they taught of civilized arts and gave them to man, and they represented the moon and the sun. Ramadan was a prince given immortality by animal spirits to walk among man as their teacher and historian. Culan traveled all over claiming unnamed tribes as his own and served as their supreme deity and sometimes their sun god as the sun was his home. Siki was a snow and storm god that was so angry at the cities he founded because of their damage to nearby forests that he flooded all of them and from hidden holes in the grounds that had latched doors on tops the people were saved. From the rebirth of their cities came unusual plants and fruit that granted magical abilities, the ability to heal, and the mysterious bread that stopped all hunger, pain, and sorrow. Oprid the final deity to claim the final five cities of the Atlantians. He wasn't very smart and wore dresses of reflective metals and sequence diamonds. From his dress the sun shined its rays on him and he was quickly worshiped as son to the Sun. In other stories he was a legendary hero that protected cities from evil animal spirits and the crystal people of Tuna.

name: Tuna
description:
Rank: Crystal People

Tuna were crystal people who ran to the undergrounds to hide from the world being flooded. When they arrive above ground they were so furious that they learned the first teachings of black magic and became the evil animal spirits. Their children became both good and evil animal spirits of Whurasha legend. These people in their previous lives invented many plants that the gods never knew about and flooded the world in hopes to hide their precious secrets. The gods in return were so angry that they ran the crystal people underground where they lived for centuries.

name: The Suderians
description:
Rank: High Deities

The Suderians were high deities that used weapons made of rock and wood to rule the heavens. They were sun, moon, and creator gods that gave life and energy to all things in the universe. The Suderians were also thunder and rain gods.

name: The Imprees
description:
Rank: Sky Warriors

The Imprees were several warriors sent from the skies and grounds and had power over the elements. They were sent from the Heavens and from there they brought the first people from the Heavens and with them came the trickster that had all power and from the first tree trunk came the many people that associates with nature.

name: Untguard
description:
Rank: Supreme God

Untguard was supreme god, he was as old as time itself and from nothingness this deity rose up and everywhere he turned came the stars and planets. From his sweat and tears of building the universe came the first man and woman. With his new creations, he gave them a brain made of mud and organs made of roots from trees and soft rocks. Untguard ruled over all things, his body was the ground, his urine the rivers, oceans, and seas, and his liver the Earth's core. His heart was home to his children and from his hair the sky. His eyebrows were the protective gates that guarded the Earth from demonic creatures that spawned from his sperm. His anus was tunnel to the underworld and from his fingernails lied 10 realms in which formed the universe. Shortly after creating the Earth and the first man and woman, Untguard started to create the gods to watch and guide over his children. He built a house made of straw, bricks, and wood all carved from his world to produce the kingdom in which the gods lived. He then named this place Guardia.

name: Inka
description:
Rank: Mother of All Animals

Inka was supreme Mother of All Animals, every time she spit a new animal came to the Earth. On the rivers of the Earth she made home for each animal until animals learn how to walk on land of then she gave them temples made of rock and trees. Inka was beloved creator and animals preyed to her for protection and guidance.

name: Arcalite
description:
Rank: Mother of the Wareins (Amazons), Goddess of Concord, Dispute, Inner Strength, & Harmony

Arcalite was mother to the Arcalites, from her name came theirs as a group. She was strong and also the mother to the Wareins (Amazons). Upon her birth, Born' adored her so much he granted the once mortal baby immortality and gave her a place in silence next to him. But knowing her place was with humans, she left and disguised herself with magical armor that shielded her from Born's sight. Arcalite then used her immortality to give birth to the Arcalites and create a place called Misearth to train warriors who were killed in battle for the Final Battle. Until Mostibik, warriors drunk, sing, dance, and have a good time while battling at the break of dawn. Arcalite was honored by warriors everywhere and called upon whenever someone requested inner and outer strength. She was the warrior's voice and guided them into and out of battle safely. Once wife to Nextis, the Elitsyians associated her with war and dispute. Arcalite was Goddess of Warriors, Dispute, and Warfare. While in the underworld looking for the Key of Humanity to save mankind at Mostibik, Arcalite met Montum and the two consorted and gave birth to the first phoenix. Shortly after, she left the underworld unbound by its law, and rejoined her children in Misearth.

name: Ashitori
description:
Rank: Animal Spirits

Ashitori or Animal Spirits were watchful spirits that roam the world. When Untguard flooded the world in hopes to cleanse his creation from evil, the animals built a temple beneath the ground to shield themselves. It would then take two of each animal to repopulate the world. From their furs and shedding skins came the new human race.

name: Giranton
description:
Rank: None

Giranton was eldest son to Untguard next to the first man. Giranton was born full grown from Untguard's stomach and with him carrying the sword of a thousand demons. With this sword he slew a thousand demons that threaten the safety of Earth. He watches over all plant life and from his body hair he grew the first farmers and insects.

name: Elements of Marnia
description:
Rank: Spirits of the Elements

The Elements of Marnia were several spirits that represented the elements. Earth, Fire, Water, Air, Wood, Metal, and Space are all children of Giranton formed from the ground to help balance the world. Seen as beautiful women and men with several features that connected to their own respective elements.

Air was youngest of all and with his winged chariot that was pulled by two wind spirits; he carried the Sun across at dawn and the moon across at night. He was both Sun and Moon God and had a crown with jewels that were the sun and moon atop his forehead. From his navel he sat the sun and moon to rest when the day and or night was over. Air was husband to Siguntha and son to Giranton.

name: Earth Spirit
description:
Rank: War Goddess

Earth sprouted from the ground fully armored and given the title as War Goddess because of her anger. Always brute and disruptive, Earth also called Terra by many cultures even the Greeks, is very war minded usually seen planning strategical war plans. Earth or Terra had a chariot made of rock and diamond led by two hound dogs with wings made of ice.

name: Water Spirit
description:
Rank: Mother of the Seas

Water was Mother of the Seas and all sea life. Her kingdom floated above her sacred lake “the only lake on Memorai Island” and it watched in secret over all things. She was second to Untguard and for many years served as his wife.

name: Kiuntiwon
description:
Rank: Weapon Makers for the Gods
Note: Puath, & Georgh

The Changing Kings were three drunken priests who were worshiped on the mainlands of Lostasia as the gods who made weapons for the Royal Circa. But because of their tarnished behaviors, these deities were driving off the main island into the forests of Ice Island where they became three sorcerers. Their black magic are so powerful that together lifted Ice Island from its place and sent it towards the icy tundra of Antarctica in rebellion of its people revolting them like the Elitsyians. The kings were Kiuntiwon, Puath, and Georgh and each would later rule over separate domains of the Black Forests.

name: Neiflife
description:
Rank: Sacred Moon Beast

Neiflife was the sacred Moon beast that swallowed the moon during the day and spit it up when the sun went down. From its urine came chunks of the Sun which it pasted back together with its saliva making it brighter than before. The sun is then carried off across the dark sky to bring daytime.

name: Metal Spirit
description:
Rank: God of Wisdom

Metal was hardworking and thus carried such the title in the Heavens. He was God of Wisdom and from his book of Life upon came the Heavens and Hell and the angels and demons. To balance all things, Metal sleeps in the middle of life and death which both sleep at both ends of his kingdom, Eternity. Metal was eldest of the other spirits and was to the Memorains the God of Wisdom, the Crafts, Metal, Labor, and Justice.

name: Medruka
description:
Rank: Dark Queen of Magic

Medruka is the Dark Queen of Magic; she brought forth sacred creatures from the underworld and ruled over them. She sight on controlling the Black Forests with them. Stories were sung since her arrival of how her 5 sons would overthrow her and her 5 daughters would remain by her side to help her remain in control. The battle of good and evil would later be destroyed when Medruka went to the dark side so she could be strong enough to overthrow her sons.

name: Fennious
description:
Rank: Father of the Shadows & Demons

Fennious is Father of the Shadows and Demons, his mother is Medruka and with his goal to overthrow her he sends his many children from his kingdom “the underworld” to attack her. But because of her powerful magic his plans are ruined and he is banished to Hell. Now his children lurk through the darkness spying on ways to revive their father.

name: Harnia
description:
Rank: Fairy Godmother

Harnia is a fairy godmother and from her comes to magic of many fairies. She was the first Fairy godmother and daughter of the first fairy. With grace and magic this enchanting creature takes shape among mortals only if they have the power to assist her with stopping her brothers and mother. Under her guidance she led the Elysian Fairies into many of their journeys and from her came their magical powers. She is headmistress of Purnog.

name: Gartenhielm
description:
Rank: Father of the Giants

Gartenhielm was father of the giants that ruled over parts of the Black Forest. He would marry a giant made of stone, Frenria and together they would house 20 powerful giants that roam the black forests.

name: Gypsy
description:
Rank: Magical Maidens

Gypsy is magical women who control the powers over the Earth. Maidens who gave their hearts to the gods, Gypsies are both evil and good and from their homes they tend to nature and planted magical herbs.

name: 20 Giants of the Black Forest
description:
Rank: None

The 20 Giants of the Black Forest was Roe “fire giant”, Ova “water giant”, Sat “wind giant”, Shubu “rock giant”, Dondon “snake giant that wrapped around the world”, and Tin “cloud giant”. Tin made the clouds that floated over Ice Island and Ova lived deep within the waters protecting sailors. Shubu gave birth to rocks and stones and Dondon wrapped around the world and was destined to destroy it at the end of time.  Noticluheilm “eldest of all else, wiseman, prophet”, Zacomiam “ice giant”, Guglum “sand giant”, Holom “forest giant”, Lokin “trickster and prankster giant”, and Lunus “moon giant”. Lunus carried the sun across the sky and swallowed it each night so that her brother could carry the sun across the sky in the daytime. Zacomiam was faithful to his mother but hated all else and Noticluheilm foresaw the destruction of the world so he raced to conquer all before all is destroyed. Humore “sun giant”, Deper “music giant”, Evil “shadow giant”, Mix “shape shifting giant”, Prodicktare “metal giant”, Runt “giant troll”, and Dinomere “giant bear like creature”. Humore brought the sun across the sky after his sister took the moon and Deper sung songs of warriors slain in war. Evil existed before all else and created the Black Forests to house his family. Dinomere was a bear like creature that roamed the Black Forests eating the skin of other living beings. Mix could take any form and Runt was Father of Trolls. The final three giants were the mischievous triplets that guarded the Grail of Fate. The magical grail could see into the future and with it the holder could control other's destinies. Given to the Ratifikies, the grail with the blood of Noticluheilm could also decide the beginning and end of the life of individuals.

name: Waywards
description:
Rank: Ancient wolves

Waywards are ancient wolves that the Iku legends described as mischievous and even demonic creatures of the underworld. Never to hunt in packs like wolves of modern age, the Wawywards only came together at battle or feasting. Originally warriors cursed by the blood of the first werewolf, these demonic spirits take corporal form when hungry or the full moon.

name: Sintos
description:
Rank: King of the Dwarves

Sintos was King of the Dwarves, from his beard sprout forth the first legion of dwarves fully clothed building armory. Like his children he builds great and sometimes magical treasures. Usually taller than the average dwarf, Sintos was by far more powerful as his skin was like unbreakable marble. Sintos lived deep in the northern part of the Black Forest.

name: Kinduwa
description:
Rank: Elysian version of Dwarves

Ancient beings of various heights but similar appearances, they are usually hardworking individuals with a traditional lifestyle. With their prescense in the Elysian myths they are for the most part servants to kings and or the gods. They are usually the enemies to the Fairfolk “fairies”.

name: The Nomael
description:
Rank: Collective Deities of the Black Forests

The NomaeI were a collective all known and well respected beings. Worshiped by good and bad creatures in the Black Forests, the NomaeI existed before all else and brought forth the Black Forests so the magical creatures could exist in silence away from mankind. But when the magical veil that protected the two worlds failed, the NomaeI retreated to the Heavens to go unseen by mortals.

name: The White Parrot
description:
Rank: Father to all bird creatures

The White Parrot was father to all bird creatures, he made wings from dead leaves, his magical spells is sought out throughout all of Black Forest. His memory is worthy of that of a god, he grants immortality to those who can predict his next move which is never anything twice and upon the decease tombs he lays magical eggs. Only to those who were warriors or royalty in life would receive magical eggs to give them luck in the afterlife.

name: The Dofties
description:
Rank: Demonic Spirits

The Dofties were demonic spirits that ate spirits and stole daylight.  Often referred to as Bad Luck wherever these creatures went bad luck followed. They taunt humans and live throughout the world as various creatures appearing almost never to anyone but themselves and residents of the Black Forests.

name: Daowine
description:
Rank: Underworld God

Daowine is the Wolf that rules over the underworld in Iku Mythology. Whenever he arrives upon the Earth, the Sun and the Moon retreat suspending everything into total darkness. Daowine brought complete drought and disease to the Black Forest killing several creatures.

name: Deruvian Angel
description:
Rank: Ascended Elf

Once an elf ascends to Helliholm, it becomes a Deruvian Angel. A being capable of immortality, enhanced speed and strength, and powers over light and nature. The Deruvian Angel has long hair that can be used as attacks and protectant shields, its armor is a mark of its honorable past life, and its weapons are big and often indestructible. The Deruvian Angel is a collection of hundreds of elfish angels that often hide in old trees and caves.

name: Fairfolk
description:
Rank: Elysian version of fairies

Thousands of small creatures of various sizes and appearances. Usually seen with wings, these creatures tend to everything including nature, dreams, fixing things “although not to the extreme as the Brukas” and they are often caretakers of animals and small children. It is believing that they were the first residents of the Black Forests and their kingdom lies on the far south near the River of Magic.

name: Lufh Bergog
description: A knight of the Fairfolk belongs to the Knights of the Triangle which devotes his life to protecting the fairy kingdom, Sertog.

name: Kindra
description: The fairy princess and next in line to inherit the fairy kingdom, Sertog. She is over 1,000 years old and haves a powerful amulet that was given to her by the Deruvian Angel.

name: Sordidad
description: The blacksmith of the fiary kingdom, Sertog. He is very tall and muscular; he contains a powerful hammer that causes earthquakes.

name: Gorgig
description: Archer of the fairies and loyal friend to Lufh. Goofy and sometimes arrogant, this playboy often uses his arrows to produce thunder.

name: Gilda
description: A fairy that provides Talent to the animals and humans of the world, she is close friend to the Selenes.

name: Crow Fairies
description: Warrior like archers that protect different fairy villages.

name: Carlu
description: Magical animals with fairy blood. They assist in various tasks for the Fairfolk. Because of their beloved natures they appear near or in almost all fairy homes.

name: Jinks
description: Knowledge fairies, they are authority over all knowledge to the fairfolk. They run the magical library in Tantirith.

name: Solution Fairies
description: Tall fairies that produce the first sign of science throughout the fairy world. They are the makers of fairy dust and provide guidance on numerous non-magical related tasks that other fairies may not know about.

name: Nature Fairies
description: Caretakers of the nature of the world. They are direct caretakers to the black trees in the Black Forests. They are dressed with leaves and wear crystals that omits magic to help in their tasks.

name: Water Fairies
description: Fairies that keeps the waters of the realms pure. They are fast and can camuflouge with water to disguise themselves. Waterdrops are their weapons as they can make them sharp or encase someone in one.

name: Fire Fairies
description: Brute and sometimes evil fairies. They provided fire to the gods and from them came the first volcanic eruption.

name: Rock Fairies
description: Caretakers of the grounds and rocks. They are decorated in rock like attire and are usually stubborn. They are very strong although lacks speed.

name: Mind Fairies
description: Powerful fairies and a dying breed. Assistance to seers and other physic entities. They are powerful enough to protect their minds against the gods.

name: Wispers
description: Silent non spoken fairies that watch guard over the Black Forest. They are incredibly fast and controls the winds. Their bodies are covered in ash and their hair are that of clouds. They produce the clouds in the sky.

name: Flower Fairies
description: They make flowers grow and keep nature in tact. They are the siblings and children at times to the Nature Fairies. When a flower is born so is one of these fairies.

name: Weather Fairies
description: Powerful fairies that produces storms across the realms. They are ill tempered but not evil. They dislike disruption and are children to Adv and Lo.

name: The Overseers
description: Elderly fairies that surpases great talents and age. They oversee different groups of fairies at a time. Often when needed they are mediators to the fairy world.

name: Shadow Fairies
description: The most popular being Griswalda. They are maleviolent fairies that produces shadows. They are tricksters and can move between worlds through shadows.

name: Flash Fairies
description: Or Light Fairies are highly worshipped fairies and enemies to the Shadow Fairies. They are kind and always smiles. With help from Con, they bring light to the world. They are his and Muda children.

name: Bishop Fairies
description: Or Ice Fairies, they are led by Golden Eil and with his guidance they are very strong and fast fairies. Carrying weapons made of ice, they are guardians of the outer Black Forest.

name: Summoning Fairies
description: Capable of summoning anything from almost anywhere, they are restricted by the laws of the Black Forest, however many have been able to overcome this law with concentration.

name: Law Fairies
description: Lawkeepers of the Black Forest and talented fairies that knows every law of every world.

name: Construction Fairies
description: Builders of the Fairfolk. They often build houses and cities with ease and in great speeds.

name: Guard Fairies
description: Guardians and warriors of the Fairfolk. Mostly women, they are fast, strong, and are always on the defensive.

name: Wand Makers
description: Fairies that makes wands for magical beings, they created the first wand with the help of Prum, their eldest leader.

name: Auma
description: The dragon fairy, she is powerful and can create a flame so strong it can burn through anything. While very young, she gets into may misheif and tries to make up for it in the end. Although very powerful, she has yet to master her powers. She is outcast to the Volcano Islands of the Black Forest where she is visited by other fairies for friendship.

name: Seibels
description:
Rank: Elysian version of Sprites

Small shiny creatures with glowing tails and long hair. They are a younger species than the Fairfolk but share many similarities in that they tend to task normally thought to be produced by humans. They unlike the Brukas “brownies” doesn’t build things, they instead tend to more natural substances like healing and the human body.

name: Leprechauns
description:
Rank: Similar to their Irish versions

Similar to their Irish counterparts in the only exception that they are usually not associated with rainbows nor gold. They mine silver and can be spotted near massive amounts of silver. It is believed that their homelands are made of pure silver with diamond encrusted bridges leading to other worlds which they can access with their spiral like weapons. Although not fighters, these fast creatures appear as men with armor.

name: Brukas
description:
Rank: Elysian version of Brownies

Small creatures covered in fur, has pointy hats, and large flat shoes. They assist in homes and prefers to go unseen by human eyes. They talk amongst each other and only ask from those they assist to leave food for their work. In ancient times, these creatures can clean a space in what appears to be a blink of an eye.

name: Jack O’ Lantern
description:
Rank: God of Halloween and Sweet Treats

Born from a pumpkin during the 31st of October, this deity uses his flashing staff to play pranks on others and his laughter can be heard during the dreams of those he taunts. Although not evil, Jack possesses many evilish characteristics that can be described as a maloviolent spirit. He appears in a youthful form with a black and white outfit with pumpkin like faces decorating it. His hair is silver and spikey containing pixie dust. He is half pixie and has traces of possibily being a adult pixie.

name: Pixie
description:
Rank: Youthful spirits that entertain children

Popular amongst young girls and sometimes boys. These spirits appear during the youth of a child that once appeared to them as sad and neglected. Always youthful and joyish, these creatures influence causes children to become happier in youth and to grow into fine adults. Once someone grows up, they are no longer able to see these beings. The main power of the Pixies is to keep balance in someone’s life. Doing so with pixiedust which was granted to them by the Fairfolk.

name: Sguise
description:
Rank: Elysian version of a Tooth Fairy

Usually seen as women, few male Squise have also been seen.  Worshipped by the ancient Elitsyians believing them to come at night to take mortal teeth as a present for themselves, while leaving behind coins or jewelry. Teeth have been rumored to be of great substance to them, even providing them with power stronger than many fairies.

name: Kookoo Cree
description:
Rank: Elysian version of a Bugbear

A weird creature that uses its long antennae to create illusions across vast lands. Its appearance is different than its counterpart however its fable is similar that it scared disobedient children and ate them if they didn’t listen to their parents by their 10th birthday.

name: Elysian Goblin
description:
Rank: Elysian version of the hobgoblin

Greenish orange creatures with scary faces and loud screechy voices. They are so intimidating that people-built statues to honor them just to keep them pleased. When it didn’t work, they left traps for them in the appearance of a cat which the creatures loved to eat.

name: Elysian Elves
description:
Rank: Elysian version of the elves

Elves are a race of millions that spans across numerous realms. So far that they have managed to live for thousands of years and fought numerous battles including against their enemies the Kinduwa. With limited magical powers given to them from the gods over the Black Forest, they have been blessed with protective armor, magical weapons, and great intelligence for their constant fight on the side of the High Council against demons. Elves are seen as tall beings that are protective against magic and they live high in the mountains away from others and take a royal figure over the Black Forest, so much that others fear them. During the Great War, many elves were transformed into Spell Creatures and their memories of anything other than their current nature has been removed. They since took on various names, types, and abilities.

name: Persung
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of the Persi

The Elitsyian version of the Persian Persi. They are beautiful half humanoid, half angel. When the first humans interacted with fallen angels, several humans mated with them, thus giving birth to the Persi. Their kind disappeared into the Black Forest where they now serve as mythological angels and guides to the fairies.

name: Tier Authority Unit
description:
Rank: Highest Authority of Tier under the Royal Family
Note: TAU

name: Tier Authority Unit or TAU
description: Are a collection of authority figures that govern the actions of various laws throughout Tier. Started by the Domi Mages, they are high officials who respond to the orders of the High Council. Mostly considered policemen. They can vary between office clerks, detectives, school officials, flight governors, and Detectors.

name: Sea Guards
description:
Rank: Varies

Skilled elf like warriors tasked with protecting Tier’s seas from disasters and threats. Each country of Tier and throughout the Magical Community has their own version of the Sea Guard.

name: Ocean Task Force
description:
Rank: Varies
Note: OTF

Hard attitude warriors with a varied ability. They exists to protect the magical communities’ oceans from threats and disasters. A subdivision was created three hundred years after their first organization was created called the Sea Guards. They can be seen with blue and golden armor with fin like weapons and powers given to them by the god, Chrochen.

name: Land Runners
description:
Rank: Varies

Protectors of the lands of Tier, they have various subdivisions for protecting different aspects of the world. So much so, it is hard to pinpoint a central chain of command other than TAU. Each country in Tier, has their own task force for the purpose of protecting their landforms.

name: House Pets
description:
Rank: None

Numerous creatures that can be tamed easily or by spells. Some pets can talk and even change shape.

name: Flight Governors
description:
Rank: 2nd Rank

Under the official Governors, they are weird looking creatures who have big hands. The rings on their fingers can detect teleportation regardless of who is doing it. They received their rings directly from the High Council. Each FG has their section.

name: Peacekeepers
description:
Rank: 1st Rank

Law makers and advance policemen. Hated by such, they abide by the law at all costs. They are rarely seen unless when a great tragedy is made.

name: Detectives
description:
Rank: 3rd Rank

Detectives are just like their human counterparts. They are direct descendants to the original Peacekeepers who guarded Tier. They are blue creatures who are built like statues. They are smart, fast, and can see through the dark. Their skin light up when they are closed to something they are looking for.

name: Office Clerks
description:
Rank: None

Office Clerks can be found in numerous places. They come in different sizes and are usually human like beings

name: Lawyers
description:
Rank: 5th Rank

Just like their human counterpart, these usually elf and dwarf creatures are smart and fast. Greedy things that only care about winning their case at any cost.

name: Governors
description:
Rank: 1st Rank

Powerful judges who make official law commands in the name of the High Council. They are higher than lawyers and can directly challenge even the Grand Professor’s ruling on matters. They oversee numerous specialized cases.

name: Detectors
description:
Rank: None

Are cloaked creatures that can detect those teleporting. Thought to be tamed demons, these creatures are fast and cross through dimensions. First seen in The Lazarons Book 2. Unlike the Flight Governors, they act more like hunt dogs instead of their own separate unit of law enforcement.

name: Tier Police Squad
description: Rank: 7th Rank

name: Tier Police Squad or TPS
description: Are policemen and women who have specialized objects to govern the law. They wear dark blue uniforms with glowing badges. Their eyes are blue colored and their skin are marked with laws.

name: Air Guards
description:
Rank: 2nd Rank

Extremely fast mages tasked with protecting the skies at all costs. They were gifted with powers by Adv the goddess of the Skies. With their gift, the TAU created a specific unit for them, others later joined through specialized training. Their abilities include flight, enhanced speed, bird like physical armor features, enhanced sight, strength, and echo hearing.
affiliates: Land Runners; Sea Guards; Ocean Guards; Adv

name: The Forcers
description:
Rank: 4th Rank

The Forcers are a protect unit that erects barriers around popular places. It was their initial magic, that erected the barrier around the schools of Tier including Tantirith, Purnog, and Hizirinth. Kayla Lazaron joined them briefly after her graduation from Tantirith in Book 5.

name: The Cloths
description:
Rank: 5th Rank

The Cloths are an unknown force with purposes shrouded in secrecy. A task force amongst the shadow government within TAU. They are cloaked figures that have abducted infants with near death experiences believing the child would have powerful and influential magic.

name: Shadow Government of TAU
description:
Rank: 1st Rank
Note: SGTAU
