The Shadow Government of TAU is a separate entity that operates sometimes illegal missions. They were once created to stop the rise of Belckus army and Tonik’s shadow army on Earth. Once their missions were successful, they were called back to Tier to protect the government from outside threats. This allowed them to affectively serve as bodyguards to TAU.

name: Witches Council
description:
Rank: 3rd Rank

Witches Council are a group of powerful witches and warlocks that govern the rules and punishments over witches, warlocks, and their familiars. Their headquarters is in the south hall of Coldren.

name: Fairy Council
description:
Rank: 3rd Rank

Fairy Council are a magical force put together by the first fairy in an attempt to secure the laws and pass on authority to Fairies, Dwarves, Elves, Brownies, Sylkies, and other Fairfolk. They are located at the south hall of the Coldren.

name: Shadow Council
description:
Rank: 3rd Rank (1st Rank in the Shadow Realm)

The Shadow Council are a mischievous group of shadow creatures and dark magic users. They exists solely for their own purposes and to create a trade system for the Shadow Realm and other realms. They at times have shown to care for shadow creatures such as creating laws, fair trade system, starting the first city in the Shadow Realm, and even protecting the realm at numerous costs. They initially were created by Tonik before removing him for fear that they would never grow from their initial reason of creation.

name: Council of Reality
description:
Rank: 1st Rank
Note: CR

The Council of Reality is one of the most powerful sections of government next to the High Council and the Tier Authority Unit. Consisting of Gins, often called the CR, the Council of Reality are tasked with protecting reality at all costs and with a similar purpose as the First Ones, they are often linked directly with the First Ones. Their laws grant the existence of everyone to continue without outside disturbance, however they care not of inside turmoil and allow the realities to happen as they should. They created the Dimensional Guards to protect the dimensions.
affiliates: High Council; Gin; First Ones; TAU

name: Dimensional Guard
description:
Rank: 6th Rank

Suited with indestructible armor, these warrior type creatures appear humanoid, but lack personality and thoughts of their own. Created by the Council of Reality, they have, since the first dimension was created eons ago, drafted to protect all dimensions. Regardless of the infinite number of dimensional spaces created, a Dimensional Guard will appear to protect it from anyone outside of the creator of said dimension.

name: First Ones
description:
Rank: 1st Rank

First Ones are some of the most powerful and most influential figures throughout the magical community. Often called the Ancient Ones or the First Bringers, the First Ones are animorphic beings that can shapeshift to appear as innocent animals. Found at the edge of Eternity along with Olerta, they guard reality and presents it rules, laws, and ordinances. They provided the power to manipulate reality to originally lower powered mages known as Gins, thus making the Gins the most powerful race of mages.

name: Bank Elves
description:
Rank: None

Snobby creatures with dark green eyes. They are fast and has various magical powers. They can travel through objects and are known to only exist within the confines of banks throughout Tier. They can disguise themselves as anything to work inside of a bank. Including humans in a human bank. They love money but not in the greedy sense but in the sense that they feel a connection to it.

name: Veknahs
description:
Rank: None

Powerful Djiins that lives within their own dimensional space. They are a set of Djiins that were protected by the First Djinn to protect their flow of magic from those that wished to have their reality bending abilities for themselves.

name: Witch
description:
Rank: None

Mages that can manipulate magic to a degree of creating anything from thought. While abilities vary, Witches are women, while Warlocks are men and Wicklings are half warlock and half werewolf under the protection of Bewithia.

name: Shadow Fiend
description:
Rank: Shadow Creature

Shadow Fiend are powerful and dangerous beings that can control shadows and manipulate magic through thought. Once banished because of their assistance with the original Shadow Fiend, Tonik. They are known to be fast and can teleport across great distances.

name: Leviathans
description:
Rank: None

Large reality spanning serpents that appear grand even amongst the gods. Leviathans were creations of Chaos and were used to battle GOD and the Ho’zares.

name: Inir
description:
Rank: Avatar of Elshack

The last avatar of the Creation Celestials. Inir’s family was murdered by a demonic disease, when attempting to bring them back to life. His request was denied by all gods and celestial powers. In his request to revive his family, Inir began to cipher the energy that flowed throughout creation alerting the attention of every magical and supernatural being in existence. This presence also started to destroy reality, causing GOD, the Neither, and their armies to act. Called upon by Elshack and told that Inir is it’s avatar.

name: Odlem
description:
Rank: Avatar of Anka

A being of immense power that formed Eden at Anka’s request to birth and house all of creation. This being appears in the highest rank next to Anka and Elshack. It appears as both a man and a woman always appearing almost across Eden watching over its precious lands, secrets, and creation that sits within its borders. It is the only avatar of Anka.

name: Behaviors
description:
Rank: None

Horse like creatures that live and roam within the boundaries of the Imaginarium. They appear graceful and has long manes sprinkled with golden ash and they leave behind scent of honey. Behaviors take on the emotion of whomever they represent from the waking world.

name: Wizards
description:
Rank: None

Descendants of Witches. Wizards have magic known as berserk magic, which means they are naturally unable to control their abilities. To control their power, Wizards have constructed items such as wands. 75% of the wizard race lives in the Wizarding World.

name: Serene
description:
Rank: First Witch

The first witch, Serene was a powerful witch almost deity like amongst her followers. Serene’s first two children Bewithia and Xshaun are the gods of witchcraft and founders of the wiccan belief. Thanks to them they gave birth to witches, covens, warlocks, and the first spellbook.

name: Alvinda
description:
Rank: First Fairy

Powerful and beautiful. Alvinda was seen gliding often above the ground with small angelic wings from her back. Her long gown consists of flowers, petals, and grass that when it touches nature can restore it. Mother of the fairyfolk or fey, Alvinda created the entire world of the “Black Forest” to house magical creatures. With several deities and most importantly Crochen, Alvinda birthed the first mermaid and merman which together they became the earliest ancestors to the Mermadic Kingdom.

name: Varus
description:
Rank: First Hunter

Strong, agile, and strategic, Varus the first hunter was also the first soldier outside of the Archangels. His demeanor was known to be brute and yet quiet, always thinking of battles and wartime. His name is often called on during a hunter’s battle and he is preyed on during their funeral. He had a father son type relationship with the God of War Nextis shortly after the deity was born.

name: Lyus
description:
Rank: First Sorcerer

Capable of controlling all the elements, Lyus was the first Sorcerer and from him came the first sorcerer and the elements of the world were his seven children. From his involvement with a nymph, the first elemental was born. From his love with Serene, their union gave birth to Bewithia and Xshaun.

name: Yeb
description:
Rank: First Druid
Note: the Silent

The first healer and medicine man, Yeb travelled the cosmos providing healing to others. He was called upon to grant healing miracles to his brethren when the Domi Mages went to war with Tonik. From Yeb, came the druids, later shamans, and oracles.

name: Runnith
description:
Rank: First Djinn

An extremely powerful being with magic that could rival those of a god. Runnith has two forms including a male and female form with two distinct personalities. The reasoning was explained by Runnith themselves that they are two souls in one body which is the reasoning behind their powerful magic. Because of their power, Runnith’s descendants were banished, and some were trapped because of their power. The Djinn war saw the magical community turn against the Djinns which also resulted in Runnith’s death.

name: Olsinius
description:
Rank: Archimage

A powerful servant of the Domi Mages that help to create their home. He appears tall, beautiful, and has long silver hair. He takes numerous forms throughout his assistance to the Domi Mages. After their disappearance, Olsinius continues to watch over the Domi Mages’ home and attempts to bring them back to the Realm of the Living.

name: Olsinia
description:
Rank: Archimage

A young golden hair girl with galaxy altering abilities. Olsinia was commanded to create the magical community to house the descendants of the Domi Mages. She created the worlds, stars, and cloaked the solar system from our own by shrouding it in darkness.

name: Imps
description:
Rank: None

Originally small creatures seen with batwings, large fangs, high pitch screams, and mischievous personalities. Sometime before the Djiins were banished to the 5th dimensional plane, the High Imp Queen seduced a Djiin. From their forbidden affair, the queen birth an imp capable of similar reality warping abilities as a Djiin. Imps would later cause destruction across the Magical Communities, causing them to be banished to the 5th dimensional plane.

name: Kusha
description:
Rank: Queen of Imps
Note: Imp Queen

A high imp queen that grew tired of the mistreatment of her fellow imps. To fix this issue, she seduced a high djiin that together with him birth a powerful imp child. From her child, came the new race of imps that could warp reality. Her second child became the first Changling and its child became the first Shapeshifter. Her memory is seen in books and on memorials throughout the Imp Kingdom within the 5th dimensional plane.

name: Changelings
description:
Rank: None

Changelings are shapeshifters that can change into any animal or magical creature.

Shapeshifters are a type of Changeling that can only change their appearance to any known humanoid.

Burnum are Changeling that can take the shape of any inanimate object that they have seen.

name: Seer
description:
Rank: None

Seers are psychics that can sense, and more powerful ones can see auras around others. In old times, Seers were often found around an Oracle at her temple. Seers like the more powerful Oracle are descendants of the Druids.

name: Oracle
description:
Rank: None

Child to the Druid, Oracles are the most powerful psychics and have direct links to the gods. In ancient times, temples and altars were erected in their honor. The most prominent Oracle was the Oracle at the Temple of Melphi which the Greeks translated to the Temple of Delphi.

name: Agaers
description:
Rank: None

Agaers are winged children seen dressed in Christmas garments. They appear around festive holidays and are believed to be spirits that secretly accompanies Santa Claus on his journeys around the world. Although they are rarely seen by anyone that isn’t a Holiday spirit, they are heard laughing and singing when near the north pole.

name: Dennies
description:
Rank: None

Half dolphin, half child, these creatures are sweet with big eyes and long garments that covers their silk bodies. They are fast and are many to be found near the entrance of the Mermadic Kingdom. Their loud and earth-shattering cries can alert the kingdom when intruders are approaching.

name: Gypsy
description:
Rank: None

Traveling witches, Gypsies although not as powerful as their magical cousins, these individuals are often seen as beautiful humans that uses a variety of jewels and items to perform their magic. Like their cousins the Wizards, they have a form of berserk magic that causes their magic to become out of control unless sealed away. This effect causes them to be cautious of using their full magical potential.

name: Romanus Housenspell
description:
Class: Headmaster of Entire School
Hall of: Entire School

name: Grand Professor Romanus Housenspell
description: Commonly known as Grand Professor Ramanus Housenspell, he is over 600 years old and scouts for new talents to attend his school. He was once a teacher at Tantirith until he rose to become its headmaster 200 years prior. He has been in numerous wars and has assisted in numerous creations of certain spells. With his longevity he has also experience loss that many others have never imagine. Something he writes in the very coveted best selling novel. Soul Release, a 438 year old book.

name: Simon Coldstone
description:
Class: Alchemy and Science
Hall of: Chapter of Drake

name: Professor Simon Coldstone
description: A dwarf and teacher of Alchemy and Science to freshmen and sophomore. He teaches Advance Science and Potion Mastery to juniors and seniors. His classroom is similar to a cave although it is located one of the highest arches throughout Tantirith.

name: Thomas Frandrick
description: Class: School’s Pet Yard or Zoo

name: Mr. Thomas Frandrick
description: The school’s pet tamer. He keeps an eye on Tantirith’s wide assortment of pets.

name: Ms. Donna Doublestack
description: The school’s cafeteria lady. She lost most of her powers during the Great Plague of Black Magic as told in Chapter 10 of The Lazarons. Although she appears in every book of the four book series. She rarely is seen using magic aside from making lunch.

name: Allegra Mooseriver
description: Math teacher at Tantirith. Her magic isn’t mentioned in the books. However, she appears with giant horns and long Greek inspired dress. Her room is also inspired by the Greek Pathenon for its massive stone structures and pillars. At the end of the room is her desk where she sits like a giant over her students. She is about 20ft tall and is only ever seen in her classroom. She is said to live across the mountains from the school in a village made up of giants and resembles the Greek city of Athens.

name: Amedeo Rvege
description: Science teacher at Tantirith. He looks like a mix between man and a snake. His appearance has given him a distinct attribution to the school. He teaches mostly to Chapter of Shade students.

name: Anais Dynos
description: A Greek Centaur that became teacher at Tantirith. He lacks magic and was infected by the Lake Disease in the first book. He teaches Hunting & Creature Study Classes to 2nd and higher class students. He appears briefly in the first book. Major role in the second book where he falls for a female centaur teacher from Purnog after the school’s merge.

name: Calliope Morningrise
description: One of the main coordinators at Tantirith. She oversees the Tower of Drake and is one of five coordinators. She attended the school when she was a teen and left to pursue a career in Magic Compulsion before returning to teach. She is renowned for her powerful spells and instant explosion magic. At times she teaches Magic Compulsion but only to those who can use this rare form of magic like Kane.

name: Cerulean Houseriver
description: A nymph whose lower body seems like it is connected to whatever she hovers above. Rather it is the grass, water, fire, wood, etc. she can control limit powers over nature and teaches Nature Healing & World Course Study. She is mostly seen teaching to the Chapter of Eden.

name: Djuna Deveros
description: A djinn that teaches Battle Spells & Defensive Techniques to 3rd year students and higher. He is snarky and once served over 450 masters before he was let free by his last master the Grand Professor. His story is told and he appears in the 2nd Lazarons Book.

name: Dmitri Rivers
description: A tall African teacher with a distinct African accent. He appears in the 2nd book where he teaches Manipulation of the Arts class. He helps in protecting the school from the 2nd horseman at the end of the book.

name: Electra Eddrick
description: Fast talking gypsy who moved to Tantirith on a course to London. She is the longest remaining gypsy to ever come to Tantirith. She gave up her gypsy birthright to remain to teach. She teaches to fourth year students. She appears briefly in the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th books. She teaches World Influence Studies and befriends Kara.

name: Melissa Eldridge
description: A teacher at the Chapter of Eyis. She appeared during Book 1 but was killed by the horseman of Pestilence because of her constant questions about the use of Kendo. Her name isn’t mentioned until she returns as a specter enraged by her death. She kills Ms. Mindwaker. The two spirits become the first ghosts of Tower of Eyis.

name: Elia Hilton
description: Teacher apart of the Chapter of Eyis. She has strong telepathic abilities. She teaches numerous courses on Mind Reading and How to Perfect it. She named her book after her course. It has sold over 3 million copies to mind readers and others.

name: Gaia Roven
description: Leading Professor of the Chapter of Eden. She is a large plump woman with grass like hair and oily skin. Her frame has been subject for many jokes by students. She speaks with an English tongue and talks like she is the queen. Her middle name is Elizabeth named in honor of the queen of England of which she looks up to in high regard. She appears during the third book introducing the Garden Maze Course. She appears briefly again to monitor the halls of the school during Book Four.

name: Gulliver Albertons
description: A teacher of Languages at Tantirith. He is an invisible man that wraps himself up like a mummy to be seen. He was cursed by an evil sorceress in the early 18th century to never be seen by another woman. For cheating on her. He came to Tantirith with hopes to find a way to turn himself back to his normal form. He is over 300 years old and uses transformation magic throughout Book 2, 3, and the final book 4. He is a fan favorite to Kara in Book 4. He speaks with a Persian accent and is revealed in Book 2 to be a once powerful sorcerer who lost most of his magic due to his invisibility curse.

name: Ianthe Sunny
description: A meditation specialist at Tantirith. Mostly visited by third year students and higher. He can help ease any pain using various techniques.

name: Isadora Musica
description: The school’s music teacher of freshmen and sophomores. She is tall, wears a wide skirt in resemblance to a giant violin and her hair is big and blonde resembling an oddly shaped guitar.

name: Professor Barburus Hofferstack
description: Known for his bleak expressions and sarcastic undertones. He has a long black beard and wears an equally tall black wizard’s hat. One that he stole from a wizard that he calls Merl. With many believing to have been the famous wizard named Merlin. He created many dark spells that are forbidden with such he was banished at one point. Before returning saving innocent lives during the Black Plague mentioned in Book 3 using one of those very dark spells. He teaches Black Arts and Ritual Magic mostly to students at the Chapter of Shade. Rarely does anyone call him Barburus instead his brother and sister refer him to simply as BH as though many of his collegues. He along with his sister and brother speaks in a strong Russian accent.

name: Candace Hofferstack
description: Sister to Professor Hofferstack. Unlike her brother she is mostly celebrated for her teachings of White Magic. She is part of the coven of Moving Spell Casters. A group of puritans that are considered to be the worshipped group of magical beings in modern times. They have existed for nearly 700 years long before Candace joined and have went through over 840 different group changes. Candace for only Books 2 has taught White Magic. It was discovered that she was sent to Tantirith to see if her brother was behind the attacks at the school. She left knowing that it wasn’t and returned briefly in Book 4 to avenge her brother’s death by helping to vanquish the horseman of Death.

name: Daniel Hofferstack
description: Older brother to Professor Hofferstack and Candace. He is the slacker brother who once lived on top of the tallest mountain in Tier. He experiments with Ghost Magic and teaches it at Tantirith. Although the course is very hard to get in mostly because it feels up quickly. He mentions to each class that Ghost Magic is dangerous because it has few limits and can put a strain on anyone other than, well, a ghost.

name: Poe Lessondale
description: A teacher that is a skeleton. He often makes stupid jokes and cries at the sound of a dog bark. Students makes fun of him which he isn’t aware of and usually teaches from his cold and usually wet room in the dungeon of the school. He teaches Ancient History.

name: Xan Zenboo
description: Coach at Tantirith. He teaches the supernatural version of Physical Education called Battle Grounds Arcade. He is a satyr and son to a Nymph and a God. His magic of choice is defensive magic. Although he is known also for his limited telekinetic abilities. He teaches nearly all students at once who attends Tantirith how to perform what the magical world knows as Fighting Magic. Such magic consists of Lightning Throwing, Fireballs, mind blasts, and limited telekinetic abilities. Also Magic Blocking using the elbows is taught nearly too all ages at one point. He is one of the most sought out teachers in the world and one of the only satyrs in the world capable of using such powerful magic.

name: Kaatje Lazaron
description: Once a teacher at Tantirith. She originally taught Spells and Incantations. She is ancestor to Kayla, Kendo, and Kain.

name: Benny Uldridge
description: One of the original students to Tantirith. He was large about 300 pounds. He specialized in Creation Magic. Mostly to summon food. His painting hovers above the Chapter of Eden’s doorway.

name: Lisa Uldridge
description: One of the 1st teachers at Tantirith. A plump woman with large eyes and short hair. She was strong minded and very opinionated. She was very nice and moved to Tantirith when she was kicked out of her house for unknown means. She died in the school’s fifth year by the Lake Disease.

name: Kendrick Hines
description: Although known to many. Mr Hines is 1,000 years old and help build Tantirith. Throughout his years he has seen many things. Which is the reason he remains at Tantirith as one of the school’s protectors and librarian. Although he is terrible at being the latter. He befriends Kayla, Kain, and Kendo. He often thinks of them as his own children because of his close friendship with their parents.

name: Giundo
description: Various magical beings known for their enhance speed, longevity, strength, flying abilities, intelligence, and teleportation. They come in different sizes and shapes. Some are guides, while others are just watchers. They rarely speak and glows when danger is nearby. They are found at each of the five major schools of Tier.

name: Malaysia Anne Wilson
description: Able to control others with her voice. She was once a student at Tantirith. Now she is one of the school’s five coordinators. She is the coordinator to the Chapter of Eyis. Her mental abilities is widely feared across Tantirith. She shares her abilities and name with her ancestor the once Queen of Africa known as Voix. It is believed that she is the reincarnation of her ancestor through a curse cast upon her ancestor and children.

name: Professor Luis Prockintaire
description: Latin wizard with long nails and beard. He teaches Spell Writing to First Year students at Tantirith.

name: Stanley Woodenver
description: One of the school’s janitors and alumni of Purnog. Once a skilled warrior he lost all of his magical abilities. However, he retain his healing factor and is over two hundred years old. He works at Tantirith during the week and at Purnog during the Winter and Summer months.

name: Tessa Moonshine
description: A sprite that works in the auditorium. She is proud of her job and is said to live there. She speaks squeaky and hates being ignored. She is considered the coordinator to events, contests, and anything related in the auditorium. She appears during the 2nd book.

name: Thisbe Pickledale
description: A helper nurse in the Care Tower. She is an inspiring doctor much like Zandra her close friend. She attends the Tower of Eden and is seen throughout Book 2.

name: Abra Housestacker
description: The school’s local housewoman. She is never shown using magic except with magical items like a moving broom, mop, and several ghosts helpers.

name: Delbert Broomstock
description: The school’s local houseman, he uses magical household items and can be seen talking about anyone and everyone behind their backs. He often cohorts with drinking on the job with the school’s local gardener.

name: Gole Shoegreen
description: The school’s local gardener that uses practicing nature magic to keep attention to the school’s local gardens and anything nature specific. He can be seen at times drinking on the job with Delbert Broomstock.

name: Albert Withermyster
description: Seen as a librarian. Albert is also the school’s advisor and officially the welcoming teacher to Tantirith for anyone that has come from anywhere other than Tier during their first year. His class is found in a narrow staircase found high in the archway of the school. His class has maps from all over the 13 realms and is often called upon to educate on various realms. He can be seen teaching the Lazaron siblings on the history of Tier, Tantirith, and magic.

name: Headmistress Gavana
description: A incredibly powerful witch that practiced very strong defensive magic during the early 1600s. In the late 1700s, a demi-god named Arcarath nearly destroyed the world to get back at those who shunned him. She was killed during the Dark War and a plaque in her honor was hung up at the entrance of Tantirith. Her statue was mounted in the hall of Leaders in Tantirith.

name: Arcarath
description: A powerful demi-god half god son to Volkanos and a witch named Grezilda. He was sent to Earth by Volkanos after he accidently killed his mother during his childhood. After being expelled from Tantirth during the late 1700s for killing a student, Arcarath destroyed most of the school and started the famed Dark War which led to hunters overthrowing him because of his dark magic. This in return convinced the Hunter’s Room that mages were dangerous and needed to be killed.

name: Majicksend Rolowen
description: A snobby rich warlock that was killed by Arcarath after bullying him during his first few months at Tantirith. His parents went on to lead a tirade against Arcarath.

name: Damien Rolowen
description: Father of Majicksend. After his son died by Arcarath, he and his wife led the army which would be later known as the Dark War against Arcarath.

name: Linda Rolowen
description: Wife of Damien and mother of Majicksend. Along with her husband she led the war later known as the Dark War against Arcarath.

name: Cahtia Reportin
description: A student that attends the Tower of Drake at Tantirith. She appears as one of the smartest students at Tantirith. She has short white hair and is originally a bubbly yet stern girl. She is revealed to be a part of the Tier Authority and is investigating the weird happenings at the school. She is poisoned by the Lake Disease and dies. Her friends remember her as an honorable person as their memories are erase of who she really was.

name: Gary Stattershock
description: One of the friends to Kain along with Cahtia before her death. He is also one of the five smartest students at Tantirith. Often timid and afraid to dive into sports related courses. He is shown to contradict his timid nature during battle. Where for unknown reasons he fights like a warrior and charges ahead of his friends when needed. It is slightly revealed in Book 3 that he is possessed by a powerful warrior who uses Gary to relive his life and take control over Tantirith. The spell is banished and Gary returns not able to remember anything that has happened throughout his stay at Tantirith. He leaves in Book 3 leaving Kain by himself. He is featured alongside Angela Broomwitch in the Adventures of Kain as imaginary detectives along with Kain.

name: Angela Broomwitch
description: Student at Tantirith. She is a student of Chapter of Drake. Her family owns the Broomshack. A local pub for teenagers that sell magical drinks that has no alcohol.

name: Serodge Huffintails
description: A tall slim Indian boy who can summon spirit guides to assist him. He is a shaman and can heal any wombs. It has been stated that like his ancestors he might be able to live for nearly 200 years.

name: Lera Ayayua
description: A Greek statue brought to life by a magician. Like all statues of the world. She is link to them believing them to be family. Given a brain and heart. Lera develops a crush on Kain. Although it is forbidden for her kind to love outside of her Statue Race.

name: Merina Goodflood
description: A gypsy. She leaves after the first year at Tantirith as tradition for her family to move every year. During her time she is often seen proving that she has more magic then her family normally possess. Her skill of choice is levitation. A skill not normally learned by gypsies.

name: Samantha Reed
description: Student at Tantirith. She arrives at the school from a mysterious place. She is widely known for having powers over the elements. She is part of the New Alliance and knows a lot about the future. She befriends Kayla although the two often butt heads.

name: Owen Pents
description: He has a strong liking for Kayla Lazaron. As the two fall in love at the end of book two. Causing Kayla to break up with the Mage of Fire at the School’s first Continual Ball. He practices very powerful weather magic. He is abandoned by his parents to save him from a threat. For reasons unknown he is attached to Wendy.

name: Bronte Billioq
description: Student at Tantirith, fond of novels and fairytales. He is the go-to guy for anything related to Tantirith and the land of Tier as he has studied it fearsly.

name: Darius Debbins
description: A tall black guy that often makes mistakes in almost everything. To only find out that he has the best luck at healing magic. He develops a small crush on Kayla but it fades when he realizes what she can do.

name: Jasper Astronima
description: He is a jock like his friend Joss Magix and Magritte Creen his on and off again girlfriend. Inspiring to be a Skyball Star. He has won Tantirith its championships two years in a row. He belongs to the Chapter of Shade with his two friends.

name: Joss Magix
description: Enemy to Kendo and his bully. Along with Jasper Astronima and Magritte Creen. He is the school’s jock. Capable of using powerful defensive magic like his father.

name: Magritte Creen
description: Inspiring to be a lawyer at Magical Properties and Company. She is cunning, devious, and belongs to the Chapter of Shade. Along with Joss Magix and Jasper Astronima, she is the Tantirith’s three bullies and head cheerleader.

name: Max Tutterfairy
description: Sent to Tantirith to earn his fairy wings. He is a fairy and only reveals such in the second book before kissing Merce Dymond.

name: Merce Dymond
description: A fairy and drawn to Max. She is levelheaded and uses Powder Dust Magic to make things grow. Unlike Max, she has already gained her wings however not her full powers yet. She attends Chapter of Eden.

name: Mila Basteet
description: Descendant of the goddess Bastet of Egyptian Mythology. Her grandmother was responsible for ending the Cat and Dog wars of Tier legend. She loves reading up on animals and how to train mythical beasts. She is a first year student at Tantirith.

name: Misha Base
description: A statue student and friend to Lera Ayayua. He often uses stone magic as a way to make the school’s gargoyles his pets although its forbidden to interact with them as they must stay attentive and ward off evil. He can turn himself into a statue at will and revert back again. He is one of the 3,000 statues throughout history that was given life. As a resort he has no official parents although two statues which were sculpted depicted as his parents became his parents when they too was presented life.

name: Musetta Teller
description: Fourth year student. She is daughter to an Opera singer. She has musically enhanced powers and has been seen using a violin to cause sonic noises.

name: Ocean Willowwish
description: Like her mother Sabrina. She is a talent singer and is one of Tier’s most prominent singers. She has sold out arenas across the realms.

name: Orion Starship
description: An alien boy from space. Although his planet is never mentioned it is hinted to be big and red. Although how he got to Tier is unknown. It is believe that the UFO sightings found across history is actually his people looking for him. He is green and red with oily skin wearing a large helmet. He appears throughout the third book and attends Hizirinth.

name: Sabrina Willowwish
description: Once a student at Tantirith. Today she is the Orchestra Director to the Chapter of Drake. She is mother to Ocean Willowwish. She is also a talented singer and inspiring singer/actor.

name: Sam Stonegruff
description: Student at Tantirith. Student of Chapter of Drake. He is a inspiring novelist. He is indian descent and uses his culture through his magic.

name: Story Brighthouse
description: Reporter and student of Tantirith. She is bright and has a high self esteem. With long dread locks and her often wild style. She resports the latest of Tantirith. Her dream job is to work at Tier Associations as a newscaster.

name: Thea Colandale
description: A ghost that attends school at Hizirinth in order to move onto the afterlife. If she graduates that is. She is very cheerful but turns a fiery flame if something bothers her. She has no magical powers however shows great ghostly powers that rival those with magic. She is nearly vanquished from existence when confronted by the Horseman of War. She is saved by Kain whom falls for her until she is granted her door at the end of the 2nd book.

name: Zandra Goldenhoof
description: Zandra is a short stubby girl with short black hair and is often seen reading a book or two. Her long robes are a gift from her father. A doctor. Someone who she wishes to be when is an adult. Because of this she specializes in healing magic.

name: Zeno Dragonstail
description: An teenage dragon boy that can breathe blue flames. He is constantly bullied and befriends Kain, Gary, and partially Cahtia during the 3rd book and the Adventures of Kain. In the Adventures of Kain his powers are finally revealed. He is mentioned to have powers connected to the five dragons that guard Tantirith.

name: Devero Shorthouse
description: One of the champions from book 3 that appears to have a problem with Kendo. He has massive amounts of powers believed to be given to him by Kendo’s grandfather in hopes to stop Kendo from vanquishing the remaining horsemen. Although instructed not to kill Kendo. He attempts too many times with no avail. He disappears through black smoke and is never heard of again after book 3.

name: Honse Backwell
description: A tall slinky blonde boy who befriends Kendo and is a part of the Chapter of Drake. He met Kendo and Zandra during a magical chess match and became instant friends of theirs.

name: Edrick Devins
description: One of the members of Tantirith’s Sky Ball Team. He is often the lead Thrower. Although he has shown great skills in being a Kicker.

name: Veronica Spellshade
description: A talkative girl with long purple hair. She can see into different realms. A gift she shares with Kayla Lazaron and they are the only two that can do this in the last four centuries. Her parents died when she was 2 and was raised by cloaked wisemen. She is almost always a conversation starter amongst her group of friends. She belongs to the Chapter of Drake at Tantirith.

name: Miles Rockinburg
description: A Scout Elf. His pointy ears are used to hear long distances and his tail can detect motion around him. With his nature, he is able to always find something. Rather its information or a particular item. He is seen throughout the first Lazarons Book. However, his character becomes more minor throughout Books two and Three. He returns to his major status in Book four as a Guardian at the Tower of Drake.

name: Raffaela
description: Member to the Chapter of Eyis. She develops a slight crush on Kendo. Unaware of his love for Hoj. She has long black hair that nearly touches the floor. Her developed form is the process of her mental powers. She is a strong psychic and is in her third year at Tantirith. At the end of Book 2 she is in love with the Mage of Nature.

name: Ralph Nuronis
description: A powerful seeker part of the Skyball team, although a jock he is often quiet preferring to stay to himself unless he is at a game. He likes to read, dance, sing, and is inspiring to become an actor. He is seen briefly throughout Book 2, 3, and lastly in Book 4 when he graduates Tantirith. His first official acting job came as the lead ghoul in the Ghoul That Can Dance.

name: Raphaela
description: Unknown twin sister to Raffaela. The similar names are subject for debate as many consider them to close in similarities. Many call her simply Phaela to avoid confusion. She is in her third year and has something to do with the second horsemen from entering the school in Book 2. She is seen briefly at the end of Book 1 with several other students.

name: Raymond Oftemyor
description: A strong man with the head of a bull. His loud voice is his most distinctive form. He attended Purnog before the school’s merged and he now attends Tantirith at the beginning of Book 2 of The Lazarons. He is placed in the Chapter of Eden because of his history with nature.

name: Remus Dolvinmorf
description: A sweet boy with a not so sweet past. He moves his body like a snake and has no bones. His true appearance is shrouded by a spell. He confronts who he really is although briefly to Zandra at the end of Book 2. He is a shapeshifter from Purnog and belongs now to the Chapter of Eden before he leaves the school.

name: Rex Devilsnap
description: A dark figured guy with muscles. He is a follower to Romulus and worships the Ogliverion family. The men of his family have been followers to the Ogliverions for centuries and are considered their often strength. Like he is to Romulus throughout their time at Tantirith. He has a liking to Septima although he never admits it. He is nearly killed during the battle with the return of Montum. He gives up evil doings and disappears. It is revealed that he moves to Russia where he has two children with Seneca Hams.

name: Rocco
description: A dog boy that hangs with Roman. He is short and orange. Although carrying dog like habits. He is very intelligent and is fond of technology. He befriends Gary during Book 2.

name: Roman
description: A blue dog boy and friend to Cahtia and Rocco. His parents are said to be governors to his people. Although his people are never mentioned. Cahtia likes him because of his knowledge about the Black Forest. Something that she finds very enchanting. He mostly appears throughout the Adventures of Kain and has an entire story around him in Roman and Rocco: The Short Short Dog Tail.

name: Romeo
description: A ghost and lover to Juliet. He attends Hizirinth in an attempt to figure out why he is reliving his shakespering death. Once he graduates he will receive his door. He is seen briefly in the 2nd book only to reveal his love to Juliet and explain his story.

name: Romulus Ogliverion
description: A foul student who pressures Kane, Gary, and Cindy and is often their bully. His family belongs to a very long line of powerful Black Sorcerers and with them controls the northern part of the magical community through trades, taxing, and delivering of powerful black forbidden spells.

name: Rufina Redwood
description: A wizard that believes her people are the greatest of magical beings. She formed a club of other wizards at Tantirith that has since become the school bullies. Although not her plan at first, she later pushes this to get her referendums passed at the school council.

name: Rufus Domagus
description: A sondred that was cursed as a teenager for eternity. Having seen the world for nearly 8,000 years, Rufus was born in North Africa and help build the pyramids of Egypt. With his family dying thousands of years ago, Rufus collected their bodies and placed them in a spell. This disrupted the natural balance of his people and caused chaos. For punishment he was turned to a teenager for eternity and visits the school often. Attracting attention from almost anyone because of his old age ways and language.

name: Sabina Spellway
description: A witch who defies her magic and only came to Tantirith in hopes to learn to control it or even get rid of it. Her parents were mortal but her grandparents were witches (warlock for grandfather). She has a liking for Rufus mostly because of his old world knowledge and attitude which she calls different then all the other boys at the school.

name: Savannah Wedgemaker
description: Descendant from a long line of blacksmiths, Savannah has always wanted to do something outside of her family’s legacy. It is said she is descendant from the first blacksmith from the first civilization although her family’s nomadic nature looking for jobs is hard to prove this. She specializes in turning inanimate objects to life.

name: Scarlett Nigh
description: All around her are shadows that holds onto her body always attempting to pull her into the Shadow World, one of the 12 Realms of Existence in which only darkness lives. At a young age, she was killed by a demon. In order for them to save their little girl, her family sacrificed their magic and made a deal with Montum to bring her back. As punishment she can only exists with one of the shards of the Pearl of Indomina. Some say she has befriended the shadows around her to the point where they don’t threaten her anymore and protects her. Many believe it is because of the pearl’s influence over the dead.

name: Seneca Hams
description: The future wife to Rex Devilsnap. She is a witch who appears briefly at Tantirith during the 10th chapter of the Adventures of Kain. She goes to Tantirith and is one of the few students who knows the Premium Dawn Spell.

name: Septima Googlsnouf
description: Follower to Romulus throughout their times in Tantirith. She is fond of forbidden herbs and has a dream of opening her own Forbidden Herb shop which is stated in a vision that she will. However in the final chapter of the Adventures of Kain she is killed during the return of Montum.

name: Septimus Moonwater
description: Seraphina’s boyfriend and student at Tantirith. He attends the Tower of Oceen and is a merman. He is tall and slinky and has spikes as fins and hair. His mermaid tail is very long and he is believed to be one of the descendants to the nymph Aqua.

name: Seraphina Goodwill
description: Student at Tantirith. She attends the Tower of Oceen. She has wings and is only ever seen in the water. Because most of her classes has water, it believe that she is one of the few mermaids at the school. Although her tail is never mentioned.

name: Sergia Gravebroke
description: A zombie girl that befriends Melia a ghost who was around during her time as a human. She uses makeup to disguise her deformed look. Unlike her parents she is ashamed of her zombie heritage. She also speaks and move very slowly. So slowly that only her closes friends have learned her zombie language.

name: Severina Snakehead
description: Descendant to Medusa. She uses powerful rays of stone omitting beams to turn anything to stone and with help she can later turn things to gold. She is distant relative to King Mitos of Greek Legend.

name: Severus Sungood
description: A bright cheery guy that appears briefly during the third book. He is mentioned to be one of the few happy students at Hizirinth. He appears in the coliseum sitting and talking calmly to Zondra about the Sun Trials.

name: Seymour Gray
description: Winner of the Sun Trials where participants must compete to win the powerful sun dial of legend that can control the powers of the sun. He uses the sun dial to bring solice to his war torn people which are never seen in the books.

name: Sidney Redroof
description: A carpenter and a proud student at Tantirith. Capable of building powerful charms. He has long been seen as the informant to those wishing to build charms and other magical items. His family created numerous magical items found throughout Tier.

name: Silvia Collinrogue
description: A spirit that attends Purnog. She lacks much human speaks and because she has been dead for so long, she forgot many of their ways and customs. She often shows this by trying to fit in at school.

name: Skela Bonebroth
description: An undead girl that transfers from Hizirinth during Book 2. Although during her life she attended Tantirith and protected the Tower of Eyis as an oath given upon her family from the original Grand Professor. After her return to the school she continues to honor her oath although as mentioned by the Grand Professor that she no longer is bound to it because of her passing. She is a walking skeleton with a bob cut black hair, pink glasses, and a 1960’s poodle dress. She always carries a sword made up of bones. She never leaves her post at the doors to the Tower of Eyis.

name: Slade Mumae’
description: A mummy like mutant with an ability to heal and summon skeleton warriors at will. His abilities are rare and thus very little knowledge of how to control them. He was once an Egyptian prince with a different name until he was killed and was reborn as Slade. His parents adopted him and sent him to Tantirith to fit in with others like him.

name: Sonny Bluebell
description: Student at the Tower of Eden. He is a short boy with short white hair and big lips. He talks very fast and can control plants.

name: Stephanus Glowridge
description: His family are magical wand sellers and thus is thrust into the world of mostly magicians and wizards. He uses several wizard like customs to blend it with the wizard students at Tantirith.

name: Stone Surrough
description: A typical dumb jock at Purnog that places in first or second in each tournament of the Golden Disk Throw.

name: Susannah Wolfentein
description: Half cat half wolf girl that is descendant from the goddess, Cat. She is strong and very quick, like her sister Tertia, she can detect almost anything with a smell. She is proud and possesses courage beyond her peers.

name: Tanaquil Webbis
description: A spider boy or spider dude as he calls himself. He is a self proclaimed lady’s man and usually is seen trying to pick girls. He can create sticky webs to hang from. He attends Purnog.

name: Tarquin Webroot
description: A spider boy that lives deep within the shadows of Purnog. He transfers to Hizirinth during his 3rd year in an attempt to control his powers better.

name: Tatiana Statuwess
description: One of the 3,000 stone figures brought to life. She uses powerful stone magic to carve and turn others like her to life. For this she is considered their queen and thus she acts like a spoil princess. She attends Hizirinth.

name: Tauria Panmaker
description: Hizirinth’s student baker. She bakes often disgusting cakes and sour candies that only the students of Hizirinth can tolerate. Her goal is to open her own bistro featuring her foods.

name: Tertia Wolfentein
description: A great singer, she is sister to Susannah, she is fast and speaks very quickly. She adores her friends and goes to Tantirith to learn how to control her feline attributes which went out of control during her puberty.

name: Theodore Wellwonder
description: His family lives at the bottom of the famous wishing well. There they can travel to any part of the 12 Realms of Existence. He attends Purnog.

name: Theon Capturon
description: A centaur that uses his arrows to cast love spells. He attends Purnog.

name: Tiberius LakeLake
description: An asian descent wizard that has a fond of using transformative magic. He attends Tantirith during Book 3.

name: Titiana Shipwreck
description: A ghost and daughter to a once prominent billionaire. She died on the Titantic and still lives on it with her family who haunts it at the bottom of the sea. She attends Purnog.

name: Titus Gromp
description: An elf with a muscular body. He is often seen naked and is rarely mentioned during the Purnog series. His only mention is when students talk about his often nude appearance.

name: Tony Thunderstorm
description: Brother to Trey Thunderstorm, they are known as the Thunder Brothers because of their history of creating some of the world’s worse storms in the last 100 years.

name: Tullia Flowersnap
description: A young girl that is always known to wear flower dresses. Although she appears to be only around seven years of age. She is indeed several hundred years old. However, do to her inexperience she attends Tantirith at the Tower of Eden. She has incredible plant based powers. During Book 2 she causes nearly all plantlife at Tantirith to come alive. She is partially used by the Horseman of War to cause havoc across Tantirith.

name: Turia Misenfloor
description: A mermaid that was magically granted legs while attending Tantirith. She is seen at the beginning of the first book while again later when her Tower gets sick with the Lake Disease. She helps develop a cure from plants found at the bottom of the Black Lake.

name: Urban Izuro
description: A Chinese dragon that was given a human form by an ancient wizard. Only if he promised to never use his power for harm. He has strong powers over the mind. During the third book he abuses his powers and is turned back into a dragon and is expelled from Tantirith because of controlling several students. He strikes vengeance when he returns in book four. He is killed toward the end of book four by Kenia Lazaron.

name: Urbana Milstone
description: A powerful seer that can see into someone’s or something’s distant past. She developed her powers from her grandmother as her parents were both mortals. Her aunt, a member of the Fairfolk, created a pair of glasses out of science and magic that gave her more control over her psychic abilities.

name: Valentina Danes
description: A girl that resembles a vampire that drains blood from animals to stay alive and possesses magical abilities on the level of a witch. Her bestfriend is Vincent Lovechild.

name: Valeria Witchbroom
description: A witch whose innate magic caused a great rift at Purnog because they proved to become too dangerous, so she transferred to Hizirinth in her final year of school to hone her ability.

name: Varinia Frankenhein
description: A manmade girl which resembles the Frankenstein monster. She is very intelligent and has sparks that goes off under excitement. She befriends almost anyone and possesses an ability to cause electric fuses to explode. She also has minor electric abilities.

name: Verina Moonshine
description: A celestial being appearing as a young girl. She appears before someone preys to the moon goddess which is her mother. She grants them their prayers if their hearts are pure. She attends Purnog in hopes to inspire the students during its rebuilt.

name: Victor Vanhigle
description: A vampire hunter with enhanced strength. He has come to Tantirith in order to learn how to subdue vampires. At his current strength he has only manage to spar with a vampire child. His ancestry is some of the oldest and well known vampires of any age. He is descendant of the Vanhelsing family.

name: Vincent Lovechild
description: A smart yet naïve playboy that tries his best at getting every girl and on some accounts guys to fall deeply in love with him. He is the descendant of the Sport’ deities and his parents were embowed with arrows that can restore love in anyone’s heart.

name: Violetta Violet
description: A purple skin girl that has poison slipping from her skin. She has never been touched and yearns to be touched by a boy. She attends Hizirinth.

name: Walter Primestock
description: The achieved golden boy that killed numerous witches as a hunter. His family are a line of strong supernatural hunters. His family is featured in Lifestyle series of short novels. He attends Hizirinth because of its extensive Hunting Course.

name: Wendy Winterstorm
description: Student and future teacher at Tantirith, she is purpled headed and her family was responsible to the Ice Age during the Great Conflict. Because of her southern accent and proper tone, she is admired and referred to by Kayla as a southern bell. Something she finds intriguing. She is in love with boys and girlish things like fashion and doing her nails. Although a proper girl, she is willing to fight without warning and uses advance Ice Magic to defend herself and those she care about. She is a main character in The Lazarons stories.

name: Wilbur Zigglebat
description: A lover of bats of any species. Treated as an outcast because of adoration. Wilbur uses what he calls “bat magic” because it allows him to manipulate the characteristics of a bat or vampire as seen by his peers. His love grew because of his father’s similar adoration for all things vampires. His close friend as a child was a vampire that his parents adopted until the vampire kid was sent off to Purnog for studies. The two hasn’t seen each other in over 10 years.

name: Xama Thunderstroke
description: A member of the Sky Tribe of Thunder Spirits. Brought to Tantirith to learn about her heritage and how to use her powers over thunder. She has since been trained exclusively in martial arts. She is a student at Tantirith as part of the Chapter of Shade. Over time she develops a tough love crush on Honse. Who she treats as a slave and sometimes pet. She is dressed in a dark leather outfit fitted with knives, throwing knives, and other weapons.

name: Zandra
description: Is a student throughout Book 1. She classifies as one of the smartest students at Tantirith. Her names gets mixed up often with another student Zondra. She is only seen throughout Book 1 before it’s revealed that she is a member of the Tier Authority to investigate the strange happenings throughout Tantirith and to dispel the authority of the Grand Professor. After the school is saved and returns to normal she leaves and with the help of Cahtia she erases the memories of all faculty and students.

name: Dharma Hiltridge
description: One of the ghost who died at Tantirith when she was a teacher. As a teacher she often slept in the Chapter of Drake. One night legend states that she fell asleep next to the fireplace to only awake as a ghost. Her body was burned alive but nothing else was. It has been one of the biggest mysteries of the school since its opening.

name: Sir Charles Everwood Mulls
description: Was a ghost that died in battle during the mid-1700s. He has since rode through the night at Shepard’s Bush in London. His most recent appearance was at Tantirith of which he appeared during unknown reasons. He is seen during the Adventures of Kain and briefly through the first Lazarons Book. He is destroyed during the first book of the series.

name: The Lonely Maiden
description: No one knows of her past except that it was very violent. She cries so often that her real name was lost centuries ago and has since been given the title The Lonely Maiden. She doesn’t speak in any known language except a few words in Old English.

name: Enchantis Mullard
description: A young boy who died sometime in the 1800s due to the plague in London. On his way to the afterlife, his soul was snatched from the gates and thrown back into this plane. He was brought to Tantirith by other ghosts to learn why he couldn’t move on.

name: The Dark Fiend
description: An evil spirit that possessed a centaur and since was trapped inside of its body. It became closely associated with the four horsemen of lore and it somehow knows when and where they will strike again. To keep close eye on its behavior, the Dark Fiend was concealed in a box until it was unleashed in Book 2 and taunted the other ghosts of the school.

name: The Gender Bending Woman
description: Born into poor family. The woman brought on money by pretending to be a man. So convincing of her appearance. She met a woman who practiced in black magic. The woman fell in love with her, and she has since wanted to marry her, however when she found out of the bending woman’s true nature, she cursed her to die as both a man and a woman in the same body. So broken by what happened, her condition pushed her into insanity. She killed herself and since in death found humor in the situation turning herself into a man or woman at will to confuse others.

name: Warlock God
description: During the time when Xshaun was in his youth, he created a coven of young warlocks and trained them in the use of witchcraft. After thousands of years, the powers that gathered from the now hundreds of covens converged into one being known as the Warlock God. This entity is so extremely powerful that witches from around the world attempted to vanquish him to no avail. To defeat him, they split his essence into halves, the Warlock God of Light Magic and the Warlock God of Dark Magic.  The Warlock God of Light Magic was reincarnated within a witch family of good witches and a druid. The Warlock God of Dark Magic was reincarnated eventually into a family of good witches but was influenced through negative actions to enact on his dark magic.

name: Authority of Magical Learning
description: An entity throughout Tier that houses many figures responsible for awarding and maintaining the studies of magical beings throughout Tier and its magical communities in other dimensions. Any magical child is under their direct influence and care. Their biggest influence lies with the three schools representing the Triangle of Knowledge, Purnog, Tantirith, and Hizirinth. However, there are over 300 different schools for various studies across Tier.

name: The Naked One
description: A young student that haunts and often attempts to seduce boys in the boy’s bath hall. He died under water while performing sexual acts on two teenage warlocks. Unknowgst until some time later that he was dead, he would often partake more acts on other ghosts of which he initially thought were alive. Knowing of his ghostly status now, the unnamed ghost often likes to taunt other male students never revealing his name and heard laughing and smiling in the shadows.

name: Sister’s Coven
description: Young mages that were taught witchcraft and became the first group of witches. They were taught different forms of witchcraft and each had different powers including power over Nature, Time, Telekenises, Telepathy, the elements, Premonition, and others. Thousands of years later three of the coven’s powers grew to immense power becoming a trio of sisters.

name: Amununo
description:
Rank: God of Strength

Anununo God of Strength was thought to be so powerful that his mother Santiyline ordered him to forever hold the sky and when he started to grow tired, Santiyline created the Pillars of Trudara which are four pillars standing on the four corners of the world holding up the sky. After his ordeal, Anununo carved the first warrior out of stone and he also created the first gym. Later in his life, Anununo created the first game and championship. The first tournament was made in his honor and Olympic Games around the country begun with Anununo at the center of the fields as standing judge. His brother Tur' created several medallions for the god to try and persuade the god in letting Adv loose so they could be together. But the offer was refuse and the two remained separated.

name: Daotti
description:
Rank: God of Fertility & Courtship

Like many fertility gods, the Elitsyians believed him to be of great importance. Mostly because of his gift to them of childbirth and sex. Daotti was a loosely clothed man that loved to show his private parts to anyone that would take an eye for them. He appeared as full bearded, sometimes elderly, sometimes young and handsome. He created the trait of bisexuality as he loved both men and women equally. His influence spread across both mankind and even the gods.

name: Doju
description:
Rank: Flower God

Doju was a Flower God and one of the many lovers to Khani. He was very feminine and laughed at almost everything. He loved his image so much he created the first mirror out of sand and wood and looked upon it for hours. For his behavior, Khani felt that his love was compared to Doju's image and the destructive god threw him into the water and turned him into the reflection of everyone that look upon a reflective surface like water.

name: Tama
description:
Rank: Father of Monkeys

Tama Father of Monkeys could jump from one end of the world to another. He had magical powers and a staff that could reach the heavens. When asked by a spirit of a dead man what was his position in the world he responded “why must life have meaning, why can't we just live and enjoy it”. The spirit reply “because then life would be for nothing”.

name: Novanna
description:
Rank: God of Sacrifices

Novanna Wolf God of Sacrifices is probably the most mysterious figure in Elitsyian Mythology. He collected several stones from different locations around the world and built the first ritual pier. In this pier he summoned several demons and spirits onto the world. For his punishment he was banished to the Bottomless Pit haunted by the very spirits he summoned. He also founded Halloween and is called upon across Lostasia for sacrificial summons.

name: Takeo
description:
Rank: Kitchen God of Food & Eating

Takeo was a Kitchen God who lived amongst immortals but worked and protected the kitchen of man. He had many forms and could guard houses, castles, and lands. Takeo to the Elitsyians was considered the first chef and minister.

name: Marlexmade
description:
Rank: God of Men & Pottery

He stole the gift of pottery making from Born' and molded the first man out of clay and Yonrohs' tears. He then gave the gift of pottery to man. He is son to Jonun.

name: Artexa
description:
Rank: Goddess of Woman, Childbirth, & Motherhood

Arxtexa was once the Goddess of Women, Childbirth, and Motherhood. Sister to Marlexmade together they created man. She created women from grass and the heart from stone. She gave them brains thanks to Authora and the gift to conceive from the god, Daotti.

name: Ni
description:
Rank: God of Sickness & Diseases

Ni is the God of Sickness and Diseases. Once a healer, Ni was very loving until Montum convinced him that the world didn't need his magic and thus continue him to go un-worshiped. This caused Ni to revert to his complete opposite and instead of healing he presented to the world the first disease and from insects came the first sickness. He became so feared that the gods rebelled against him forcing him to live his days in the underworld. Still to the day, Ni is feared and his magic haunts the world.

name: Morch
description:
Rank: God of Monarchy & Royalty

Morch is God of Monarchy and Royalty and although he was born of independence. The Elitsyians knew their world was protected with many unseen warriors so they too thought the same for the gods and the legend of Morch was born. He protected the gates of Lium, but before this legend grew, Morch gave birth to Authority much like the Coldorns and presented the first organization and the first royal family was his. In his honor royalty would be granted his name, Monarchy.

name: Harmoxide
description:
Rank: God of Lies & Manipulation

While in his life he was a deform and very evil king. His kingdom killed him because of his deformity and because of his evil tyrant ways so in the afterlife he cursed the world with the 7 sins and gave mankind the ability to lie which served as small but dangerous emotion. War was built from it and deaths grew, for this Montum made Harmoxide one of his Judges. He judges whether truthful dead went to Helliholm “heaven”. Harmoxide is also one of the many avatars to Khani.

name: Tidis
description:
Rank: God of Memory

Tidis God of Memory was made out of watermelon seeds and oil. With his conception Authora became struck in love for the first time for the ugly god. She loved his vast knowledge and ventured nature and granted him a place living with her in the Heavens. From there they gave the world wisdom and gift of memory. In some stories he is a evil god and serves as God of Forgetfulness and Amnesia and one of the avatars to Khani.

name: Sentos
description:
Rank: God of Might & Empowerment

Sentos god of Might and Empowerment, he assisted in given women equal rights in Lostasia. Because of his movement he was brought to the Heavens by Authora and his mother Nexus. He is lover of men, but women knew him as their voice especially with the Heavens. He was born of Marlexmade penis and his armor from Nexus breast milk, dressed in all white Sentos would be more beautiful than expected and instantly became a love interest to many. His statement was to unite the world regardless of class and to give integrity to all not just the wealthy. His only female lover was the princess Ushu to who help give birth to the entire Mushin Kingdom found in far East Lostasia.

name: Dorduck
description:
Rank: God of Knowledge, the Crafts, & Intelligence

Dorduck the two headed snake God of Knowledge, the Crafts, and Intelligence only importance was assisting Authora with making the human brain. He created the many parts of the brain that allows self-thinking.

name: Ditios
description:
Rank: God of Security & Manuscripts

Ditios was Dorduck's only son and served as God of Security and Manuscripts. In the first library he was its librarian and with the help of magic he would record the contents of the world and protect them from harm. He was the Lizard God and from his poisonous noise raised the first security guards and dogs.

name: Bow
description:
Rank: God of Substance & Reluctance

Bow God of Substance and Reluctance resisted becoming a prime figure in the Royal Circa after proving that he has strength that other deities don't. With one punch the earthquakes, one spit came Armageddon, one sneeze came the first tornado, and when enraged he threw thunderbolts. Pictured on luxury items as a Dove Deity that was dressed in all white and controlled the elements around him.

name: Lome
description:
Rank: God of the Golden Honey

Lome the beautiful strong willed god of the Golden Honey was very strong and so she was appointed the protector of the Golden Honey. Her children would churn and mix the honey to give the gods their immortality. His son, Arny Stage was sent to Earth so that he could live amongst humans without fear; he gave his son powers that could neutralize anyone’s abilities through the help of the golden honey.

name: Spelce
description:
Rank: God of Truth & Well-being

Spelce he could not tell a lie and so annoy by his honesty the gods thought it best that everyone needed some of his truthfulness so they turn the deity into an immortal and he became God of Truth and Well-Being. Later on some myths state that he was so truthful that the gods grew tired of him so they turned him into the Stone of Truth that if someone was to hold it they could not tell a lie. This was so dangerous that nations fell because the truth was far more a threat than the lie.

name: Me’
description:
Rank: Goddess of Childbirth & Marriages

Me' Goddess of Childbirth and Marriages is responsible for assisting mothers with childbirth and marriages. With the rising of hospitals and modern births she was later merged with a better known goddess, Artexa. Her only parent was Daotti.

name: Simone
description:
Rank: Goddess of Learning & the Spoken Word

Simone Goddess of Learning and the Spoken Word. Simone guarded the spoken word since the dawn of creation. Her parents are unknown and where she came from a bigger mystery. But it is told that the spoken word is a forgotten language that if said correctly could grant any being ultimate power. Simone the only one who knows of its meaning and location had her mouth sewn shut and her eyes cut out. With immortality and the power to destroy any entity no matter how powerful, Simone is not to be approached and a law has been set in Elitsyian Times that her name to be forgotten.

name: Follans
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Deadly Sins

Follans are the beautiful 7 goddesses with the deadly sins. Aele “anger”, Sondra “sloth”, Pele “envy”, Bethra “greed”, Whora “lust”, Metche “gluttony” and Poni “pride”. Each of their appearance took after their positions of the emotions. Poni was associated with warfare and married Nextis and later one associated her with war entirely. Metche was associated with food and became goddess of Plants and Vegetables. Whora was a love goddess and Bethra was greed. Sondra was mother to the Dream Gods.

name: Rotrude
description:
Rank: God of Prisons, Reincarnation, & Captivity

Rotrude was born to mortal parents but after being locked up and abused for most of his life, Born' took the young boy to the Heavens and made him his private lover and cupbearer. The boy agreed to stay by the king's side if he granted him the revenge against his parents. Once back on Earth the boy used the torch of Born' which if blown upon could burn fields to cities in just moments. His parent’s souls now roam the Earth as Sanity and Sorrow. Montum too fell for the boy after witnessing his ill behavior and ofter him immortality but he had to remain by the deity’s side. Betraying Born' to join Montum, the king was angered and sent his crows and vultures down to eat out Rotrude's heart. Now dead his soul was revived and given immortality, Rotrude became God of Prisons, Reincarnation, and Captivity.

name: Frisk
description:
Rank: Goddess of Rainbows

Frisk Goddess of the Rainbow protected the realm of life with her many magical children, the sprites, leprechauns, brownies, fairies, and spiders. Frisk used her hair as a bridge only seen after rain and sunlight greet each other, and the bridge connects the realm of living to the magical world. Together with Xesir she parented Sesir, Jagnur, and Agikile.

name: Shade
description:
Rank: God of Hidden Entrances, Doorways, Shadows, & In-between

Shade is God of Hidden Entrances, Doorways, Shadows, and the In-between. Father to imps, trolls, shape shifters, dwarves, and harpies, Shade served mankind with watchful spirits he calls shadows. These creatures would disappear during the night as the whole world was their open kingdom and needed not to hide. Midnight was associated with this deity and he used this time to rule the realm of the living. His bride was the fairy queen, Tomi.

name: Opopes
description:
Rank: God of Worship & Prayer

Opopes is God of Worship and Prayer, at alters, churches, chapels, and sacred rituals he is invoked upon and given sacrifices for his magic. Son to Bewithia and Wishi, this deity would appear tall and very brute but have a gentle nature and sensitive outlook on the world.

name: YuanYuan
description:
Rank: Goddess of Mercy

YuanYuan Goddess of Mercy had her heart cut out by Nextis believing she was not a worthy warrior. When Kanos found it buried beneath a stone floor, he blessed it with Bewithia's magic and brought back YuanYuan this time as an immortal. She protects the good hearted and the middle class mortals. In one story because of Kanos kindness she married him and bore Kanos several sons, of whom were the first wizards of the world.

name: Sin
description:
Rank: Goddess of Wealth, Fortune, & Treasure

Sin Goddess of Wealth, Fortune, Treasure, and once a Sky deity. Although a hag she is adored by men and women for her offerings of treasures and magical items. To receive gifts from the goddess, people would burn down their old homes and from the ashes plant several baskets of fruit and straw which the goddess loved to eat.

name: Mel
description:
Rank: God of Music, Inspiration, & Musical Duties

Mel God of Music, Inspiration, and Musical Duties. Similar to most other music deities in other religions, Mel was both handsome and very skillful with his many musical instruments. With hair of ice gold, eyes of brown, and skin of silk this deity was adored by women. He was loved by gods too, first Jessana took him at her side and made love to him in the form of a nymph and then Crienta blessed him with jewels that lit of the night and a kiss that gave him immortality. His picture is drawn on almost every wall in Lostasia and he often plays at the festivals in honor of Smod.

name: Touchi
description:
Rank: Goddess of Ecstasy & the Blossom

Touchi, Goddess of Ecstasy and the Blossom Tree, was born from the stems of an Oak Tree and quickly became associated with it. Besides the Oak Tree, the Blossom Tree was too beautiful and very important to the Elitsyians Islands as they grew there and were originally presents from Japanese. So in their honor the Islandia Elitsyians gave many deities along with Touchi Japanese names. This deity was infatuated with several men and bore lots of children. With her magical powers she lifted up her children and planted their them into the ground to make the first Blossom Trees. From their roots came magical waters and the deities Nusuwaka and Hoshiume.

name: Koliomi
description:
Rank: Mother of Song

Koliomi was Mother of Song, from her gracious dances to singing, this deity grew sacred instruments from the Earth and from there she celebrated dances and theme parties for the gods. Koliomi's children were the first mention clowns, dancers, singers, musicians whom she made from cookies and magic powder. She also came up with writing music and invented an object similar to the piano.

name: Varvilvasta
description:
Rank: Goddess of Letters, Writings, Language, & Teachings

Varvilvasta was goddess of letters, writings, language, and teachings. Created by Authora to assists the people of Lostasia in learning of the world around them. Not a major goddess in Lostasia, she left to the islands of Lostasia where she was widely worshiped. There she over ruled the idea of Authora, and is looked on as teacher to students, of the arts and music, and inspiration to writers. Visioned as having 6 arms represented her ability to nurse all lands from any direction and in each held a symbol of the Islandia people of Lostasia. In one had she held the Ilu a sacred instrument that played sweet music that could make trees dance. In another hand she held the book of all knowledge which she read to the world, another she had a mirror which represented the beauty of learning and acceptance. With two of her other hands she held a blossom that could extend light over the world and it represented the honesty that is within man. The other was a bowl of cold soup. The soup was the statement of power and how it never spilled even under great turmoil. In the sixth hand held a tea leave which was the center of all things. The tea leaf was sacred to all Elitsyians because it was so old and wise that it brought anyone who held it eternal knowledge, youth, and power. If eaten this leaf could also grant two wishes.

name: Tibe
description:
Rank: Tribe Goddess

Tibe was a tribe goddess who was merely worship on the Islands of Lostasia as a powerful and very well worships deity. Tibe was represented as wood and daughter to Muda. The name tribe derives from her name and also shows her integrity toward bringing several walks of life together hinting the first tribe. Tibe was also written to have protected mankind from the fears of the world. Tibe takes several techniques known as the Aura Cleansing and teaches them humans known as Pridest “Elitsyian Buddhas” and they teach their tribes. During these procedures, the Pridest glow in intense light and emits great knowledge onto the tribe members. At this phase, the person releases all fears and reach acceptance and develops the strength to fight any division. This is more mental than physical however but has managed to strengthen the minds and hearts of millions still today. Once all mortal possessions and mental conscience are release then and only then can someone reach enlightenment. The enlightenment then made mere mortals become higher beings closely associated as the Islandia Elitsyians version of the Domaedians.

name: Me’
description:
Rank: Goddess of Childbirth & Marriages

Me' goddess of childbirth and marriages, responsible for her assistance in childbirth and female labor. She was daughter to Nextis and Mok'itu. During her teens she traveled the world and brought couples together and assisted Artexa in marrying the two. She and Artexa are sometimes classified as one goddess.

name: Caltow
description:
Rank: God of Oath

Born of a fallen star which was created from the birth of the universe, Caltow quickly rose to authority by creating the oath system amongst immortals. It is known that if any being regardless of power and ranking break an oath, he or she would receive punishment of the greatest lengths. Caltow met a Seefor and the two would produce The Link, a group of spirit like deities that causes most powerful oaths.

name: Arana’
description:
Rank: Spider Goddess

The spider goddess of legend is said to feed off of the energy and blood of her victims and lures them to her nest through her beauty. Her nest appears modern like a mansion covered in invisible spider webs with charms placed around it by witches and Sondreds to keep her from exiting. She has been killed many times throughout history but she can regenerate herself because of her heart that she keeps locked away in her mansion.

name: Buruth
description:
Rank: Protector of Helliholm

Buruth is a giant angel like being that once live to protect other Domaedians and served as servants to the High Council. Its body is covered in white fur that can block attacks; it has giant red eyes, giant claws, fangs, and wings. The red glowing structure on its chest, wings, knees, and elbows omit energy and causes protective force fields around it when in danger. The Buruth is immortal and one of the few beasts that can leave and return to Helliholm as needed.

name: Dosimide
description:
Rank: God of Slavery and War Planning

Dosimide was once a general in Nextis army and help the deity forge a successful plan to seize the Silver Horn from the Jonir Gods. For his reward, Nextis brought him to his fortress and endowed him with godly powers. Immediately after receiving his godly powers. Dosimide took a small army to enslave his old home of where he once was a slave. Released the slaves and captured the rich. He became known as the God of Slavery for his action.

name: Siola
description:
Rank: Goddess of Karma and Reaction

Once servant to a violent king. Siola granted a passenger aboard the king’s vessel a night of pleasure with her. If he helped her to escape. After love making, the passenger helped her escape. He was killed and she swimmed to nearby shores. Escaping the king’s wrath. Authora took her in and awarded her immortality to get back at the king.
