She became the Goddess of Karma to her worshippers.

name: Bestiny
description:
Rank: Goddess of Old Age

Tales speak that Bestiny was born old and invested with the knowledge of all things. She carries a sack within it holds old age of everything in existence. In the sack at the bottom are hard rocks of old age for the immortals that will never see it. She is seen covered in wrinkles and shrouded from sight with glowing cloths made of silver and parchments made of golden dust. She glides across the floor and sleeps at the doorstep of Eternity with her two large cats that speak in different languages.

name: Goldus
description:
Rank: God of Competition, Rivalry, and Challenges

A sly deity that was fastest amongst those that challenge him and because of his constant need to challenge others, he had opponents often. He helps create the first tournament and battle the first warrior to a hand to hand combat. Known for his speed and quick thinking. Goldus created the first gold metal which was handed to whomever could win one of his grueling battles.

name: Gentaewa
description:
Rank: Goddess of Law, Union, Order, Custom, and Tradition

Quick witted and always looking for a great challenge, this deity birthed the Law Fairies of the Black Forest and gave them each a function to divide the system of law across all regions including those of the gods. She was seen in formal clothing and has giant glasses that also served as a way for her spy on those doing unlawful deeds.

name: Inneria
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Soul and Heart

Known for her love to Jessana, the two made love for nearly three days straight and when they emerge Jessana blessed her with god like abilities and appointed her the cherish deity of the inner soul. Believing that Inneria found a hidden love within her heart that went missing when all the love of the world disappeared. The word Inner and the term hidden is derived from her myths.

name: Pentros
description:
Rank: God of Sexual Yearning

Youngest child to the deity Jessana. Pentros was the deity that lovers called on to have passionate and successful love making. Often the deity was considered the love counselor to young lovers who couldn’t get eroused but wanted the resulted claim.

name: Thole
description:
Rank: Goddess of Festivals and Banquets

The greeks and the Elitsyians often argue over whom thought of this deity first. Figured similar to the Greek goddess Thalia one of the graces. Her main story was that she was often called on by humans to bless a party of great significance to them.

name: Gleide
description:
Rank: God of Good Health

Planting special seeds throughout his garden that once bloomed promoted good health and was often used as herbs in teas and certain ingredients in foods.

name: Mourna
description:
Rank: Goddess of Adornment and Radiant Glow

The radiant glow that women often get when they are pregnant is mentioned to be because of Mourna blessing of them. She was daughter to Jessana and a mortal king.

name: Cura
description:
Rank: Goddess of Curing Illness

During the Casting Plague of Elitsia’s youth, Cura was called on to banish plagues from homes. She can be seen in paintings flying with her winged feet and wings on her arms and back with a giant cup with healing herbs. She also could be seen without wings being accompanied by a goat with a magical lace around its neck. The goat’s milk granted cures to many diseases.

name: Guardians of the Gates of Lium
description:
Rank: Gods of Protection, horsemen, Gymnasia, sports, and the field

The guardians of the Gates to Lium, they were children to the gods and had no separate myths of their own. They were usually considered cousins since they were born into the family of gods that ruled over Lium. These deities also collectively and sometimes separately at times especially the principal guardians were gods over specific games played by the gods and mortals.

name: Castias
description: The renown, had large arms that help him close the gates during war.

name: Brohmen
description: Long hair that defended him against magical attacks.

name: Zackxus
description: Armor that made him immortal as long as he wore it. A nymph tricked him into bed where he removed the armor and was killed by her. The nymph was really a vengeful spirit sent by the Valkens to sneak into Lium.

name: Gladios
description: Father of gladiators of which his name is derived

name: Sisten
description: Daughter to a king and Olerta. She could predict movements and sense weak points in anything

name: Bornish
description: Goddess of the harm, she had the power to heal almost any wound. She could also project herself to any known location

name: Gilden
description: Principal guardian to the east. He was the god of Sports and Gymnasia. He was called upon to take watch over specific games played by mortals. He was also the name that was prayed upon when someone wanted to win.

name: Milstrum
description: Principal guardian to the west. God of Horsemen, his post at the gates of Lium, like his brethren was limited as he often went to Earth to watch over and guide horsemen on their journeys.

name: Kildsa
description: Principal guardian to the north. She was the ill faced goddess of Patrons, she protected sailors and blacksmiths. She was a lover to one man of which is usually seen next to her as a spirit. The man was killed by her for betraying her love and for his punishment she declared his soul as her forever companion.

name: Aeolis
description: Principal guardian to the south and lover to Jessana. His long black and gold hair was sharp as a sword and was used to make weapons. It instantly grew back when cut.

name: Aven
description:
Rank: Goddess of Childbirth and pains of labour

When Eve was cursed by GOD to bear the pains of labor. Aven was sent to watch over and help her through birth of her sons. Since then, the diety did the same for nearly every birth. Her maidens are humans who share her name and also help give birth although they are forbidden to ever give birth themselves.

name: Hapsta
description:
Rank: Goddess of Happiness, Cheer, and Merriment

With giggles of a newborn, Hapsta, word happiness is derived from her name and is the meaning of it, Hapsta was annoyling the deity seen always smiling regardless of any situation and as such she was painted this way.

name: Wvesta
description:
Rank: Goddess of Ranks and War

Seen as a stripped suited woman. She was Nextis youngest child and newest appointed general in his wars. She was very still and cared of nothing but war management.

name: Olmindahi
description:
Rank: God of the soft touch

The Elitsyians believed that soothing pain of illnesses were the cause of an invisible deity. His father was Jonun and his wife was a resident nurse in a local village where he was worshipped.

name: The Rankings
description:
Rank: Collective of Human Gods

Children and several were lovers to the principal goddess of love and beauty, Jessana. The Rankings were numerous deities devoting themselves to human beliefs and systems. Many orchestrated a system for things like marriage, human order, and love making. While others help create cities and make things often used by humans. Each of them were products of Jessana and a different mortal man.

name: Glideus
description: God of Weddings, this elder deity used his beard to play the marriage hymn. It was so beautiful that it was recorded and replayed throughout time.

name: Lovi
description: Goddess of Sexuality, she recognizes different sexualities and often plays a part in the thinking of these choices. The word love is derived from her name.

name: Bitrue and Aoma
description: Are the twin god and goddess of Plays, musicals, and rythems. They are the personification to the Greek Muses. They have been prayed on during plays.

name: Imet
description: God of Music, Song, and Dance. A playful boy that has a very musical charm. He is one of the fondest children and lovers to the deity Jessana.

name: Ckolden
description: God of Betrayed Love, a despiteful deity. Once lover to Jessana, he was punished by the goddess when he was found raping two boys. The two boys became stars in the night sky after their death and he was sent to guard the gates to Hell. While guarding the gates, his skin and organs were eating every day and night while he screamed in agony.

name: Pancrea
description: Goddess of Connection, the youngest of the Rankings. She built the connection that once connected all the lands.

name: Lurita
description: Goddess of Curatives, youngest child to Jessana and Jonun. Because of Jonun secreative nature, this product was left out of his legend. For this, she associates herself with Anatisu, her lover. The two deities parented the medicine man, Well.

name: Aphro
description: God of Seductive nature and speech. He was the constant if not main lover to Jessana. Upon birth, she loved him so much, she made love to him while still a child and instantly he turned into a man. From this moment he would never leave her side and for this he was forever blessed with beauty. He was also considered the God of Persuasion because of his persuasive nature.

name: Seta
description:
Rank: Goddess of Panic

Always in a constant panic, this deity bosted about not fearing anything until a giant spider monster scared him straight out of his home. The story goes that he was so friegten that he was called the God of Panic because of his worry that the spider would return. For this panic behavior is a product of his and those that experience it, owes it to his persuasive behavior.

name: Somir
description:
Rank: Medicine Man of the Gods

As Well is the medicine man amongst the humans and a deity in his own right. Somir is the medicine man of the gods. He crafted magical potions and numerous curatives for them including potions that can strip or bestow immortality. One of his many consorts is the deity Lovi and Lurita both children to Jessana.

name: The Ocieans
description: The Ocieans were three beautiful and seductive goddesses who in the name of their father, Crochen sung songs so beautiful that any man nearby would get trap in their spells. These songs however were demonic tunes that brought anyone who trespassed onto their territories without an invitation to their deaths. They were seen as half fish and half bird like women who could create the illusion as a woman from the victim’s life.

name: Huluhu
description: Huluhu was a crab deity that created the cities of the Mermadic Kingdom. His voice was so deep that it crashed ships when heard. Once a normal crab, he was given magical powers by Tininuota to guide his 7 daughters.

name: Tininuota
description: Tininuota was supreme mermaid that looked similar to the Roman Neptune, he was a merman that ruled over all mermaids and mermen and creatures of the Mermadic Kingdom. He was a seed that was planted by Crochen. From one night he laid 1,000 eggs that became the first mermaids and mermen.

name: The 7 Daughters of Tininuota
description: The 7 Daughters of Tininuota were so beautiful that they could seduce even women. Unlike the Ocieans they didn't hate mankind but adored them and on their lands they left several treasures such as the diamond, pearl, and crystal. In return man gave them clothing and left them ships. The daughters then made one of the ships into a floating city and covered it with a fog. This fog would then lift the ship at the same time keeping the daughters nourished as if they were underwater. Each of the daughters had mystical powers and together they knew the longer above ground they would lose their mermaid like appearance and become more human. Still with their mystical abilities, the daughters would each conquer a country and populate it. Their legends would create several societies and legendary stories throughout the middle east. One of the daughters brought people to the now Asia.

name: Krita
description:
Rank: Painter with magical powers

Krita was a great painter and when she was a little girl she painted a magical painting and gave it to the gods. At the midst of night the paintings came to life and enslave half the gods in bendable chains. These chains were the first sign of rubber. Krita is wife to Tama and mother to the bears.

name: Ahane
description:
Rank: Dragon Slayer – Demi God

Ahane was the great dragon slayer and one of the many mortal children to the god Born'. When born, Born' conjured great dragons from the farthest corners of the world to challenge his son and when Ahane killed the 7 dragons he became revered around the country. Ahane met the beautiful princess Nojikuach and the two had a beautiful son, Akeni who died years later because of a wild boar. To bring his son back to life, Ahane did several trials conducted by Montum to prove he worthy. But after the trials Montum stated that in order to get his son back that he couldn't look upon his sons face as he would be bound to the underworld forever. At this moment Ahane was very happy but like mortals he turned back to see the look on his son's face. Then Akeni turned into a monster and Montum turned him into the leader of demons. From this Ahane cried for forty days before he killed himself and his wife. In the afterlife Ahane became lover to Montum and turned into the Judge over the dead. Here he was the judge over the evil dead.

name: Dilpor
description:
Rank: Has golden touch

Dilpor can turn anything he touches to gold. Born of the Sisian King, Melio and one of the Vitinct who King Melio met while buying weapons from the Black Market in the Other World. Dilpor later took his father's thrown and became king of Sisia of Lostasia.

name: Mackitosh
description:
Rank: Warrior of the Gods

Mackitosh is the warrior of the immortals. Sent to earth to battle thousands of demons, he was given the sword of immunity to protect him from anything in the living world. Unlike the many other cultures, Mackitosh wasn't the only or main warrior and although he had great strength, indestructible weapons, great agile, knowledge of the gods, and the gift of flight. With great speed, Mackitosh defeated an entire army without even been seen and from his great knowledge came wisdom no other mortal bared. Son of a Sondred and Domaedian, Mackitosh rested amongst the gods because of his great abilities, he was given longevity however not immortality and would be given the title as protector of all things including the gods. But one day his mortal curiosity came about and he left to Earth where found the Pool of Desire and met several protecting spirits that seduced him into drinking from it. Once he drunk a drop his deepest dreams and desires came true unleashing them on the world. Montum took advantage of his unleashed dreams by unleashing demons onto the world to join the rampage. Now with demons, evil spirits, and other creatures of the dark lands on Earth, the gods had to act very quickly. Born' sent several deities to cure Mackitosh so he can assist in the battle. The battle lasted for 13 days and within this time the world was ripped from the ground to the skies. The gods shocked at its appearance told mankind that the 13 day of the Demon War would be remember for all days and so the number 13 itself by most societies were considered a cursed number. On the 14th day Mackitosh used his great speed and strength to rebuild most of Lostasia and with powerful magic by the Sondreds the island city would return to normal but not without new flaws.

name: Arkylentese
description:
Rank: Guardians of the Golden Honey

Arkylentese are the guardians of the Golden Honey “honey that gives immortality”. Whenever seen they can't refuse a fight and so they fight often as they love to wonder among crowds. So beautiful that Santiyline sealed them away in a secret garden hidden away in the Sea of Time.

name: Well
description:
Rank: Medicine Man

Well the Medicine Man, practices in magical healing found this Indian from the Eastern world becoming more and more popular leading him to be inducted into the Elitsyian society. His growing popularity caused the gods to bring him to the Heavens and given immortality. God of Healing and Prophecies, Well is father to Ni is complete opposite.

name: Sole
description:
Rank: First Shaman

Sole the first shaman is son to Sesir. The second healer to the world he follows the footsteps of his teacher, Well. His main worship is in cities near forests, jungles, lakes, and newborn places. He assists in childbirth and warfare.

name: Wonder
description:
Rank: Cupbearer of Born’

Wonder or Wur is a boy that was so curious of the world around him that he wondered away from his parents into a lake and drowned. Born' took his spirit to the Heavens and the two made love for forty days until he would revive the boy and made him into his personal cupbearer.

name: Takinewa
description:
Rank: None

Takinewa was so beautiful that men around the globe wanted her for their own and thus many protected her from the dark forces. But one emperor of Kinota, an island of Lostasia, granted her with a gift from the Heavens and promised her eternal youth and beauty. But Takinewa denied this gift and remain among her family in Mountainville. Here she ate one of the beautiful blossom flowers that tasted like cherries, little did Takinewa knew these cherries were gifts from the emperor of Kinota. In the morning the emperor visited Takinewa and told her of his gift and Takinewa begged him to take his gift back but couldn't. So Takinewa knowing of her immortality knew she couldn't bare watching those she loved grow old and die without her so she slowly floated off to the moon where she made home. Her family grief stricken by her absence made temples and planted blossom gardens with cherries in her honor. To show his ever fetching love to the maiden, the emperor of Kinota had his followers plant a giant pink flower blossom with special healing blue berries. The special berries were so light that each spring they floated into the air, where Takinewa collected them to build her palace on. From the rocks of the moon that the people of Kinota believed where colorful and glowed in the dark given the moon its shine she made her palace and filled it with berries. These berries became people or moon people that had long dress like legs and beautiful long blue hair. Whenever they dance the moon go through different phases. Takinewa was so enchanted by her people that she presented their gift to the world and it became an art form known as the Moon Dance.

name: Creatus de’ Inobulus
description:
Rank: None

Creatus de' Inobulus were humans that were believed to exist before even the gods. The Elitsyians believed that the world once was very beautiful and went untouched until the gods came about and later created mankind. But they also stated that just how the world would be rebuilt after Mostibik it would be the second time that it would be reincarnated. The first time was before their current stories and the race of humans that lived in that world created the gods and their universe out of images. These humans were so powerful that they went unmatched. But one fateful days, the Elitsyians wrote that the Creatus de' Inobulus which in return meant “tribe of creators” disappeared into nothing and destroyed their world in hopes that their powers would not plague future tribes. The Elitsyians later wrote in text that this race of humans ascended into the sky still watching over us unheard and unseen.

name: Sondreds
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Wizards & Sorcerers

They are usually cloaked and very wise mortals who served the High Council. Found mostly in their own world hidden from sight of the gods and mankind, they could be called upon by a spell. One of the most powerful Sondreds was Oki and his wife Hodi, their eldest child was Hoj. Hoj was known to the middle east mostly Arabians was called Hoji King and father of the Djins. Concern for the magical world's safety, the Sondreds appointed the strongest and most powerful group of warriors serving the magical communities called the Lazarons. Its name meant “prisoner of magic” they are simply called this by the descendants of the original Elitsyians.

name: Doki
description:
Rank: Holder of the Key of Humanity

Doki was once imprisoned in the underworld by King Barbas for his trick on Mt. Punukien kingdom. This magical elf used his magic to break free but not before being harassed by soldiers of the dead. After much debate he agreed for his freedom in return protecting and hiding the Key of Humanity. At the end of time he would present the key to the savior of mankind.

name: King Barbus
description:
Rank: Human King of Mt. Punukien

One of the first and foremost powerful emperors ruled over Mt. Punukien. His name was King Barbus he was believed to have been the creator deity Anatisu in disguised. On Earth he conquered many lands but none of which stood as proud as Mount Punukien. Born from the gods, Barbus had many wondrous abilities such as turning things into gold with just one touch. This gift was denounced on him from Volcanos, the Blacksmith God of Elitsyian Mythology. In his early childhood, Barbus had already built his city from the rocks and made glass structures from water and crystals found at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. Alone in his new city, Barbus begged and pleaded to the gods for people to share his new world with and the gods so fonded of Barbus granted his wish by giving him some of the first inventors, teachers, scholars, and farmers of the world.

name: Important Families of Elitsyian Mythology
description:
Rank: Important Families

One of the most interesting families in Elitsyian Mythology was Clemide and her father Talex. Clemide's mother was a mystery because of Talex constant love affairs, but one thing is for sure that her beauty was a story that only the gods could tell until now. During her youth, Clemide's father Talex has promised her to anyone that could boast the strength, intelligence, and speed that could take his thrown as heir. Over 1,200 men tried to test their abilities but none here on Earth has matched such a feat as Talex was not just a king but a demi-god. Talex born to Born' and his mortal mistress, Hanna. He was given his great strength, great speed, vast knowledge, and persuasive attitude from his father Born' along with the city of Talamade “a city located in eastern Lostasia”. For moments Hanna was the first and only mortal mistress to Born', until Crienta intervened and turned her into stone. But before her final state, Hanna gave birth to Talex. Still angered at Born' Crienta created a city known as Linius which stood as the capital of Lostasia throughout the continent's history. And from this city came the Lininians who stood beautiful but hidden with brute and anger. The Lininians under Crienta's word raged war against the people of Talamade which later would last for almost ten years. In victory was the Lininians who later consumed the city and took half of Lostasia as their own. In return, Viken “storm god and son to Lo and Adv” watched from the heavens at Clemide since her birth where he more and more fell in love with her over the years. It wouldn't be until years later that the two would meet and married. -But lets talk about Clemide a little more in detail before her city was overruled and before Viken married her-. Once along time ago around 1 B.C. the beautiful princess Clemide was sworn to anyone who could overthrow her father and take his thrown. But Clemide had different plans for herself and her future. On the night of her 16th birth date, Clemide who was destined to wed, told her older sister, Clode, that she didn't want to marry someone who she didn't know. You see, Clode was married off to her arranged husband, Prince Mumu of Munuki City. She told her younger sister Clemide, who she left behind, that she would always overlook her as her guide and act as her mother figure. So now that we got that out of the way, lets get back to Clemide. She told her sister of the arranged marriage and from then on so content for her sister not to marry the way she did, Clode offered to leave her kingdom with her sister so they could direct their own lives. This became one of the prime examples of women empowerment and independence. This act of treason became such a matter in Munuki City and Talamede that it caught the attention of their respected kingdoms after their women started to revolt against the men. This march of independence and female empowerment also made its public debut among the goddesses of the heavens as well. Supporters became Authora, Crienta, Olerta, Smod, and surprisingly Jessana. With Clemide and Clode both on the run their kingdoms both sent out hundreds of soldiers to find them. But this would be no easy task as all the goddesses mentioned above, covered their every traces. For years the sisters would be in hiding until being found through the efforts of Born', Nextis, Jakilen, and again another surprise Montum joined the alliance. As you see back in those days men controlled the world and the male deities wanted it to stay as such. But Montum didn't care of such alliance, he wanted both women to be his queens in the underworld along with his current queen. Now with a war above their heads, it would only get worse for Clemide and Clode as Montum intent on bringing them to the underworld sent his army of harpies and skeleton warriors down. But with the other gods fighting one another for independence, the sisters were own their own. Viken looking at all this commotion did what any warrior would do which was to save the damsels in distress. So from the heavens he reign down with thunderbolts lighting up his chariot and swirling tornadoes lifting the skies for his arrival. In one instance, Viken destroyed the undead army and the harpies and rescued the sisters. He then took them away from the other gods and hid them in his fortress. Surrounded by dark clouds it was hidden even from the other deities so they were safe. Now a year has past and Viken has grown in love with the youngest sister, Clemide, and it was certain it was returned. The two took hands and went back to her father's kingdom, there Viken overthrew Talex and his army and took Talex's thrown. Here Viken ruled alongside his new bride for years until finally receiving a male heir.

name: Monius Castius
description:
Rank: Ruler of Talamede

Viken and Clemide's son would be Monius Castius and once old enough he would too take over his parents kingdom of Talamede. He would become the first ruler to extend the kingdom. From the east side to the north side he expanded overcoming other lesser cities and enlarging both. But Crienta not one to be conceived as the jealous type felt this kingdom should be overruled by a women. So she built her city and led her army of Wareins (Amazons) to Talamede. After forty nights of war, the Wareins (Amazons) took control and drove the royal family from their thrown. Monius and his parents were now enslaved by the Wareins (Amazons) and so Crienta gave control to her children's first queen, Melina.

name: Nackson
description:
Rank: First Author & Inventor

Nackson probably was the most important as his stories the Maenaid was a collection of books that were found by the Anlicks and told of almost the entire history and belief systems of the Elitsyians and their neighboring islands. Nackson was beloved by all because of his major contribution to literature. Authora first and foremost credited him as the first author but also with his invention of the chariot the first inventor as well. Seen from above, Volkanos grabbed Nackson and brought him to the heavens. He agreed to give him immortality as long as he serve several years with the god in the heavens building items. But little to Nackson's knowledge the time in the Heavens aren't the same as on Earth. So when he returned to his family they have grown old nearing death and when asking Volkanos for immortality to them as well the god refused. So he then asked could his immortality be token back and still the god refused because Nackson made a promise and his time wasn't up. So back in the heavens, Nackson knowing of his fate if ever to return to Earth, he agreed to remain in the heavens but only if he could build great objects not just for the gods but also for mankind. To this Volkanos agreed and got his first assistant. From his disappearance, Nackson became such a household name, that people started worshiping him with being the God of the Household and associating him with protecting them.

name: Melina
description:
Rank: Amazon Queen & Queen of Linius

Melina was not just beautiful but strong, agile, and very intelligent as she was Crienta's personal creation. Viken would loose his power and his son Kanos would take his place as the world's personal warrior and Storm God of Elitsyian Myths. Viken and Clemide would fall into the backgrounds alongside Monius Castius. and Melina would take control naming her new city, Linius “worth”. She then with her Wareins (Amazons), would seize power of neighboring villages and cities some of which were Talamede and Munuki City. Prince Mumu became her husband after bowing to her power and Melina and the prince would give birth to the first official royal founders of half of Lostasia. Linius became Lostasia longest staying capital and the largest city ever found in Lostasia.

name: Anme
description:
Rank: First Scholar & Second Author

Anme was the son of two local farmers in the Western part of Lostasia. Here he thought his destiny was forever to live on a farm until he was visited by a Selenes. Here the spirit told him of his gift to write stories and from them would inspired the world. Following this, Anme bid farewell to his life on the farm and begun traveling the world sharing his ideas with others. Some of his best works today tell of some unknown tribes, several mythical stories, and his ideas about geography. This inspired others like the Greeks Plato and Homer. He then traveled to Africa and met with several cultures that shared his idea of creation and the world around them. He then came back to Lostasia where he told of his ventures and then wrote his first book, the Intilliad which spoke of other cultures and contained over 1,000 different stories about those he visited. Other great items of his was the most famous, the Trankit which told of most of his findings of the Elitsyian Myths.

name: Geni
description:
Rank: Clay People

One of the hardest working class of people who were mentioned in the Intilliad was about the Geni. They existed around the beginning of Lostasia and survived several generations until their sudden disappearance. Although much of nothing is known about them, some relations support them with being made from clay and wet stones and given brains to function on their own. Their physical images were similar to cavemen with hairy bodies and very limps limbs. Some say that their disappearance was because the gods were so ashamed of their creation that they destroyed them and replaced them with the people of today. Others say that the Geni would be our spirits always living through our bloods as one of the first races on Earth.

name: Lord Cao
description:
Rank: Ruler of Ble’

A brute and unkind king, Lord Cao was ruler over a quaint town called Ble'. Here he enslaved his people and tortured them with the help of his army. But word would get out and eventually get to the gods. He was given a choice to treat his people better or suffer a worse fate. Lord Cao ignored this warning and so the gods turned him into a crow. From him came the first crows of which in return watch over the city he once ruled. In his absence, the people of Ble' would form the first democracy that would call for no one ruler but several that would give law and order to all people.

name: The Hoins
description:
Rank: People of city, Ho

The Hoins were people of the city, Ho. They were especially known for their exceptional gold coins and as silversmiths. Their prime deity was Aspel who was also worshiped by the Muonch People.

name: King Hapita
description:
Rank: King of World Town

King Hapita was in the middle of one of his journeys through the forest that existed behind his kingdom, when he found the lost blanket of the god, Ongrude. His kingdom a place known as World Town “known for its treasure, jewelry, magnificent wonders, and vast schools” was never happy with what they had so he presented them with the night blanket so they could sleep. You see this town was a place where no one slept just worked all day everyday and because of this they were some of the bitterest people in the world. But after the blanket was given to them they became even more wealthy, dreams, and immortality. This alerted Ongrude and he took his blanket back and punished the entire town by putting them in an eternal sleep.

name: Aere’
description:
Rank: Magical Painter

A skilled painter that painted Mun, Goddess of the West Wind as a gift to her favorite goddess, Adv. Adv then took the painting and brought the deity to life. From this beautiful gesture, Aere' was given immortality and from that moment word spread making Aere' the patron of painters, artists, and visual ideas.

name: Nojikuach
description:
Rank: Dragon Mother

This once beautiful young girl sold her soul to become a dragon. But this decision wasn't just made one day and then given to her. She had a reason and it would surprise not just those that knew her but the gods as well. To understand you have to understand her situation which was of her husband Ahane a powerful warrior that slain the 7 headed dragon that threatened their home. But the dragon's mother was angered and poisoned Nojikuach killing their unborn child. Nojikuach was so sad that she agreed that she would become servant to the dragon mother by selling her soul. This would in return her son to life to live out his years alongside his father. The two would then become great heroes fighting in the honor of their lost one.

name: Akeni
description:
Rank: Son of Nojikuach

The unborn son to Nojikuach. When Nojikuach became pregnant, a dragon mother poisoned her because of her husband Ahane killed her son. In return, the dragon mother did the same. But because of Nojikuach sacrifice of herself, Akeni was given the gift of life and lived alongside his father and a great fighter.

name: Melio
description:
Rank: Sisian King

The Sisian King that ruled with great honor over his people of Sisia. Probably one of the only kings in Lostasia that ruled in favor of his people. Sisia was a proud little town that lived in peace throughout its existence and never experience any kind of war or debate. It lied somewhere in the far eastern part of Lostasia. He had a son, Dilpoor who was a product by one of the Vintinct. After Melio's death, Dilpoor took control of his kingdom and became king of Sisia.

name: Nakquia
description:
Rank: Emperor of Dowling Village

Nakquia became one of the first female rulers, she was one of the many queens of the Wareins (Amazons). Once her reign was over, she was replaced by Melina, the ruler over the Lininians. Once no longer an Amazon, Nakquia gave up her weapons and founded a tribe of men and enslaved them with the help of magic from the Other World. She then became the first female emperor of the Dowling Village.

name: Cylene
description:
Rank: Wife to Nextis

Mother to Acnar and once lover to Nextis, God of War. She died shortly after his birth, but from the underworld she watched and weeped at her son becoming destructive and killing others for not worshiping him. Her tears became such a bother by the spirits of the underworld that they turned her into the first Weeping Tree. Its roots reach into the world around every Fall and cause other plants and trees to weep. Cylene is often considered the personification of  Fall and the reason why plants change colors and why plants dies.

name: Mint
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Astrologer

A great astrologer for the Elitsyians. His people turned to him for answers from the stars. His name would be written down in every book and with it came his most memorable works. Along with the goddess Night, he would father to Lena.

name: Ushu
description:
Rank: Princess of the Mushin Kingdom

Princess of the Mushin Kingdom. With Sentos, God of Might and Power, she would give birth to the entire Mushin Kingdom and serve as its rulers for the first thousand years. Ushu was granted immortality from the Golden Honey river which she drunk from in silence when she protected it. Because she drunk from it however, she was banished to Earth where she met Sentos and fell in love with shortly after.

name: Pridie
description:
Rank: King of Kinota

Probably one of the most famous emperors to Lostasia. He was ruler over the kingdom of Kinota. He fell so much in love with Takinewa and offered her magical blossoms planted below his kingdom for the price of youth and eternal life. When Takinewa denied this offer, the emperor repeatedly tried again and again. Until one day when Takinewa ate one of his plants without knowing and was given the gift that Pridie promised. So disgusted at this, Takinewa left to the moon where she remained for eternity. In her honor, Pridie and his followers planted blossoms throughout the world and built her a giant blossom palace which floated to the skies and where Takinewa accepted. For protection from this moon deity, people are enthused that they plant blossoms around their homes in honor of Takinewa.

name: Jonireres
description:
Rank: People of Jonira

The Jonireres were a race of prideful people found in Jonira. See Chapter 8 under Jonira for a full description of this race and their beliefs.

name: Pridest
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of Buddhist

The next group of people are a mixture between spirits, a person, and somewhat worshiped as a god. To Buddhism they are Buddhist, but to the Elitsyians they are wiseman known as Pridest. Usually seen marked with the the language of ancient spirits, they old men and rarely women usually live in temples hidden from plain sight. Here they sit meditating for years trying to reach enlightenment. Whether or not it actually works is left to the imagination of the people who worship them. But it is written that when they reach enlightenment they become spirits that spread their teachings and what they learn. They serve as healers of mortal pains as along with teachers of those that follow them.

name: Rosh Empire
description:
Rank: People of West Island

The Rosh Empire were once farmers who took over the West Island in hopes to leave their barren lands. They came from the west in search of a fertile land with new opportunities. With just spears made of wood and corn they managed to raid the recent civilization that lived on the West Island. Those that lived in the West Island were known as their descendants. It was not told of one specific ruler but some could think that they brought some sort of order because there was no recorded war of this race or of Western Island. Just like the other islands of the Four Corners, the Rosh Empire worshiped the presence of gods and creatures that they thought lived around them.

name: Uchawatis
description:
Rank: Tribe of Whurashia

The Uchawatis was a tribe that shared the island Whurasha with the Ics and the Resumes. Some would say that this tribe had little to offer unlike others because it only existed in some stories and even then they are not as popular as those around them.

name: Ics
description:
Rank: Tribe of Whurashia

The Ics were a tribe that shared their island along with the Uchawatis and the Resumes. With their major support for their deities, the Ics probably were the most important tribe on this island. Their supreme deities were the most powerful of all the islands and granted many other tribes to enter in their ideas which also collected one of the most important and biggest mythical stories of all western tribes.

name: Resumes
description:
Rank: Descendants to Anme & First Writers

The Resumes were not as important as their twin tribes, the Uchawatis and the Ics. But they could be seen as the first writers and from them came Anme one of the first scholars. Resume derives its meaning and name both from this tribe. The Greeks would later adopt this word into their language.

name: Mukkukku People
description:
Rank: People of Sune

The Mukkukku People of Sune were in small numbers but had the strength to equal bigger armies. The Mukkukku People are descendants of the Patheons who discovered their city and probably would explain their great strength. The Patheons were known for their great strength and speed, they were a mixture of animals which matched their physical skills and humans which matched their intelligence.

name: Delliana
description:
Rank: First Oracle of Melphi

Delliana was the first oracle of Mephi. Born from the gods, Delliana told many predictions and once predicted the world would come to an end by the hands of the Gods and Valkens. Delliana was the mother to Samantha Cue of Elite Force. She gave her child up after the power it emitted while during childbirth to SAA. She often visits Samantha in her dreams and to help her during missions mentally.

name: Promaiden People
description:
Rank: Steel & Rock People

Worshipers of Ongrude. These people were made of steel and rock. Given life they would appear grander than the people of today, but not to interfere with the future of the mortal race, their appearances were tampered with to appear less intimidating.

name: Akuma-dae
description:
Rank: Priests in Elitsyian Mythology

Blessed with the abilities to perform exorcists’ repell demonic entities, Akuma-Dae are earthbound angels or Domaedians who remember partially of their heavenly divine selves. The Akuma-Dae each have similar symbols around their bodies which are cloaked as if someone sees the symbols, it can be lethal. Akuma-Dae is priests by calling and will only revert to their angelic selves once mankind perishes from the Earth. These beings also possess enhanced fighting skills, enhanced strength, speed, knowledge of the world, and giant weapons (swords, guns, & throwing stars) and also with much training can omit light from their hands.

name: Kalioni Warriors
description:
Rank: Priest like warriors

Working under the leadership and guidance of the Akuma-Dae, the Kalioni Warriors each wear blue like armor and giant weapons. The markings that cover their bodies are protectant spells that can help in defeating demons and battling angelic beings as well. They are chosen at birth and are often powerful when younger however gains worldwide knowledge as their age advances.

name: Mary of Nazareth
description:
Rank: Mother of Jesus

Mary of Nazareth is the proud mother of Jesus of Nazareth and wife of Joseph. She gave birth to Jesus on the night she was visited by three angels known as the Wisemen. They provided her tools to provide to her then unborn child. In later life after Jesus was born, Mary was a devoted mother and wife of Joseph, she watched her son be tortured on the cross and then removed his body after many believed he was dead. She later buried him in a tomb near her late husband Joseph.

name: Joseph of Nazareth
description:
Rank: Father of Jesus

Legal father to Jesus and husband of Mary of Nazareth. He was a carpenter and taught this to Jesus during his youth. He died shortly after Jesus was placed on the crucifix. He believed his son to be dead on his deathbed. Jesus would later be buried at 36 years old next to Joseph’s tomb.

name: Sholls
description:
Rank: Demonic Trolls

Sholls are demonic trolls with a wide range of intelligence. Unlike trolls of celtic mythology these gigantic and mysterious creatures have great minds and incredible strength. Created from swamp water and fungus and given advance brains by Montum these creatures are found more so at night and rarely unless hungry or during war are they mention to be seen in the daytime.

name: Will
description:
Rank: First Unicorn

Will is the first unicorn that flies with the help of white magic. This unicorn is the embodiment of good and purity and often times live amongst the dead but at the same time protecting the magical community. Will was created from the ashes of an angel and given life by Jonun.

name: Lex
description:
Rank: Guard dog of the Underworld

Lex is the 7 headed four tongue, 7 stomach, and 3 stomach hound dog with massive claws and fangs that protect the gates to the underworld. Sitting at the edge of the staircase that leads to the land of the living. This dog could swallow the entire island of Lostasia in one bite. Lex unlike most creatures in the underworld never leaves its post and when caught by Kanos this hound had its heads chop off in time for the god to pass but its 7 heads grew back more fierce than before. Although it holds great strength, agility, intelligence, the ability to speak, a massive body, and supernatural powers Montum would never let it leave beyond the underworld even to assist in Mostibik.

name: Dalspetta
description:
Rank: Scorpion Queen

Dalspetta scorpion queen, she lives deep in the Dark Caverns of the underworld with her demonic children. She appears beautiful through the day and hideous while in the dark, she haves over 20,000 children a day ranging from poisonous animals and insects to impish demons.

name: Wicklings
description:
Rank: Warlocks

Wicklings are warlocks, servants to Bewithia. At night they are wolves and in day they are magical warlocks who attack witches when they are weak to steal their magic. In some tribes in Lostasia Warlocks are male Witches who get their powers from Bewithia.

name: Pjuns
description:
Rank: Male Harpies

Pjuns is a half scorpion and half falcon demons that closely resemble harpies but with their difference being their cries and that they are male.

name: Farmen
description:
Rank: Cave Dwellers

Farmen are cow and bull bodied cave dwellers that builds large caves and laid giant size eggs and at the end of time the eggs hatch and out come several land animals.

name: Mikles
description:
Rank: Dream Eaters

Mikles demonic spirits that crawl into the bed of children and unblessed adults. While there they appear as deform little children that eat away at the nightmares and grow bigger. After all nightmares are sucked dry, the dreamer goes into a coma.

name: Wisnu
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Gargoyles

Wisnu pretend to be statues to trick oncoming travelers. While caught in their arms, creatures' souls are eaten and their bodies are burned with their ashes spread across the underworld for the dead to eat. In some Elitsyian Myths the Wisnu are referred to as Soul Eaters and when in cemeteries they eat away on the bones of the dead. The mummy and skeletons are warriors of theirs. These demonic creatures also haunt the living and attack protector spirits leaving mankind defenseless against supernatural forces.

name: Harpies
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Harpies

Harpies are demonic statues brought to life by black magic. They are led by their mother the Harpy Queen. When she is in-heat she seduces mortal men to help bring her demonic offspring to life. Based on their appearances they are Elitsyian versions of the Harpy and Succubus combined together. Harpies are also known for their shape shifting abilities, great speed, loud screams, and hard rock bodies.

name: Black Brocken
description:
Rank: None

Black Brocken was the giant fish created out of oil and sea water by Tuni to get revenge on his families sacred islands. This creature ate islands and sunk ships and was wrote in stories across the world and explained as the Giant Kracken and the Lockness Monster to just name a few.

name: Yati
description:
Rank: Yeti in Elitsyian

Yati Father to the Olki (yeti in Lostasia) protected his mother, Snow's ice palace. When someone with a warrior’s heart whistles in his domain his children assist them. As for cowards they eat their hearts and spit up a brave warrior.

name: Screechers
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Banchees

Screechers, their screams can shatter glass. They are the product of witches whom died and reverted to black magic to get back at people who done them wrong in life. Their cousins are the Harpies.

name: Likoundeptez
description:
Rank: Caretakers of Children & Mothers

Likoundeptez are caretakers of Children and Mothers, not much is known of these swift creatures only that they are seen by those they protect and whispers things into the victim's ears. They are considered the mortal commonsense.

name: Punokipetes
description:
Rank: Watchers of Families

Punokipetes were watchers of families, with their help families were protected from the dangers of the dark world and on occasions the gods. If a family wanted their protection they had to sell the soul of their first born child, later in adulthood the first born child would become a Punokipetes.

name: Olki
description:
Rank: None

Olki or the Yeti is powerful muscular, bearish, white furry creatures that speak in Elitsyian tongue. They are the children to Yati and helps protects Snow ice palace.

name: Poraficks
description:
Rank: Golems of the Elements

Poraficks six Golems molded from stardust, Air, Wood, Earth, Fire, Water, and Metal, these creatures would be later personified the major elements. They are the children of Volkanos and in the loving memory of his elders he gave them to Crochen, Adv, Santiyline, Tur', and Fire and Metal worked closely with him. They are drawn on stone to instruct the world of their workings. The Poraficks are mostly known for their aggressive behaviors and knowledgeable ways.

name: Jonipers
description:
Rank: None

Jonipers were giant blue coyotes born from the moon's light. With bodies of dead grass, wet soil, swamp water, acid blood, metal skin, and diamond fangs. These creatures were servants of Montum and watchers over the dead. Living in the Black Forest these creatures love to taunt humans and eat animals no matter the size.

name: Tarnetch
description:
Rank: None

Tarnetch are children to Tur' created for his mother to help tend her many landforms and sacred gardens. When they laugh flowers grow and the air cleanses, when they dance rain storms occur and the ground shakes, when they cry the sky turn black and oceans gets tide waves. Tarnetch are tree spirits that serve under Earth Gods.

name: Furdock
description:
Rank: Dessert Creature

Furdock is the dessert Giant whom body compelled of sand and boulders was the first dessert and his eyes came forth the waterfalls of the earth. When he smiles the sun raises and when he sleeps the moon raises. A kind giant but had his evil ways as he was to a prankster that created avalanches to defeat his enemies and destroy those who didn't like him. To please him gods and mortals alike made offerings for him. One time the giant would fall asleep and the world would forever be turn to complete darkness.

name: Trecks
description:
Rank: Wisdom Trees

Trecks are wisdom trees living in Santiyline magical garden. The biggest one can be found in the center of the world where its roots reaches out to every plant life on Earth. Another major tree was the Sggriuidj and it stood in the Heavens. When it was created all life and death hanged from it, from its leaves were the stars and at the tip was the Heavens. Hanging from its branches were planets and the realms of the universe and from the seeds were the lives both mortal and immortal grow and sprout into flowers. When those lives are over they will fall to the ground and sink into the ground where the underworld was awaiting at the roots. This story however was major on the Islands of Lostasia but another creation myth of Elshack and his children overtook most of Lostasia.

name: Agikile
description:
Rank: None

Agikile an imp that can move faster than light, he created mask to trick his enemies and as loyal assistant to Jagnur he commands the Iron God's chariot of snow.

name: Moschiefs
description:
Rank: Rock & Clay Soldiers

Moschiefts are soldiers of rock and clay forged by Ditios and Bow to protect Lostasia from the Atlantians during the Lostasia and Atlantis war. The gods used these stone soldiers to assist them in the final battle. They were given indestructible armor and weapons by Volkanos and immortality by Lome.

name: Coldornes
description:
Rank: None

Coldornes were goat like women who gave authority to Lostasia. They were found formed under an oak tree by Authora and appointed her eyes and ears on Earth. They were so feared by man because of their appearance that they wore necklaces of magic to disguise themselves.

name: Solit
description:
Rank: Watcher of the world

Solit part bat part man watched the world at night and was very close to Seltice. He guided her chariot at night and from his venom could grant anyone immunities to diseases. He thrives on the blood of wrongdoers and the negative energy of spirits.

name: Capa
description: Capa are troll like children that can fly very fast and run at incredible speeds. The Capa are seen in hundreds and are rarely seen apart. They live deep beneath bridges and startles little children as they pass them. While they can only be seen by little children they can sometimes be called Brownies from Celtic Mythology. Their mother was the River Goddess, Mu.

name: Seefors
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of the Siren

Creatures appearing as women when being viewed by non-supernatural beings. When viewed by mortal men, these creatures appear as beautiful immortal women that can take various forms that the man dreams his perfect woman is. Their counterparts are closely similar to the Greek Sirens. These creatures are the watchful daughters and servants of Crochen. They are controlled by the Seefor Queen whose name is unknown but she is elected every 3,000 years and has power that can rival at least 1,000 seefors and trains for about 300 years to become so strong. The triton that she carries resembles her father’s Crochen. The Seefors name means “Sea Floor” in Elitsyian because that’s where their home, the Island of the Seefors is located at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean protected by a giant clam like shield.

name: Mirror Giest
description:
Rank: Mirror Shifter

Powerful creature that can copy any being including Domaedians and Belki, at one point it copied powerful beings like gods and even the Ultimate Good when it appeared in a benevolent form. Over the last thousand years many of its kind died off, leaving only a handful of creatures alive. It lives in the Mirror World and can only be summoned if envoked by a spell over a broken mirror.

name: Monster’s Holdren
description:
Rank: Most powerful monsters

There exists the most powerful creatures in existence and sometimes are considered the first creatures of their kind. They vary in sizes and abilities and were said by the Elitsyians to be the original creatures to first walk the Earth. Some are good and some are evil but together they come together to decide things like territories, history, future, power, etc and are on close watch by the High Council.

name: Baseia & Cambola
description:
Rank: Guardians Of Youth And Old Age

Once children turned into large cats for their trickery on the Groners. These cats are mischievous and only respond to the voice of Bestiny. They are so large that their bodies are twice the size of a normal 6ft male. Their teeth are made of iron and their tails are hard as diamond. Their whiskers are made of gold and their fur are prickly. They guard the Gates of Eternity where their master Bestiny sleeps. Both represent Youth and Old age as seen with their coloring.

name: Dragons
description:
Rank: Elitsyian Gods

In the Eliteverse, Dragons are powerful creatures with each having elemental powers including Fire, Water, power over the Earth, Electricity, Thunder, Air, Light, Darkness, etc. Originally allies and sometimes pets of Sorcerers. In ancient times, dragons were also guardians and guides to the children of Sorcerers, Elementals.

name: Yosubut
description:
Rank: Watcher of the Universe

He was unknowingly intelligent and played with Yonrohs for almost 4,000 years. But Yosubut himself grew much older than Yonrohs and his years were near its end. One night at his bedside, Yosubut knew his final day was near and since he was brought into this world by amateur magic that of Yonrohs he knew his moment was anytime now. So at his final breath Yosubut predicted the future, and saw children of the god killing him of which he would be no more. Because of his means of living, Yonrohs ignored this and left to play. The next day Yosubut disappeared to never appear again and Yonrohs tired of being alone would give birth to several children from multiple parts of his body.

name: Crienta
description:
Rank: Queen of the Gods, Goddess of Creation & Birth

Her hair was of white snow and eyes of bright blinding gold. Her skin was rock hard and because of that she never bled. Her voice was strong and deep and with vast knowledge she was never over spoken not even by her elder siblings. Crienta's might was so feared that not even the Domaedians or the Primordial Ones undermined her. Goddess of Creation & Birth, Crienta wondered often through the Heavens as mother of all even spirits of Heaven & HELL loved her. She could walk on water and fire and her touch could either kill or bring something back to life. So beautiful, flowers and trees bowed to her with no animal tamed or wild would disobey her and all the creatures in any realm would respect her and not to mention her name without blessing it first. Crienta was not without her own flaws though as she created the Bottomless Pit to punish immortals as she thought entities with a vast life span would go unpunished so she created the Bottomless Pit and it stood could appear when summon by great magic. When standing at its end, her brother Montum pushed her in the pit but unknowingly to his knowledge the pit had a curse that for those that fell into the pit not judged they would reappeared. Crienta appeared behind her brother in a glowing light and punished him so she banished him to the pit with the judgment of being guilty for pushing her into the pit. For a thousand years, Montum stayed until he was summoned out and reclaimed his thrown in the underworld. For his summoner punishment was given by Crienta to be banished to a place where no one could return from not even by herself. For this Crienta called on her older sister, Olerta to create Oblivion a vast place as far as the universe with white fog as cold as ice, dying trees, and the spirits that would taunt anyone there for eternity. This place was so deemed and so tortured that it was feared even by the gods, it had no ends to either side and time didn't exist. Here the gods lost their immortalities and their abilities, all else would slowly forget who they are. Olerta created this place and even herself feared it to insure not just anyone could go here Olerta promised that only great power could banish someone or something here. Fearing her own death here, she created safe gates that linked to other realms for escape. These gates were called the Olden Gates and were only seen by those falsely accused. Crienta lived in the biggest chambers of the Liumus and from her bed she could see the entire universe. In her chambers doorways could leave to several realms in the vast universe.

name: Born’
description:
Rank: King of the Gods

Born' was husband to Crienta and Father of the Gods. Like many Kings he had several affairs that put his own existence in jeopardy as Crienta was very watchful of him. In the stories he was a shape shifter and caused much friction with other gods of Lium. He had few journeys but the ones he made he was almost always royalty. In several stories he was a King and in others he was mysterious men who slept with several women to have children with great powers. Most of his mortal children were future kings and queens, some were demi-gods “half mortal, half god”, and there were those who were creatures of the land such as the first dog, cat, & snake. Because of his great powers, Born' was not approached the wrong way by neither man nor immortal. His stature was that of almost great intensity as with great knowledge he had somewhat insanity. In one story he was an old man that foretold the destruction of the city Tole' and another was how he cried to the gods to change him back into his almighty self after he forgot his old ways. On one of his journeys Born' gave birth to Khani the God of Destruction and his eldest son. Together they took control over the Eastern World and enslaved Indians, Aztecs, & Malayans. Back in Lium, Born' return with Khani and presented him as a present to his wife Crienta. But Khani was with not his own devious plan to overthrow all creation killing his father and the other gods in a scheme called the “Boltren”. Later on in this chapter more about Khani will be revealed, but in the meantime Born' is punished after this scheme was found out so Crienta and the other gods discussed at Born' for his creation banished him to Oblivion. Out of his image, Crienta created Vechknur, her new King of the Gods.

name: Vechknur
description:
Rank: New Age King of the Gods

Vechknur was created out of memory for Crienta's now banished husband. For his often tales of adultery and his punishment Vechknur studied Born' and promised to never betray the love of his wife. Little is known of Vechknur but those that speak of him are often not aware of his skill at pottery, swordsmanship, and creation of wings of animals. During the time of the great battle of the gods, Vechknur is often considered as the avatar or image of Born'.

name: Olerta
description:
Rank: Goddess of Realms & Gateways

From her head sprouts out our galaxy, from her breasts life pours and from her eyes sits the ponds where the Sun and the Moon sleeps. In her pocket realm hidden from all else she is by far the most powerful deity, while in the realm of the living her abilities are limited. Olerta had many lesser forms known as Avatars and with them she plays many different relationships throughout history. She was eldest daughter to Anka and eldest sister to Shecknurd. Her most known children are the Galatic Beings and her son is Inkium, God of the Sun.

name: Adv
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Sky, Mother Sky

Her city of worship exists in Montihigh a city found in the southernmost part of Lostasia. Molded after a cloud above Yonrohs' head she was given life and together with her father she constructed herself a husband named Lo'. Together they created the Wind Gods and lived in a floating sky palace known as the Shadikre, there they controlled the winds of Earth and watched over the world. In the Pool of Visions she could visit many places with just a thought and with this she ventured to many foreign lands until she came across a place so divine that she called it her own. This place had buildings of Gold and rivers of blue ice. Its skies were lit with wild flowers and red flowing wine. Its lands were decorated with virgin spirits whom danced in her welcoming. She called these spirits Advians and so here she remained for centuries. Here she would give birth to flying animals such as the falcon, eagles, and the phoenix. But back in her own lands, Adv did not speak of this beautiful place but yet visit it often. To appear kind to mankind she disguised herself with the head of a sparrow and wings of a butterfly. But whenever she’s angry she appears with the head of a bee and tail of a vulture. All these animals were her creations. The pidgin was her messenger and appearing almost half human it was too her creation created to watch those in her domains.
affiliates: Gods of the Royal Family; Sky Gods

name: Dreggizune
description:
Rank: King of the Valkens & Earth God

Dreggizune was big and strong; he stood as tall and fierce as a mountain and roars louder than anything on Earth. Although very scary, he was gentle and was easily persuaded. As for this behavior he was persuaded by Montum, God of the Underworld to help battle Crienta for her thrown. After much thought about this he raged his children the Valkens into a war that would last for an eternity. In the final battle called Mostibik, was told in stories as far as Greece although given different names overtime and through translation with other great myths around the world; that spoke of Dreggizune and how his heart turned cold after the first battle and the mountains started to crumble and volcanoes started to cry out fire. With trees wilting, flowers burned to ash, and animals dying mankind was near its death. It would be on the final day that Dreggizune would be cleanse by an oracle that sent his new soul back down to Earth where he became the Mountain God, Siphnu.
affiliates: Gods of the Royal Family; Valkens

name: Shecknurd
description:
Rank: God of Time & Beginnings

He is the first child to Anka  and from his heart came the spirits of Time, Arcota. When he was born he had so much knowledge that the gods centered him to being the new Ruler over the Universe. But Shecknurd, wanted his silence away from all else so like Jonun his brother he built his own realm overlooking time made out of stars. He had control over all things and stood as the second most powerful being in all creation. Authora goddess of wisdom and Night goddess of the stars are his virgin daughter. He is also simply referred to as Father Time.

name: Siphnu
description:
Rank: Mountain God

Siphnu the Mountain God was the new earth god and avatar to Dreggizune. After Dreggizune was recycled by an oracle his soul was sent back down to Earth and there now as Siphnu he slept under a mountain. As long as he slept he kept the Earth balanced, so to forever keep him asleep creatures of the forest sworn to silence and fought away any noise. Whenever Siphnu awakes the world trembles and if for more than 7 days straight then it would fall into itself.
affiliates: Gods of the New Royal Family; Earth Gods

name: Crochen
description:
Rank: God of the Seas, Horses, & sea-life

Crochen, father of all sea-life is also creator of the horse, fish, and from his left eye sits the oceans of the world. Crochen rides on giant dolphins and his chariots are led by flying winged whales. Despite being a giant, Crochen was rarely seen although mentioned a lot especially by his followers. His fortress lays at the bottom of what is now the Pacific Ocean and is guarded by Mermen and Mermaids dressed in silver jeweled incrested armor. Inside it contains hundreds of halls of which the most known is the main hall where Crochen sits controlling the waters of the world. Accompanied by his wife Oceania, Goddess of the Ocean and sometimes by his eldest daughter Aqua a Lake Goddess, he travels the world's waters in various forms. His most known form is perhaps that of a old man dressed with pearls wrapped around his arms and legs. He is also father of pirates and guide them through harsh storms. But for those who travel unwanted into his domain are greeted by his sharp tooth, boar headed daughters the Seerfors and they would lead the travelers to their dooms by singing deadly songs that could control the minds of anyone nearby. Out of all his children he many that were adapted into other cultures some with similar names and others. Mermaids, Nymphs, Sprites, and the serpent were all his children. Of all his children, Crochen has over 10,000 offspring.
affiliates: Gods of the Royal Family; Water Gods

name: Montum
description:
Rank: God of the Underworld

Always dark figured and bitter, Montum has overshadowed his visions of a peaceful world by turning his idea location as far away from all else. Tall, dark, muscular, long haired God of the Underworld and Ruler over the dead, Montum has always been very fond of young beautiful women and in some accounts dead men who were kings in life. His court along has over 2,000 beautiful undead mortals who gave them their souls in order to receive power or magical amenities while alive. As father or at least king of all Underworld deities he is also the strongest, his castles lied on top of the highest mountain tops in the underworld and the highest point of them were watch towers where his watchful guards the Monkey Devi “watchers and keepers to Montum” watched the dead. Now as for his armor and magical powers, Montum has always been very careful to install powerful amenities into all of his armors and weapons such as his magical cloak which could protect him from powerful spells. His helmet granted him great all knowing knowledge, his armor could protect him from any damage, and finally his magical elixir could heal him from even the deadliest poisons. As for his children he lots of them, like his siblings he fathered thousands and some were his most watchful creatures, the Harpies, Screechers, Banki (Banchee), and the Vampire. Montum also played important parts in judging the dead, whenever one of his 3 sons the Judges of the Dead couldn't come up with the right decision, he balanced the dead heart on side and a bowl of water from his Elixir on the other side. If the bowl was to tip over then the dead was guilty but if no drop was spilled then the dead was innocent. Sometimes the dead could fool even the bowl of Truth from Montum through magical items placed on their graves. Whenever this happened Montum's pet the Doggiglanger “four headed, four armed, four tailed beast” to eat the dead, if the beast spit up the dead then it was innocent and if guilty its soul would be sent to HELL. There were also moments when the dead had equal good and bad and their soul was pushed to appear in the Garden of Eternity where they lived for eternity doing what they did while alive.
affiliates: Gods of the Royal Family; Underworld Gods

name: Santiyline
description:
Rank: Goddess of Nature

Mother Goddess is also the Goddess of Nature and its many wonders. All of her children where perhaps Earth gods or Underworld deities later on as she was associated with the dead after one of her daughters fled to the underworld to wed Montum. Santiyline was beautiful and very graceful and even in her mortal stage she could burn away flesh from the biggest beast with just a laugh. In many ways she had lesser forms which she was associated with and merged into her because of their importance. Anix, Goddess of Crops & Plantations was guardian of the crops of the world and for plantations she was their scarecrow figure and protected them from demons and creatures of the dark. Frenta was Goddess of Milk and Mother of the Cow, Deer, Moose, and Pig, Frenta was pictured as an old hag that laughed continuously and hated all things but the animals in which she protected very close. Progra the Goddess of Insects bore thousands of insects from bees to earthworms. From her skin bore the insects that could swim and crawl, from her fingernails came the earth insects, from her hair came the insects with wings, and from her blood came the snakes, worms, and roaches. Santiyline was associated with fruit as well as her home itself was made of apples and oranges. Seen in her godly form by mortals produced quiet a problem because she was a giant connected to the earth and had hair of rivers and her eyes were the lakes and ponds. Her hair was the grass and from it grew her children the trees. Whenever she smiled the world lit up and brought with it dawn, when she was angry she produced storms and earthquakes. Once when her daughter, Sickle Goddess of Vegetation and the Dark was seen playing in a field just beyond her home, Montum whipped up in his chariot of ice and fire led by howling spirit hounds and invited the deity back to his lair. She accepted and the shortly after married and she sealed her fate to be in the underworld forever. Although Sickle didn't know that she would be bound there forever she was trapped by law of the underworld, Santiyline called out for her daughter but with no answer the goddess flew the grounds of Earth and swept to the Heavens but no one knew of her daughter's location. It was then Santiyline knew it was her brother who have token her and once in the underworld she bound him to the ground and threaten him to free her daughter but he told her of the law and that even the power of Crienta couldn't break it. Santiyline didn't give up so she asked her sister, Crienta for help but like Montum stated she had no power over the laws made by the Underworld so her daughter was lost for eternity. As the goddess cried nature of the world died and animals and mortals alike froze to death. Crienta was alerted by this disturbance and flew to Montum's palace to make a deal if she let him come to Lium for half the year Sickle could be let free. But Montum decided against it stating that although he wanted his seat with the council of gods he wouldn't leave his new wife's side. Then he vowed that he would let her spend half the year above ground while he enjoyed the wonders of Lium and the other half him and his queen took ownership in the regions of his domain. Santiyline happy of this agreed as long as she could at least see her child again, so for the moments Sickle was above ground we experience Summer & Spring and while below the world we had Winter & Fall.
affiliates: Gods of the Royal Family; Earth Gods

name: Jonun
description:
Rank: God of Destiny, Fate, Knowledge, & Life

Jonun was by far the most important deity in Elitsyian Mythology. He was son to Anka, brother to Olerta, Shecknurd, and he fathered the Groners. His only children were always by his side and because of his distant nature that meant he accompanied by them alone somewhere in another realm. He invented the Wheel of Life called the Zornan that spin both life and death. Jonun has always been known as an unhappy god and when asked by a young cheerful Sod why this was so he responded “Unlike you child I had no childhood and never experience happiness because of my role, I worked my whole life. So to answer your tedious question no”. In his kingdom held the transcripts of Existence, they told of every thing's history and with the help of anyone they grew. Jonun was also responsible for godly knowledge being leaked into the human world.

name: The Groners
description:
Rank: Goddess of Fate

The Groners were three sisters with different ages. At times when the mortal world is in distress the three sisters become one crone called the Ashaki Priestess that could precisely predict the past and the future. The three sisters represented the past, present, and the future. The Groners consisted of Hobiwath “past” she was a old woman with several eyes and a staff that could rewind motions around her. Another was Senithia “present” she was the most beautiful and churns the honey of life and from it came the string of existence. On the Wheel of Life she used magical dust for immortals and wet sand for mortals and animals to keep the strings from breaking by the coldness of their realm. Standing at the edge of the Wheel of Life was the youngest Omothin “future” that had two eyes that were blindfolded until the end of all things. Her third eye was placed on her staff the Ordari, it was used to predict the future while she cut the strings of life. Omothin was mother of all Oracles and Prophets and with them she created temples to preside over living things. There father was Jonun and followed him around wherever he traveled. These goddesses are similar to the Norns in Norse Mythology, Moirae, Parcae, and Matres and Matrones and probably influenced their myths as well. There temple were on the tip of the Dobulous Mountain.

name: Authora
description:
Rank: Goddess of Wisdom, Wafare, Cities, Towns, & Teachings

More powerful than other deities, Authora stood so grand that Crienta feared her wrath. Her magic was that of no other and with her power over objects the Elitsyians believe that she is responsible for things not floating off the ground (gravity). She was second in command over the Hall of Time and Knowledge, and becoming the first deity born outside of the Royal Circa to be inducted in it. When all else looked dim, the gods looked onto her for great knowledge and mankind honored her with temples for safety and protection. Her main service was to virgin women like herself as she protected them from harmful objects mostly men who wish to rid them of their virginity. From a fallen branch on the Tree of Knowledge, Authora created the first scholar, from its leaves came teachers, from its roots came schools and homes, from its fruit came the knowledge of the gods and from its bark the brains that humans would need to think on their own. The biggest gift to mankind was the first library made from rock and dirt and it served over 1,000 books made with the memory of the world.

name: As guide on Earth
description: Assisting her cousin in the creation of the Earth Raiders to protect the world against demons, Authora became one of the guides of the group after Tur went missing in the third half of the Earth Raiders saga. Here she took mortal form with limited godly powers. Unable to return to her normal form, she remained on Earth guiding the Earth Raiders and fighting the demonic armies.

name: Jessana
description:
Rank: Goddess of Love, Beauty, Honesty, Eloquence, & Fertility

Jessana Goddess of love, Beauty, Honesty, Eloquence, and Fertility. In her many forms she grant many different societies with many different gifts such as love and reproduction. To North Lostasia she is Goddess of Love and Beauty, in Eastern Lostasia she is in her original form and in Western Lostasia she is Nexus Goddess of Fertility and Growth. While disguised as Nexus because of her lack of worship as Jessana, she is more of a warrior and uses magical arrows to seduce men into falling in love with women. Also she helps with the life cycle and instructed the first woman how to give birth to mankind and supposedly slept with Marlexmade to have Sentos. She created many temples and towns in honor of women and illustrated strategic war plans with her army of supernatural female army. Nexus created magical armor and a magical disk to give to her army to defeat over 200 cities, the first female ruler without a king was of the city Dowling Ville. In her form as Jessana she was more pleasant but when she disobeyed her mother, Crienta's word to remain in the Heavens she mistakenly set free love onto mankind which caused a great burden that nearly destroy the world. But with the help of her children the world returned to normal but now with new emotions of lust, desire, hatred, and war.

name: Ohn
description:
Rank: God of the Sun

His son was Pupu and together they brought the sun across the sky in the morning and at night they rest it in the banks of the Sea of Time. Ohn was brother to Seltice and son to Adv and Born'. At festivals this god is called upon for a great day and wealth. With his sister Seltice he haves the ability to direct the motions of the entire planet. With a magical golden red disk on his head many tribes between Lostasia and Egypt called him their sun god and in Egypt he was called Re' and later Amun Re' the supreme deity. With destructive powers at well the Anuit called him their God of Destruction. He also had similar appearance of the Hindu God of Destruction, Shiva. With a world worshiping him, Ohn made himself a worldwide figure. From the rays from his back to the floating orbs around his body he had intense power and could burn the world if he looked upon it. Pictures are often shown with his head facing away from all else.
