As for his appearance he was very tall, warrior attire, 7 arms, a monkey's tail, and a giant optical disk that erects from his lower back. His long hair is made of brimstone and fire. His reddish face is because his home is located on the center of the Sun. This deity is also called the creator of all things but only in the lower most part of Lostasia.

name: Seltice
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Moon

Seltice was sister to Ohn and Moon Goddess, but was not worshiped solely as such. Her appearance is tall with bluish skin, short hair, white eyes, two giant swords coming from her skin, and 4 arms. Shes very quick and with her cat as her assistant many wonder if she more of a protector of cats then her actual position as a protective goddess of the night. She loved cats so much that she chopped off her own head and replace it with her familiar her cat Thebe. She then grew a tail and rode around on a chariot pulled by two giant cats. Her home was near the Sea of Time where she took the moon at the break of dawn. She would create Febian & Jesia to protect the Cosmic Soldiers during their fights against the forces of darkness.

name: Nextis
description:
Rank: God of War

Nextis God of War is seen as a brute villain that has brought the world over 10,000 wars during the time of Lostasia. His most powerful mission ever was serving as lead general against the gods at the end of time. His allies include Montum and demons. During many of his battles he brings powerful spirits to assist him in battling his opponents. Unlike the Greeks and Romans, Nextis is seen as a more handsome man with little knowledge of anything else besides war and destruction. He is son to Khani and Omitia. His biggest enemy is Kanos the Weather God.

name: Sod
description:
Rank: Goddess of Clouds

Sod was the most beloved daughter to Adv and was appointed as her watchful eye whenever she was gone. Serving also as Goddess of the Clouds, she protected flying animals such as birds and mythical creatures like the griffin and the phoenix. Her chariot was led by falcons, animals who sworn their allegiance with her upon her birth. With her silk skin and pearly blue eyes she is not just beautiful but very adored by men of all ages. Montum was no different with his ever lurking eyes and raging sexual behavior he wanted the virgin goddess for himself. Once playing in her mother's secret garden, Montum saw the young beautiful goddess and was captivated by her from one glimpse. Disguising himself as a bird that sing, flew in and sung to the goddess and at the finish of his song the goddess kissed him and he changed to his true form. Once someone kisses the God on his poisonous lips they are forever bound to him wherever he goes. “So be it” said the god and he took his new bride away to the dangers of the underworld. Once there she was greeted by Sickle who knew who she was and why she was there and was quickly punished. From one story it told that the goddess was beaten every day and night because of her adultery with the husband of Sickle. After he found out Montum quickly returned the goddess so that he himself wouldn't be scorn by a woman as strong as Sickle herself.

name: Lo
description:
Rank: Storm God

Lo, the first Storm God was product of Born' and the sky deity Krum. Whenever Lo was angry he struck the ground with his hammer and the Earth shook. Lo was ill tempered and almost never caught smiling. From his head were feathers that changed colors depending on the storm that was coming. His face was that of a parrot and his arms were wings and he had human hands. He had 5 eyes, the left watched the west, the right watched the east, the top watched the north and the bottom watched the south. The middle eye on his chest saw the past and future and could predict them at will. Covering his lower body with a magical cloak so that the future could not be seen by anyone but him, Lo made sure he protected the future in all cost. His children were the Oracles and Totems “watchful statues of Indian Mythology” were his sons. For years at a time, Lo disappeared leaving his wife Adv to keep after the skies, the reason for his absence was never revealed but some state that he just was not included in stories as he wasn't very adored by mankind. Whenever he return he predicted several prophecies and left again. His last time seen was before the Mostibik where he told Crienta that the final day of Eternity was upon them. From this disappeared again and its not stated if he was one of the gods that perished in the battle or existed afterwards.

name: Viken
description:
Rank: Storm God

Viken, second Storm God was product of Lo' and Adv. He was not as popular as his father but was definitely as strong. From his Axe and hammer he produces some of history’s greatest storms and with his thunderbolts he protected the Earth from demons. He was a warrior and very fond of little children as he thought of them as powerful beings of the future. Unable to see the future, he didn't take much for granted and thus begun training his son to take his place. When he was merged into Lo in later tales he disappeared almost entirely. One account shows him assisting in the Final Battle Mostibik.

name: Onyard
description:
Rank: God of the North & Morning Breath

Son to Crienta, he was born from her left breast and after Crienta found a lump she sliced it off and it became Onyard. Dripping in blood, the young beautiful boy became a man moment later and the blood hardens and became his armor. With hair of white gold, Onyard was very handsome and built to be a warrior; he guided ships from deadly storms and watched over the skies. His wife became Sod and the two had many children. Considered personification of Dawn and the northern breath in which mist and fog covers the air with gentle breezes of warmth and ice. His palace sat at the edge of the Earth balancing the day and night and whenever there was a moment when the two was in one he would loose his powers and the earth would spin into darkness. The lunar eclipse is the effect of this moment. He gave the World Town a place known for its coins, jewelry, books, schools, and hospitals a blanket of wealth and immortality which remained hidden until his return. But when the god never return the blanket was stolen and never seen again, but it has been rumored that King Hapita has the blanket and announces to give it back to the gods to get protection for his kingdom.

name: Sonos
description:
Rank: Messenger of All Gods

Sonos was the Messenger of all Gods and born of Crienta and Barbas “king of Mt. Punukien”. Stories agreed that he was so fast that it only took him about 5 minutes to circle the globe and about 3 hours to circle the Heavens. The gods adored him and granted him free passage to any realm no matter of its limits. Protector of Sheeps and herds and Father of farmers and inventor of the sandals, Sonos was everything wanted in a messenger but he was not alone as there were others.

name: Delvi
description:
Rank: Messenger to Born’

Delvi was a falcon goddess and was born from Born' and a falcon, she boasted great potential but because of her speed she was left out of many journeys. Although she could fly very fast she could barely walk and couldn't run without tripping, thus forcing Born' to keep her in his chambers where she flew messages were they needed to go.

name: Lurasha
description:
Rank: Messenger of the Underworld

Lurasha son to Sonos and the nymph Cukgi, he is deaf and to assist in communication he invented the sign language and brail. Pictures were also described as a teaching of his as a language. Some accounts explain how he introduced it to the Egyptians and Japanese. Later China & Babylonians adapted this idea until it reached half the world away. Because of his special needs Sonos threw him to Earth where was attended by man and made their own teacher and personal messenger. He then related messages from mankind to humans and whenever his existence was needed a special bell was ringed so that he could feel the vibrations.

name: Kanos
description:
Rank: Thunder God

Upon his birth his father Viken and his grandfather Lo merged into one in the stories and he took priority over their previous domains. He was tall, muscular, handsome, and very proud. His strength equal great legends and was constant companion of the Sondreds or Sorcerers of whom he adored. He learned from them the art of magic and how to paint, he presented his paintings with the Elitsyians and taught the artistry of painting on canvas and walls to explain stories and their ideas. Kanos was also considered a War Deity and his chariot covered in vines and stripes of lightning lighting it up in the night sky. His chariot was also led by wolves made of steel and they could speak in every language, a present given to him by Authora. Over the years, Kanos wanted to call Earth his home but because of his status among the immortals, the gods wouldn't let him leave easily. So to let him live amongst mankind the gods gave him 14 trials called the Storm Trials and to make it more challenging he was stripped of his abilities and his immortalities. The first trial was to bear the harsh weather of Teldorn “a city known for its terrible weather and even more terrible creatures that ate the hearts of its people”. After he pass through the city barely alive, he was founded by Gypsies “children of Montum” and was nursed back to health. One Gypsy known for her magical beauty seduced the god but when he denied and left the Gypsy turned to dust, little did he know this was his second trial given to him by the goddess, Jessana. For his third trial, Kanos would have to battle his own doppleganger a favorite test for the god Nextis. For 8 days the battle reign until Kanos knew he had to think differently and so he blinded the doppleganger and stabbed him in his head, the trial was over. For his fourth challenge he had to battle the three headed watch dog of Lium. But because he use to tame the beast he knew its weakness was golden apples, so out of his pouch he pulled half of an golden apple and from then he tied up the beast and granted him back to the gods. The next challenge is making his way through the desert of Despair were souls of the damned roam violently. Here he nearly met his death until he cast a spell that he remembered from his father to use on malevolent spirits and just like that the fifth challenge was over. But now the biggest challenges begun for his sixth challenge he had to make it through the underworld but not before making it across the poisonous river of Delfai. Now on his 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th challenges he must battle the dangerous creatures of the underworld. The first creature was the harpy queen in which he battled hundreds of  harpies until he finally battled the Harpy Queen. While battling her she introduced the Screecher and the two battled Kanos for his 7th and 8th challenge. The two met their ends when Kanos trapped them at the bottom of a lava pit. For his 9th challenge Kanos battled the serpent Snukota who protected the lair of the Mikles “metal and steel bodied demons”. After cutting the serpent in half and using its venom to kill the Mikles, Kanos was now his 11th challenge. Now standing face to face with Goddess of Darkness “daughter to Sickle & Montum” Vic, Kanos fought the demon goddess for years until they both fell to their graves. But determined as he was, Kanos continued on but as a spirit and his next challenge was awaiting and it was the Stone of Arma. With this item he could come back to life but it wouldn't be easy as Montum himself guarded it. Now faced with fighting Montum, their fight crumbled the underworld and startled the dead. In the final moments, Montum raised his sword and Kanos maneuvered it in hitting the stone. The light from the stone revived the thunder god and he struck his thunderbolt on Montum's sword and the stone and caused the two weapons to wipe out anything nearby including Montum. He then defeated Montum and he left to the Heavens for his judgment. For his accomplishment he was given rights to live with man and later joined Elite Force in the modern day world.

name: Re’
description:
Rank: Vengeful giant birds

Re' were vengeful winged spirits that looked like beastly vultures with some human features. They were born from the rotten heart of Montum and given to Sod as a present but because of her return to the Skies she refuse but the Re' remain. Whenever someone or something abuse a promise or break their oath the Re' tears their hearts out, this idea became so popular that the gods adopted this and the Re' were given immortality and abilities strengthen but to the Gods surprise they were victims to. Now deities of Elitsyian Mythology swear on their creator Elshack as once stated by Nextis God of War “By the strength of Elshack I swear I will not hurt you” when he broke his promise toward the Village of Nomick instead of his heart his immortality was stripped for a week and he was then tortured by the Re' in repeated order. There are usually 8 flying creatures consisted of being the Re'.

name: Tuchorent
description:
Rank: Guardian of Skies

Tuchorent is the fish headed guardian of the skies. It lived on the highest mountain with its gills raised to the sky predicting the patterns of the weather. It served as the official and first weather watcher and almost all its predictions were correct. Tuchorent had the head of a fish and the lower body of a Buddha.

name: Hodribitch
description:
Rank: Rain God

Hodribitch was a minor Rain God with the head of a cricket. His only major contribution was to the eastern part of Lostasia where he was worshiped with groups of temples and considered a major rain deity.

name: Mun
description:
Rank: Goddess of West Wind

Mun is Goddess of the West Wind and mostly minor goddess. Seen with the head of a voodoo doll and paper fans for hands she was a painting done by Aere' until the Sorceress Bewithia made her real and presented her to Adv. Adv loved her so much that she made her part of her kingdom.

name: Altum
description:
Rank: God of Eastern Winds

Altum son to Adv and Lo was one of the only Wind gods to separate him from the world. After he went into hiding he was written out of the myths that once worshiped him. He is still called the God of the Eastern Winds.

name: Bar
description:
Rank: God of the Southern Winds

Bar is son to Adv and her son Viken. When Adv set eyes on her newborn, she immediately made him into her new king after Viken disappeared and he became God of the Southern Winds. Together they gave birth to the Siloutettes.

name: Siloutettes
description:
Rank: Nymphs of the Skies

Siloutettes are bird like maidens so beautiful that if looked upon they could turn the looker to stone. They are usually called the spirits of voices. To the Greeks they are merged into one deity known as Echo. In the mornings they sing to raise the sun and at the edge of the night they dance to raise the moon. When angered the song and dance to eclipse the world in complete darkness.

name: Nulmu
description:
Rank: Watcher of humans

Nulmu or Numu is a giant piercing eye that looks over all creation. It was created by Elshack to watch over his many inventions including life. Human and animal eyes were created in image of the Nulmu.

name: Sha
description:
Rank: Sky Goddess

Sha is a minor Sky Goddess that was worship on the Islands of Lostasia. Sha lives on a hidden island found somewhere near Lostasia.

name: Danes
description:
Rank: Protectors of the Sky Kingdom

Danes were Bird protectors of the Sky Kingdom, they screamed so loudly that thunderstorms happened wherever they were. Symbols of thunderbolts were found on their wings and each had a different color feather erected from their scalps.

name: Keper
description:
Rank: Watch God

Keper the three headed watch god was so curious of things around him that Adv put him in charge of watching over the world. His left eye could see the East, his right the West and the lower could see the south. With the help of swallows he rode off on a chariot watching the north.

name: Chief Munosokupoleses
description:
Rank: Sky God

Chief Munosokupoleses was Chief Sky god and eldest child to Adv. He was worshiped around the world in hundreds of different forms. To the Indians he would overlook their skies and watch their forests. With one eye always asleep his over 500 watched the Earth day and night. When his one sleeping eye would awake it would foretell the end of the world.

name: Chase
description:
Rank: God of the Winds

Chase God of the Winds was worshiped only on the Islands of Lostasia where this deity gave birth to the hamster, rabbit, and squirrel. These creatures had great speed and adopted his agility to live on land as he watched them from the heavens. His mother was Adv and his father was Chief Munosokupoleses.

name: Voloman
description:
Rank: Messenger of the Wind

Voloman was Messenger of the Wind and son to Sonos and Adv. He built wings for birds and fathers the duck, seagull, and the flying fish. He planted eggs that became clouds.

name: Kano
description:
Rank: Creator of the Sky Gods

Kano was the Latin speaking rabbit that moved so fast behind him came the winds of earth. From its hairs came the first wind deities and on his back sat the Sky. He was worshiped only on the Islands of Lostasia where he was both a creator and Sky God. In his mortal form he was highly represented as a great prophet and farmer. With no knowledge of him as an authority it would be hard to explain how exactly Kano would become a loyal authority figure with armies as far as japan.

name: Parasolt
description:
Rank: Protector of Children & Animals

Parasolt was shaman of the Elitsyian Islands and protector of newborn children and animals. His name meant “protector of the wild or backwards”.

name: Krum
description:
Rank: Sky Goddess

Krum was an early sky deity, but because she was so distant in stories, she was merged with the arrival of Adv as the major sky goddess. She was mother to Lo and one of the earliest wives to Born'.

name: Ali
description:
Rank: Rain God

Ali was a minor Rain God. Associated more with gentle rains that hit the earth, this deity was everything but gentle. He was giant in size and brought the world some of the most historical and dangerous storms. The Bermuda Triangle is said to be his home and once sacred creation. From here the deity lied to rest his problems which also brought forth his inevitable wrath that destroyed many ships and killed many people.

name: Corn
description:
Rank: God of the Mist

Corn was God of the Mist, called the Morning Mist, he was son to Ali, in the morning he brought the first feeling of cool breezes that woke man for the new day. His temple hovers above the ground carried by the winds of Adv his beloved wife. Both a Sky and water deity it was no wonder this god was worshiped in so many places.

name: Siguntha
description:
Rank: Mother Sky

Siguntha or Mother Sky was the great supreme Goddess of the Sky and of Storms. She was a giant that had wings and hovered over all things spreading gentle breezes and given birth to the day, evening, and night. The sun and the moon were her children. She was second eldest child to the great Untguard. From her mouth flew out the first airborne animals and she gave them wings to remain above all else as Siguntha wanted her children to rule over all else.

name: Snow
description:
Rank: Goddess of Ice, Climates, Temperature, & Snow

Snow was Goddess of Ice, Climate, Temperature, and Snow. Born from Winter she assists her mother bring the world icy weather. She invented the blizzard and snowstorms in memory to Sickle. Her home is at the edge of the Earth lying in Snow and 12 mile thick ice, even the gods grew cold while in her realm. The panda, Yati (yeti), dove, beaver, and koala were her children and the ice sickle was her weapon.

name: Vitinct
description:
Rank: Protectors

Vitinct are human protectors. Each mortal, animal, and magical being have their own Vitinct and they took on their image throughout their lives. Only seen to magical beings, these distinctive spirits use their charms to protect others.

name: Selenes
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of the Greek Muses

Selenes are a collection of deities that inspire inner talents; similar to the Muses they range from passive advocates to aggressive teachers. They consisted of 6 very popular spirits Cloe, Moni, Toli, Redchi, Harmony, and Obrena. In order they give to the world and are: Cloe taught mankind how to use the stars for time, mathematical problems, and used them for direction. Moni inspired science and gave birth to the first scientist. Toli and Redchi were twins and they inspired the use of Writing, Language, Speech, and Spelling. For Harmony she taught dance and singing and with her beautiful voice she was often called Voice. Obrena was the eldest and inspired Theater, Performing Arts, and Playing Instruments, her children were the first musicians and first actors. Her house was the first theater and the first play was performed there.

name: Roses
description:
Rank: Spirits of Inspiration

Roses are a collection of deities that inspired sports, farming, and religious practices. 6 beautiful women who were opposites to the Selenes. In early Elitsyian legacy, the Elitsyians didn't believe in art and poetry so they created the Roses and they were: Elena, Aeotrode, Hollen, Besta, Newta, and Silloute. Elena taught mankind gymnastics and how to become great warriors and Aeotrode taught then ancient forms of football, baseball, racquetball, soccer, and basketball. Hollen and Besta together inspired the use of planting, farming, and some sacrificing. Newta known for her distinctive look from her sisters inspired History and Epic Poetry, at one time she loved the god Shecknurd. Silloute the lonely maiden build thousands of objects for mankind and inspired the first idea.

name: Dynameids
description:
Rank: Nature Spirits

Dynameids are beautiful spirits who protected the nature and like their counterparts the Naieds they were women who care of nothing else but dancing and singing. Whenever apart flowers wither and rivers dry up. To force them forever together, Sayr plays his instruments to keep them always dancing in his sight. When they are afraid they can hide within trees and flowers. Born from fallen leaves and grass, these spirits the counterparts to the Greek Nymphs.

name: Bik
description:
Rank: Spirit of Violence & Retribution

Bik not much is known of the dark entity except that it is the personification of Violence and Retribution and at one time was Earth God that went insane. While in the underworld its true image was shed and its heart turned into the first maggots and later the first leprechauns and fairies.

name: Hylends
description:
Rank: Spirits of Fairytales

Hylends are the sisters of fairytales. At children bedtimes they read them stories of magical places. When they awoke they remembered nothing. They were part of the Dream Gods until exiled to Earth for playing jokes on sleeping people's spirits. Some of the most popular Hylends are the Elysian Fairies.

name: Andry
description:
Rank: Spirit of Lust & Desire

Andry is the spirit of Lust and Desire. Born from the lustful nature of humans and invoke by late Indian tribes found in Lostasia as their protector. This creature usually seen as a mortal woman gliding over the ground is a wish maker found in the jungles of Lostasia.

name: Lasare’neides
description:
Rank: Spirits of Good Emotions

Lasare'neides along with their vengeful counterparts the Spirits of Veonmide are spirits of day and night that the Elitsyians believed inspired different emotions. They were the many emotions that were left behind after Jessana left love uninspired in the world for too long. The Lasare'neides are

name: Holly
description: Note: chastity

name: Stone
description: Note: temperance

name: Cause
description: Note: charity

name: Aware
description: Note: diligence

name: Strong
description: Note: forgiveness

name: Heart
description: Note: kindness

name: Humble
description:
Note: humility

And were led by Proud and

Belief. They were set to clear up the negative activities that their counterparts have made on the world.

name: Druids
description:
Rank: Magical Spirits of Protection, Guidance, & Learning

Druids are mortals who have reached stages in their lives where they can use great massive amounts of magic to protect, guide, and teach the magical world. They are also worshiped in Celtic Mythology. The Elitsyians have adapted these magical wiseman for their own belief system that short dwarf like people lived in their forests spreading the teachings of another world.

name: Spirits of Veonmide
description:
Rank: Spirits of Negative Emotions

Spirits of Veonmide are 12 deadly spirits that inspire the human world with negative emotions. Because Jessana left love uninspired it spawn into darker emotions and these spirits took on their own separate personalities. Anxeride (assault), Poxoride (wrath), Fromixed (rage), Onide (Hatred), Hoxide (fear), Moxide (discrimination), Toxinide (prejudice), Ronickide (sadness), Xolikide (malice), and Nonprovide (vanity). They are led by two more powerful demons name Suicide and Grief. Suicide and Grief follows Montum on his many journeys while in the underworld.

name: Nymphs
description:
Rank: Spirits of Nature

Nymphs like in ancient Greece, these spirits come in thousands and supports nature. They are beautiful deities that can disappear at will and sing gently to make plants grow. From roses and sunlight more are born each day. Each nymph protects its own part of nature ranging from a single seed to giant mountains. Although they appear together and nearly identical, few have made separate appearances in Elitsyian Mythology.

name: Sanity & Sorrow
description:
Rank: Spirits of Dark Emotions

Sanity and Sorrow once were the parents to Rotrude until he punished them by burning them alive. Because of their torturing of their son, they were punished to walk the Earth forever as the two spirits of Sanity and Sorrow.

name: Ansencion
description:
Rank: Elitsyian version of the Zodiacs

Ansencion are several deities that go in direct comparison with the western Zodiacs. Like their counterparts they consist of magic control objects, mythical creatures, and humans who sold their souls to remain in history. Below are the 14 zodiacs of the Elitsyian Myths and their counterparts.

name: Amon
description: The Ram

name: Beth
description: The Bull

name: Gomain
description: Gemini

name: Libre
description: Libra

name: Chinzer
description: Cancer

name: Liondress
description: Leo

name: Viogra
description: Virgo

name: Shauta
description: Scorpio

name: Vagiritus
description: Sagittarius

name: Bascka
description: Capricorn

name: Pieces
description: Pieces

name: Aqua
description: Aquarius

name: Months’
description:
Rank: Spirits of the Elitsyian Calendar

Months' were spirits who represented the separate months of the year. Like most parts of the world the Elitsyians had a 12 month calendar believing that the year took only 12 months to complete. They were children to the Ansencion and parents of the Chapters.

name: Janiune
description: January

name: Febe
description: February

name: Ma
description: March

name: Apa
description: April

name: Mvay
description: May

name: Juna and Jula
description: June and July

name: Antius
description: August

name: Setember
description: September

name: Octobris
description: October

name: Nember
description: November

name: Dece
description: December

name: Chapters
description:
Rank: Spirits of the 4 seasons

Chapters are 4 beautiful daughters of Santiyline, when Santiyline discovered her daughter missing she created these spirits and unleashed them onto the world. Each quarter of the world experienced something different and it caused so much chaos that the gods forbid these spirits from entering the world again. Once her daughter was granted a leave for several months, Santiyline gave this time the two spirits Spring and Summer. When her daughter left she punished the world against the god’s wishes with the spirits Autumn and Winter. Spring danced at the happiness of Santiyline return so flowers bloom and waters cleared. Summer knew of the ending days of Sickle's stay and thus made the world hot in retaliation. Toward Sickle's arrival in the underworld Autumn made trees died and flowers wilt as she walked down to the underworld. Winter the most angered of them all gave birth to Snow and the two would give the world cold and icy weather in agony of Sickle's time in the underworld.

name: Doreans
description:
Rank: Personifications of Hope, Faith, & Inspiration

Doreans are 10 beautiful men and sons to Ditios and Me'. Seen in images around Godum “a city located in the far west side of Lostasia” on walls and on special vase. They are glowing spirits that hover over broken hearted people and helps mend them. Once these spirits were killed by the Valkens in a cross fire and they were later revived by an unknown force. This showed that no matter how difficult a situation was that anything was possible and some situations can become better. The Doreans represented good nature creatures that mended the hearts of all beings alive or dead.

name: Nareids
description:
Rank: Water Nymphs

Nareids like the nymphs were all female deities that granted beauty and protection to the Earth but most incredibly to the waters of the world. The Nareids were hundreds and all came out like fish from Sbone's uterus. With their fish like gills and mermaid like appearance overall, the Nareids could also grant diseases to anyone that look upon them without their consent. They appeared as mermaids with long flowing hair; reeds decorated their hair, teeth of pearls, glowing earrings, and shark like claws. Small like wings helped them leap great distances into the sky. Unlike the Nymphs, the Nareids never consorted. For their numbers to remain in high amounts, a Nareid would be born after another dies. It is believed that the Nareids kiss can cause its victim to breath underwater, their saliva can prevent anyone from drowning, their English like tongues appears like a regular tongue however its sharper than a sword, their songs can seduce men and turn women angry, their fins and tails are often smooth with sharp like blades when angered, and their hair is often bright with sea shells covered in magical beads.

name: Syrahs
description:
Rank: Inpirational Spirits of Imagination

Syrahs are greatly in detail comparisons with sprites and nymphs. Sometimes grown and more of human appearance than their counterparts. These complicated but loving creatures were born from Crienta's spit and given to young children for inspiration and guidance. While in the early stages of a child, Syrahs are drawn giving children imaginary friends for guidance and protection. Together the Syrahs influence gardening, dancing, singing, drawing, and considered forms of imaginations themselves.

name: Dark Emotions
description:
Rank: 125 Spirits of Dark Emotions

Dark Emotions are demons and spirits that make up all human emotions such as Pain, Grief, Misery, and Hope to just name a few. There are over 125 classes of human emotions and are all led by the two eldest spirits, Mental and one of the horseman of the Apocalypse Death. They were all sealed away inside a tomb called the Narxus which was hidden away from all creation and guarded by a Good and Evil Ho'zare. Dark Passion a spirit with a mysterious past came into play after Jessana left the mortal world uninspired by love. After sometime love progressed into the 7 sins and several other darker emotions with Dark Passion being one of the few unrecognized. The Spirit of Dark Passion had long burgundy hair, red eyes, a long black dress that shadowed the Earth in a dark veil and caused night. She ranged from beautiful during the night and an ugly hag in the day. In mortal dreams she is seen standing at the edge of the Nightmare Gates.

name: Spirits of Larte’carsa
description: Spirits of Larte'carsa were 12 deadly spirits that haunted mankind every night. They were the eldest children to Tonik. From their dark emotions during life, humans would pay for them while they slept. The shadows or dark places were their only way into the human world and to protect themselves, someone would have to carry a lighted object around with them. The spirits consisted of Guilt, Resentment, Murder, Robbery, Trickery, Rage, Violence, Retaliation, Retribution, Addiction, Adultery, Lies, and Jinx. There were originally thousands of these spirits and each represented dark human emotions. But because these were the main dark emotions it is difficult to identify all.

name: Spirits of Carli’tasta
description:
Rank: Battle Spirits

Spirits of Carli'tasta were battling spirits against the Spirits of Larte'carsa. Created by Myonar, these angelic spirits had no faces and from their hands held the dreams of each living being. The most sacred were the immortals which lied in a long hall hidden from all else. The spirits each represented several objects and emotions that are used and or conquered in life. Such were Wood, The Key, The Heart, Light, Air, Fire, Earth, Gift of Flight, Hope, Serenity, Worship, Mood, Song, Happiness, Flower, and Destiny. Usually drawn in epic stories these spirits took hundreds of forms and about 200 hundred existed. OF those the most powerful or most popular was those listed above. At the dawn of mankind's greatest battle with these spirits and their counterparts came the Lazarons “Elite Force” powerful Sondreds that sealed away all the spirits into a magical book and labeled it the Willox “book of emotions”.

name: Ancient Spirits
description:
Rank: High Angels

Ancient Spirits in Elitsyian Mythology are powerful deities who ascended above all else and goes nameless, they sing the Ultimate Power's every words. They could be guardian angels, guides, or somehow associated with good and evil. Their numbers are almost unlimited and they can’t die even when all else is destroyed.

name: The Link
description:
Rank: Spirits of Powerful Emotions

Born from the sexual endevours of Caltow and a Seefor, The Link is the beginning of all emotional and physical situations found in humans and at times immortal beings. They consist of:

Aldayes “god of Hard labor & toil”

name: Balbex “goddess of starvation”
description: Bendox “god of sorrows, grief, & body and emotional pains”

name: Zubi-yon “personification of battles”
description: Xrendes “spirits of murders, slaughter, & killings”

name: Nancyje “spirits of ruin”
description: Opeka “god of memory loss, concealment, & forgetfulness”

name: Hello Spirits
description:
Rank: Banished spirits

Spirits with no recorded moments throughout their lives. They are happy and gentle spirits that appear to always smile and say hello in three different distinct tones. Restrained in Japan by Japanese witches during the 3rd dynasty because of a mysterious plague that the Hello Spirits once brought to the now Tokyo.

name: Centuries
description:
Rank: Guardians of the home

Lonely spirits that haunt homes with new families. These spirits are of young women who died unexpectedly and tragically. Kind with whispering voices, these spirits are beautiful young women with long white and silver hair. Although, they live in the houses haunting them, they care deeply for the residents of the houses granting them with protection from supernatural forces. Centuries are capable of beautifying homes, cause gardens to blossom, cook, clean, and appear to children.

name: Pupu
description:
Rank: Sun God

Pupu was a minor Sun God with a lower bodies half of a tiger. He drives the major Sun God, Ohn's chariot.

name: Con
description:
Rank: God of Light

Con God of Light and father to Mel. Both beautiful and benevolent, this deity had no shame and very little anger. His main mission was to present light to the gods but he fell in love with mankind that he presented them with the first fire and thus came light. Ohn is his often companion and visa versa. For his gift of light to mankind first, the gods punished him by binding him to a rock with chains forged by Volkanos and his own gift burned him alive. At the dawn of each day he would return to life and light shined on Earth called dawn and Ohn awoke bringing the sun across the sky. To rescue his companion, Ohn took the fireball that ate away at the god each night and directed toward the heavens. This was the first sign of Mostibik to mankind. Con created The Lights out of his urine and blessed them with the knowledge of the universe. In many but not all myths concerning the deity, Con is a member of the High Council and serves as its active leader.

name: Sole
description:
Rank: Caregiver of the Sun

Sole caregiver of the sun uses her shield to reflect the sun's light onto the Earth. Seen driving a shining chariot carrying the sun in a sparkling basket, she was only worship on the Islands of Lostasia where Ohn was a minor Sun God and drove Sole's magical chariot.

name: Muanda
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Horizon

Muanda was the minor goddess of the Horizon. She was daughter to Seltice born from her dead skin. By the time she was in her teens she created a kingdom of light only seen between her uncle and mother's kingdoms. She appears with her father to present the day.

name: Shade
description:
Rank: Gods of the Awakening Day
Note: Dawn, & Cool

Shade, Dawn, and Cool are the daughters to Ninirara and Il. Shade was black skinned and planted giant feathers turned trees to shield mankind from her mother's intense sun rays. Dawn awoke every morning after her brother “the moon” went to sleep, she awoke her mother to begin day. Dawn was also referred as to represent the inevitability of death. Cool was made of ice and whenever she closed in on something it grew colder and when she backed from it warmed up.

name: Night
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Stars

Night was Goddess of the Stars and with her name come her story. She lived on the brightest star and from it she threw smaller stars down to please her followers on Earth. Her beauty was greater than others and to keep her safe from all else her parents Ohn and Muanda placed her in the sky with her hair the night sky and left eye the moon. Her right eye was the horizon and her beautiful shining dress was the stars.

name: Lena
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Eclipse

Lena daughter to Night and the mortal astrologer Mint. Lena is Goddess of the Eclipse and with her mother greets Ohn on his journey at the toward of dawn and night. Although a minor moon goddess, Lena is a powerful deity seen with an owl's head. She helps give birth to crickets, owls, and totem poles all are which assist her in bringing the night.

name: Otsleep
description:
Rank: Representation of the Moon

Otsleep is the Moon that settles over the Four Corners, he is son to Ninirara and brother to Shade, Dawn, and Cool. His body is the moon and his heart the sun which his mother's carries with her everywhere. He was born sick after receiving a kiss from his father which was said to be lethal. He then died but his heart and body was preserved to create the sun and moon and his voice is the morning breath and his eyes are the stars at night.

name: Bewithia
description:
Rank: Goddess of witchcraft, magic, protection, the arts, & poison

Bewithia was the daughter to Montum alone and with his help she raised several demons to attack the gods. Unlike her father, Bewithia didn't want ultimate power but independence so she shared the likeness of mankind who thought their time with the gods was over and wanted separation from them. So Bewithia, Goddess of Magic, Protection, Witchcraft, the Arts, and Poison gave the world a chance to prove them. With these tests they would prove to be independent thinkers, inventors, great fighters, and formidable foes to other entities. Born from rotten thorns and poisonous water of the underworld, Bewithia is no stranger to being unlike by her brethren so she took her stay with the mortals on Earth being their ever watching medicine woman and guide. In many tales, Bewithia is also considered a trickster and the Elitsyian female version to Loki of Norse Mythology, where she is depicted as being young, deceiving, and very beautiful. Most men while in her youthful form are immediately attracted to her and vulnerable to her spells. In Chapter 5 she becomes one of the main villains to the Justice Knights.

name: Zone`
description:
Rank: Ferryman of the Underworld

Zone` is the boatman that delivers the dead across the river of Zys in the underworld. It is said that if the family of the deceased left behind fruit or gold in the mouth of the dead that their spirits made it across the river into the afterlife. If they however didn't leave an offering to Zone, they would roam the gates of the underworld for eternity as ghosts. Born from the earwax of Sanolli, Zone is not a Valken like his mother but a skeletal man with torn clothing that was originally an offering left for him.

name: Zys
description:
Rank: God of the Zys River

Zys minor God of the Zys river. His beard became the very river that connects the world of the living with that of the dead. His eyes were the two moons that overlook the underworld. Born from Valkens, Zys came with no history just appeared entirely at the edge of the underworld.

name: Onur
description:
Rank: God of Spirits & the Spiritland

Onur the Lesser God of Spirits and the Spiritland is the most loved child of Montum standing as his second in command if he was to ever leave the underworld for to long. In some stories, Onur took a mortal name as Zon and appeared in traditions as a Prisoner “protector of magic”. He once fought Kanos in struggle over the Earth's safety, Onur (Zon) although not evil didn't care much for humanity and thus thought it best for all living things to cease to exist. In one story, Zon took control over the underworld but because of its dark apperance he took for the land of the living. After being above ground for centuries, Zon grew passionionate for mankind and protected it from members of his father's kingdom. But Montum didn't agree with his new decision and sent bounty hunters “demons” out to bring his son back to him. In his mortal state he had incredible powers but not strong enough to stand up against demons. So he invoked on the help of the Christians' Jesus to stand up against the children of HELL. This happened by asking people to stand up against the evil in the world but as the stories of history was rewritten, so was the outcome and Jesus was killed and Zon was tooken back to the underworld. Shortly after, Zon became Onur again and watched over the dead and created a world to assist spirits and or ghosts to crossover to their respected places in the afterlife. This place is known as the Astral Plane and it coexists with the mortal world. In this plane all things look as it did in the living world but only spirits roam here and all else is unknown, while spirits are here they continue to live their lives to resolve unfinished issues. There are moments where some spirits becomes ghosts and pass to the mortal world to finish unsolved issues. Those with supernatural abilities can see these entities.

name: Anit
description:
Rank: God of Pain, Grief, & Misery

Anit son to Montum is God of Pain, Grief, and Misery and bore demonic offspring with the same names. Anit was a minor God of the Dead and instead of watching the dead like most others like him; he created evil emotions to taunt mankind. During the time Jessana cursed the world with emotions that have never been experienced before, Anit created Pain, Grief, and Misery and destroyed all hope to have unity on Earth again.

name: Anchun
description:
Rank: Keeper of the River of Visions

Anchun is the Keeper to the River of Visions found in the underworld. From the ancient river came the first psychic visions and prehistoric creatures that later roamed the earth. This river predates others and at both ends lays Life and Death. Anchun is modeled heavily after the Egyptians version of Osiris. Anchun's history is unknown and the Elitsyians stated that the ability to predict the future came from the gods and stories of the gods predate all else so into play came the idea that Anchun came from Yonrohs' during his youth.

name: Obekuwa
description:
Rank: Judge of the Dead

Obekuwa is one of the Judges of the dead, he was barbaric and a giant that served the dead. He taught rhymes and built the first labyrinth. His magical sword was founded by Kanos, which helped the god slay the 15-headed serpents.

name: Maniuosphateles
description:
Rank: Judge of the Dead

Maniuosphateles is one of the Judges of the dead, his laughter was heard in all realms and with it, and he was chosen to decide if the dead were to go to Helliholm “heaven”.

name: Dargerone
description:
Rank: Judge over the Dead

Dargerone judge over the dead was once a tormented soul in the Underworld until his escape to Helliholm proves him worth sparing suffering. So Montum made him into a judge and gave him the power over all the elements in honor of his great escape. He also assists in the battle of Mostibik fighting on the side of Montum.

name: Sharda
description:
Rank: Demonic Goddess of Rituals & Temples

Sharda the Demonic Goddess of Rituals and Temples was daughter to Bewithia and held powerful black magic. She could easily travel from realm to realm and had no fear of those stronger than herself. With her magical bag of spells she could defend herself from the strongest of magic, even the gods invoke on her references of the Other World to assists in battles and solving mysteries.

name: Xshaun
description:
Rank: Father of Demons & Warlocks

Xshaun Father of the Demons and Warlocks is a powerful child of Montum. His black magic caused Bewithia to fall in love with him and the two would give birth to warlocks, witches, and half of the magical community. Although feared by most he met, Xshaun created a school, Anura a place for young magical beings that wanted to learn how to control their abilities. The Elitsyians believed highly in another world opposite of theirs that was home to magical creatures that either helped them or tormented them and the birth of many magical entities come to be. He is father to Zon and pleaded to Montum to make sure his son stays alive through the Trials of Jesus even going as far as controlling the minds of the humans responsible for crucifying Jesus to kill Jesus and not him.

name: Isala
description:
Rank: Mother to Dragons

Mother to Dragons lived in the debts of the underworld and served no one. Her children were slain and enslaved by thousands throughout history but every day she gives birth to more in hopes to aid in Mostibik and bring peace to her kind. Her true appearance is unknown and were she came about is also a mystery.

name: Dugarda
description:
Rank: Spirits of Sickness & Death
Note: grim reaper

The Dugarda “Grim Reaper” similar to folklore of the Middle East, these ugly skeletal creatures floats above the ground carrying a sickle. Some haves wings and others have glowing orbs beneath. Some can even appear almost human and with one touch they can suck the life out of any living thing. One Grim Reaper called Eternity is placed at the doors of Eternity watching guard and allowing only those who are dead into Norgard. It carries a book with all the names of the dead called the Book of Name.

name: Cromov
description:
Rank: Spirit of Death

Cromov is the spirit of death. In his kingdom all souls of the dead are judged and enter their respected places in the afterlife. He controls all those that enters the underworld and from his dark magic comes the elements of the world. Cromov was also an elder druid that could predict the future and he wrote down history on white scrolls and placed them in a vault in his chambers. He was father of the bringers of Eternata.

name: Bringers of Eternata
description:
Rank: Bringers of the Apocalypse

Bringers of Eternata was the 10 demons that plague stories since the first prediction was made. They are ancient spirits that existed long before the first civilization but shortly after the birth of man these spirits awoke from the ground and threatened to bring forth the Apocalypse. Since then man had told stories and made prophecies of the end of the world starting with the appearance of these spirits.

name: The Bana Woman
description:
Rank: Goddess of the Underworld

The Bana Woman was a fat old black skinned woman that in one had held a magical stick that when touching the ground awoke the shadows in which she also commanded. And in the other hand she held one of her eyes which could see the future and look into people's souls. She was associated with black magic and death. The Iku thought her to be their Goddess of the Underworld. She was a haggish old witch whose magic was more ancient than the Iku's island. She lived deep in the darkest part of the Black Forest surrounded by giant griffins that protected her and her land.

name: Osus
description:
Rank: God of the Afterlife

Osus invented a system that weighed the dead to see where they went in the afterlife. Although there were three judges who decided this, his judgment would be more important especially in circumstances where the judges couldn't present a decision. This half dog half cat god resembled the Egyptians God of the Underworld, Anubis. Osus was God of the Afterlife and resided over the underworld whenever Montum left to join the gods in Lium.

name: Hepti Apocalypse
description:
Rank: 4 Horseman of the Apocalypse

Hepti Apocalypse is the name used to describe the Elitsyians version of the Apocalypse. Hepti meant “end” and so be the end of time when these creatures are seen. They represent Famine, War, Pestilence, and Death and are seen as the black horsemen riding through the underworld spreading their devilish magic. Famine brought drought, war brought destruction, pestilence brought pain and suffering, and death brought the obvious “death”. They were sealed away in Heaven long ago and are said to be released alongside Belckus at the end of Time.

name: Vic
description:
Rank: Goddess of Shadows & Panic

Vic shared the same body with her brother Con until they were separated. For the time that they were together, the world had light with shadows. Vic Goddess of Shadows and Panic had very little worship almost to the point of her own existence disappearing in later stories. Victory and Vicious derived from her name. Vic sometimes assists Nextis on his many battles.

name: Shiles
description:
Rank: Mother of the Harpies, First Vampire, Vampire Queen

Shiles Mother of the Harpies was the original harpy queen until she was given a soul by a gypsy and shortly after she was made into the first vampire. Upon her arrival on Earth she had a ledge of vampires and was given the title as the Queen of Vampires. In modern times she has the power to lay eggs that can hatch full grown vampires and harpies.

name: Ubfu
description:
Rank: King of the Underworld

Once loved by a witch named Sinsara, she betrayed him and turned him into a zombie. While drifting into the underworld, Ubfu fought many members of the dead, slowly becoming a vengeful warrior. Ubfu would then meet with the previous King of the Underworld, the two fought and then he killed him in a blind rage. This act allowed Ubfu to become the new King of the Underworld and ruler over the growing zombie population.

name: Sinsara
description:
Rank: Witch & Renowned Priest of the Dead

A powerful witch that often goes to the above world to steal souls for the leaders of the underworld. She was the one responsible for Ubfu’s becoming a zombie.

name: Nasha
description:
Rank: Means spirit in Elitsyian

When a human soul dies, the energy that is left retains the memories, emotions, and physical appearance of when they were alive. This allows them to become a spirit or a Nasha in Elitsyian.

name: Greever
description:
Rank: Ghost in Elitsyian

If a Nasha or spirit can interact with the living world or leaves the Astral Plane. It becomes a Greever or commonly known as a ghost. It has transparent abilities along with the power to take control of a living host, change their appearance, limited telepathy, and telekinesis.

name: Will-O-Wisps
description:
Rank: Guide of Souls

Small floating spirits that take the form of little children playing and laughing. When someone hears their laughter, that would mean that the person is near death. When someone sees them, it means they are already dead. Will-O-Wisps are powerful beings that can cast away dark spirits and demons, they were the creators of the original demon binding spells later perfected by Mages. Will-O-Wisps are also guides of the dead to Onur “the Underworld”.

name: Zolrick “Haunting Dog”
description:
Rank: Protector of Graveyards

A black dog that protects graveyards and haunts churches. It eats evil souls and loves bones from recently deceased living creatures. Although humans only see these creatures when they are either near death or experience death, these creatures are usually invisible to humans.

name: Necromancers
description: Mages that can resurrect the dead. Necromancers are powerful mages, descendants of Druids. Although many Necromancers are often looked down upon by other mages, their magic are also banned by the High Council.

name: High Council
description:
Rank: Parents of Angels

The High Council are powerful mages appointed by their respective magical races to define order, authority, and laws amongst the magical universes. In the High Council’s earliest days, they were formed by the Domi Mages to bring ordnance to magic in hopes that it doesn’t go unchecked as it continues to grow.

name: Domaedians
description:
Rank: Angels of Heaven

Ultimate Power protested that they stay far away from all else as they were precious. So, the Domaedians removed themselves from this time, but so history would remember their presence their light could be seen even thousands of years later as stars in the night sky. Domaedians were thousands of angels that the Elitsyians believed live among them. But unlike angels, they were more warrior than human like beings with wings. Most had armor and protected an individual as somewhat of a guardian these were called Protectors. Others were those that sung the All Powerful's every word to all of creation and they were the Supreme Justice. And there were many guide and watch over several species in the world. They were one of the first creations of Elshack.

name: Ho’zares
description:
Rank: Authority over Existence

Created by the Ultimate Good during the birth of the good and evil in the new Universe. They live high above all else watching and providing laws throughout the universe. Their many children range from the Almighties, Domaedians, High Council and some of the most well-known siblings include Belckus. Because of their all-watchful nature, many beings fear them and would rather face death then to meet even one Ho'zare. All powerful they collectively can recreate or destroy all existence and even had the power to overthrow and imprison their bretren Belckus. The Ho'zares home is somewhere near the Ultimate Power kingdom in the highest level of Helliholm.

name: Primordial Ones
description:
Rank: Creator Gods

Primordial Ones are all powerful angels with six wings. Often called Seraphs, Primordial Ones were called upon to create the features of the Universe by the Ultimate Power. When in their youth, the Ho’zare grew jealous of their beauty and power and attempted to destroy them with his own creations that rivaled their power, the Belki.

name: Vantiside
description: 2nd oldest of the Primordial Ones and often High Authority figure amongst them.

name: Crea
description: Created the first known fire spark, land like substance, and air to breathe and from her creations all else would be created

name: Xandromeika
description: Holder of the Book of Elite, writes in it at all times to foretell all events

name: Zegus
description: Older than Yonrohs, however younger than his other siblings, often jokster and can bend reality to his will

name: Rifordus
description: Gave birth to Yosubut, Yonroh’s bestfriend, it is believed that he killed Yosubut by causing him to vanish because of his friendship with Yonrohs

name: Wonderus
description: The middle child, Wonderus created the first star and later went to create the various stars like Suns.

name: Ashilakeruh
description: The eldest of the Primordial Ones, holds all knowledge of Alternate Realities

name: Bamrupnus
description: Created souls and life essences found in all living and sometimes dead beings

name: Quadus
description: Assisted in creating the planets and alongside the gods provided them with life, he is the 3rd oldest Primordial One

name: Neifide
description: Only Primordial One that adores Yonrohs especially as a king, believing he is worthy of the thrown. Neifide also assisted in creating and shaping the various worlds and was the primary in deciding how the worlds would look and exist.

name: Fromithcis
description: Created the first known water like element, of which all water and aquatic life gets it start is from his chalice

name: The Powers
description:
Rank: Ancient Powerful Deities

The Powers were ancient creatures that appeared as little children clothed with white and black garments that concealed their true forms. The Peon People believed that everyone on Earth had a similar spirit that each could control some force of element found on Earth. They built a temple so far in the sky that no human could reach it, in its center lied a room of white. In the center of the room was the world projected as a viewing globe and all fate was controlled here. They took neither the side of good nor evil and stood neutral as a balance power. The Powers were created by the Domi Mages to serve as authority figures in their absence.

name: Granjun
description:
Rank: Immortal Dragon

Granjun was the longest creature in Elitsyian Mythology. Its body could wrap around the entire universe in one stretch. Its head was that of a lion with whiskers and many of its dragons had similar appearances. It had several arms and legs on its long body and unlike most dragons in Elitsyian Mythology he had no wings but could gradually float high above all else. His scales if churned the right way could grant invincibility and if mixed with water could grant immortality. With its saliva could grant someone invisibility and the stardust from its eyes gave it magical abilities. Because it was so long and powerful it hid in the high heavens and lived amongst the high council of the Domaedians.

name: Vigrestia
description:
Rank: Member of the High Council

Vigrestia the cloaked god. He is also called Destiny and his son is Jonun and grandchildren are the Groners “decider's of Fate and Destiny”. His wife at one time was Crienta but because of their status they kept it a secret. Vigrestia had several forms and usually took the form of animals mostly because they were trusted and most animals protected mankind and dreams. With his many disguises he was always remembered as a funny old man with great knowledge. He was one of the wise and most memorable members of the High Council.

name: Saji
description:
Rank: Creator of the Cosmos

Saji was the great Creator of the Cosmos, because his brother took more of an active role his authority and name got lessen. With his hand he could emit bright light that could destroy worlds, with his breath he could bring the dead back to life, and with his true name the reader could become immortal. His true name was Sajibeth “Htebijas” had to be said three times in order to receive complete immortality. He is the son of the Primordial Ones Bamrupus

name: Y’brukahs
description:
Rank: Benevolent Spirits

Powerful spirits that live near the Y’soborus the mythical tree that provides powers to angels, gods, etc. Magic to witches, elves, etc. and spins the universe in a spiral. They are massive sized beings only seen by Yonrohs upon his birth. They were created during the time of the Domi Mages and have existed since before time when the angels were young and before the gods. The only thing that can kill them is power from the Y’soborus.

name: The Asrai
description:
Rank: Collective gods of the 7 continents

The Asrai were devine deities and youngest children to the Primordial Ones and younger siblings to the Royal Circa of Elitsyian Gods. They can be seen in paintings along the walls of many Elitsyia Temples as patron deities whom sat at the Royal Circa’s table but often as deciding factors when the main deities failed to provide a decision. Each dedicated a piece of massive land to other cultures and thus brought forth competition for Elitsyia and its gods. For this, they were banished to another dimension believed to only be able to speak to their respective race for periods when the dimensional veils were their weakest.

name: Amentia
description: Was the patron of America and presented herself with a large bear like creature of which she can be seen riding. She is Goddess of the Stars and of Collective Order. She gave birth to the many deities and cultures that was born within the North American continent.

name: Amenitius
description: Brother to Amentia and her husband. He is God of Traditions and Culture. With him came forth the south American continent and its many deities and cultures. He believed that every homeland should have a tradition to set rules and examples of who they were.

name: Racen
description: God of Race, Scripture, and Belief. His prime belief was that the world should be separated from each other and each nation should battle with each other for rule. He created the European cultures and the deities that live there including started the myths of Roman, Greek, and Nordic.

name: Copia
description: Goddess of Prestige, Command, and Royalty. She granted the home of Asia to many and any race including those of other lands. She gave them their own deities and allowed them to produce their own cultures without her example.

name: Lord Repsis
description: God of African Culture and Spiritual Guidance. A dark tone deity with a large shattering voice. His body laid the land for Africa and its surrounding islands while his voice inspired their deities and cultures. His greatest product was the Egyptian gods of which he fathered before his banishment.

name: Royal Cenias
description: The high ocean God. He befriended a young Crochen and taught the god how to use water as a weapon and as an ally for his growing magic. He fathered Oceania and its cultures. Although his deities of this continent was in smaller status, he still marched them to victory during the reign of the gods before Mostibik. He was the only deity that didn’t get banished.

name: Anarcia
description: Goddess of the Cold, Hunt, and lands. She was ill tempered and had a icy persona. She graced the ground which turned it to ice and destroyed many homes on a once beautiful landscape. She gave birth to the Arctic, Prehistoria, and Antarctic locations.

name: Akuma
description:
Rank: Heaven’s Beast

Also known as the Heaven’s Beast. Akuma was created by the Ultimate Power (GOD) to assist in defeating CHAOS and the Leviathans. When the Akuma became untamable, it was banished to the furthest corner of existence. Ever since, it has been eating away at creation until it came across Kendo Lazaron and took advantage of his powerful psychic powers thus becoming corporal again. It was later defeated for good when good and evil joined forces with Heaven and Hell. Akuma-dae were named after this creature because they share its ability to kill heavenly beings.

name: Sanolli
description:
Rank: First wife to Dreggizune

Sanolli was Dreggizune first wife and gave birth to all giants and from her rib cage came forth the underworld. Created shortly after Dreggizune took control over the lower world, her inner body was given the kingdom of Montum and thus her almost complete ruler over the dead as stated in early text. Sanolli was the original Goddess of the Dead and Queen of the Underworld. Her appearance was almost entirely that of a heavy weight woman with several arms and legs and 9 breasts. Her two mouths are the entrances to the underworld. From her breasts milk came the many rivers and water base places of the underworld. From her earwax came the boatman that delivers the dead into the underworld.

name: Kouichim
description:
Rank: Caregiver of the Moon

Kouichim the caregiver of the moon laid the egg that would produce the moon. He is seen carrying it across the sky after his sister; Sole finished her trip across the sky in the opposite way. The two twins almost never met and until an eclipse would never know each other existed. Only worshiped on the Islands of Lostasia, Kouichim is the most important Moon Deity there and temples are built in his honor.

name: Moluck
description:
Rank: Personifications of the Elements

Moluck are several giants of fire, ice, rock, and wind that assisted Montum and Dreggizune in the Final Battle against the gods. Their only major contributions would be one gave mankind the first taste of heat, another the first taste of wind, and the other gave birth to the first rock and stone.

name: The Honseities
description:
Rank: Warrior Goddesses

The Honseities are warrior goddesses that train and prepare soldiers for the Final Battle. They represent strength, courage, agility, nobility, intelligence, and other great aspects. They are giants with skin as hard as armor with hair that protects the Earth from the wrath of the gods.

name: Gogulush
description:
Rank: Dark Giant

Gogulush a dark giant that exists in the darkest place in the underworld. Hating the light, this giant is said to swallow the sun and moon at the end of time, sending all into eternal darkness. He travels through the shadows and rides on giant hound dogs that screams turns the world each day.

name: Conil
description:
Rank: Creator of Current Day Earth

Conil was once born from the ashes of the first world, he would mold the second in hopes to better than the first. From the bones of the fallen Gods, Angels, Demons, and Valkens came the lands, from their blood came the rivers, seas, lakes, ponds, and oceans. From Dreggizune and Crienta's eyes came the suns and moons and from their teeth came the gates that protected the land of the living from that of the dead. With their skin the Heavens and HELL were created. With their hair came trees and plants and with their fingernails came the new race of humans and animals. Conil would then rule over the Heavens and from his urine came the new balance of good and evil gods. His saliva gave birth to demons that roam HELL and torment the souls of those who have been bad in their lives. His navel sat the magical world where magical deities and creatures roam and live side by side with Earth. He planted a tree from his penis and from it hanged the many worlds and on its roots were the underworld and HELL. His nipples were thousands of stars and from them gave birth to angels again called Domaedians and above them were no stronger force.

name: Zyinifir
description:
Rank: Guardian of the Heavens

Zyinifir' guardian of the Heavens, he betrayed the Valkens during the Mostibik after realizing they were all to die and thus survived the battle. During the new legion now a mortal with Abnormal strength protects the bridges leading to life, eternity, the underworld, and oblivion, Moed “bridge to Eternity” and Boei “bridge between life and the underworld”.

name: Nyxix
description:
Rank: Mother of Earthbound Animals

Nyxix is mother to earthbound animals, beasts, and creatures of the new world. She was one of 5 Valkens that survived Mostibik. After she was spared by Conil, Nyxix gave birth to earthbound animals and lived among humans teaching them of their forgotten history. It is told that she inspired the first myth, fairytale, and dream.

name: Valken Holdrum
description:
Rank: 56 giants of the Valkens

The Valkens Holdrum contains lesser known giants, there are over 56 Valkens that live in this hideous place and almost all played a role in Mostibik on the side of their father Dreggizune and mother Sanolli.

name: Pixusus
description: Was a 7 headed dragon giant that guarded part of the Valken Holdrum.

name: Veruzx
description: Father to Pixies, Elves, and Diins “genie like demons”

name: Prifire
description: Wife to Veruzx, she mothered Pixies, Elves, and Diins.

name: Dagadon
description: Mountain Giant

name: Redix
description: River Giant

name: Solmus
description: Guardian of the Gates of Time

name: Host
description: Guardian of the land of dreams

name: Simen
description: Part of the Viginir race, had the body of a wolf, coyote, lion, and vulture

name: Colspur
description: Part of the Viginir race, brought day and night by running around the world

name: Digience
description: Part of the Viginir race, ate the rotten corpse of criminals and would wear their blood in a vile around its neck.

name: Nel
description: Part of the Viginir race, twin sister to Mel'

name: Mel
description: Part of the Viginir race, twin brother to Nel'

name: The ifisick
description: One of the biggest and deadliest creature of Elitsyian Myths, Protector of the Valken Holdrum.

name: The Boken
description: The sand giant with no facial features

name: Born Se'd
description: Demonic reincarnation of Born'

name: Erroled
description: Priestess of the Valken Holdrum, she predicted their futures and thus knew of their violent deaths. She was too killed off.

name: Ick
description: The rainbow giant that was the kindness of the Valkens would give the world rainbows and protection from the shadows.

name: Tantal
description: Made of lava and ice and smelled of bones, blood, and rotten organs of the dead ate spirits and slept for centuries.

name: Onzungee
description: A giant vapor with only a voice, it spoke only to the Valkens and was their strategic mind. With its knowledge, the Valkens at one point knew more than the gods.

name: Kox
description: Giant fox that carved Yonrohs' organs into the many worlds and from his heart grew the many realms of gods and magical beings.

name: Gunnuapig
description: A giant boar that ate the second world and spit out the third world which was ruled by enhanced human like beings with vast knowledge and technology that constructed the new world.

name: Warvue
description:
Rank: Guardian of the Wheel of Time & Fate

Warvue are 6 Giantess who guarded the Wheel of Time and Fate, like the Groners, these witch like giants were more powerful and instead of predicted time and deciding the events of mortal lives. They controlled the lives of immortals as well even the Groners. Living in a fiery realm in the Valken Holdrum, the Warvue are usually seen together making fun of everyone else. They are the first children of Yonrohs' although they are forgotten and written out of stories until after the fall of the gods. They consisted of Contessa, Seliondra, Fer, Velda, Honna, and Fate. Contessa watched and decided the fates of animals, Seliondra watched and decided the fates of plants with Fer watching and deciding fate of the immortals. Velda made the food for immortals and created realms for them too. Honna created the Wheel of Time and Fate and with it came the fate of all things which she watches closely with her 99 eyes. Fate ends all lives by predicting the outcome of all events.

name: Guard
description:
Rank: Creator of Battle Fields

Guard created a war field for the gods and Valkens to fight during the final battle, as decided by the Warvue this place would be their death beds as well. Although Guard was the first slain in the battle, his memory lives on in construction and wars.

name: Latos
description:
Rank: God of Ships

Latos is the Pirate God of Ships, son to Crochen; he is a Valken that carries the universe on the back of his boat. Although forgotten completely this giant deity lives outside of all and knows all, existing outside the Final Battle he had no effect on its outcome. He was one of the 5 Valkens that survived the Final battle.

name: Spirits of Norgard
description:
Rank: Spirits of Death

The Spirits of Norgard are similar to Angels of Death; they are usually human looking with cloaks or modern attire. They exist outside of time and appear to the dying and guide the dead into Eternity. Inside each living thing lies an Angel of Death which comes out when that living thing is about to die.

name: Jegeru
description:
Rank: Mother of Beasts, Goddess of Courtship & Battle

Jegeru Mother of Beasts and Goddess of Courtship and Battle. Jegeru gave birth to the cyclops, minotaur, and thousands of other creatures. Most creatures of the world and underworld were her spawn and from her breast grew the first demon and from her spit was world they lived in. Many heroes like Kanos and Mackitosh battle these creatures and nearly slain Jegeru herself but because of her many disguises she escape and continue to populate the world with her deadly children. Jegeru was one of the only Valken who had a separate story to tell.

name: Wivayva
description:
Rank: Goddess of Women, equal rights, and motherhood

Beautiful giant whose name means wife. Wivayva guided women to take a higher position in their lives and often ruled in their favor to become authority figures. She is the patron goddess of women and offerings are made to her for fertility, equal rights, and blessings. She was an early activist.

name: Sasasian
description:
Rank: Guardian of Grandoff

A large crab that can speak any language of the person or thing in front of it. It was created by Elshack to guard the realm where magic began, Grandoff.

name: Tolnick
description:
Rank: Guardian of the realm, Grandoff

An island size falcon that carries people on its back between realms. Before magic arrived, it was the means of teleportation between dimensions.

name: Omitia
description:
Rank: Goddess of Destruction & Endings

Omitia Goddess of Destruction and Endings was first wife to Khani and presented him a child which was the first plague of the Apocalypse. It is read that at the end of time she would open the gates of HELL and destroy the world.

name: Khani
description:
Rank: God of Destruction & Creation

Khani is the all-powerful, all knowing God of Destruction and Creation. Khani had 7 faces and all faces were different deities with several powerful parts of the Apocalypse. Khani had 10 arms, 2 legs, 100 stomachs and inside his heart chamber lied Oblivion. When angered, Khani destroys several landforms and at the end of time he destroys the universe and from his breath a new world is created. At one moment he was so powerful that the gods and angels came together and locked him away behind a steel door believing that Belki could not break through steel objects. Behind the door a prophecy was told that Belckus or Belckus to the Christian Mythology would raise up break the 13 Steel Doors of HELL and Khani would reign as his head chief of war.

name: Barburis
description:
Rank: God of Punishment & Anger

Barburis God of Punishment and Anger he is one of the main avatar to Khani and after Khani was banished to HELL, Barburis was created and gave the world Anger in revenge. Along with Nextis, Barburis was a major War God that lead many battles across the world to conquer many of Lostasia's enemies.

name: Acnar
description:
Rank: Demi-God of war

Acnar is Half God and Half mortal closely associated with war. His father is Nextis and is minor patron of the arts. Shortly after his mortal mother, a farmer name Cylene died he joined his father's embrace and slaughter several cities for not worshiping them. He is founder of Loaweia a province in the southernmost part of Lostasia.

name: Xela
description:
Rank: Goddess of Strife & Discord

Xela daughter of Nextis born from his saliva and given immortality is Goddess of Strife and Discord. She gave birth to several demons that are pictured on caves pushing her chariot across the sky. Xela would plan different wars and use highly advance strategies to capture her enemies. Some believe that she is partially if not completely responsible for the war with Toaga and Mountainville.

name: Builin
description:
Rank: Protector to the home of the Gods

Builin was chosen by Crienta and Born' to protect Liumus from the Valkens because of his vast strength and strategic way of fighting. In their first attempt on Liumus, the Valkens were tricked into a cave that thought led to Liumus but instead led to the underworld. Their second attempt was close but the Builin used his mighty sword to rip open the clouds of Lium and the giants fell to their deaths. Their souls were then locked in the underworld until the battle of Mostibik. Builin was the first to be slain on the day of Mostibik.

name: Nonth
description:
Rank: Goddess of War

Nonth the Demon Lion Goddess of War had her hair burned off and became the first lions, tigers, coyotes, wolves, and cheetahs. Now surrounded by her animal children, Nonth raged war against the underworld and enslaved hundreds of the undead. She became Mother over the underworld shortly after.

name: Love Gods
description: Followers and children to the love Goddess, Jessana. These deities are both spirits and direct influencers of love and its substances. They are found across Elitysian Mythology as inspiration to love itself.

name: Juradye
description:
Rank: God of Youth & Innocents

Juradye is son of Jessana and God of Youth and Innocents. Always as a child, he had little maturity and almost no authority. He played in his mother's magical springs and protected youth and the children of the world. Rarely talked about in myths, he did however played an important role with his mother to restore love back into the world.

name: Artica
description:
Rank: God of Love, Hidden Love, & Distant Love

Artica God of love, Hidden Love, and Distant Love is the son to Jessana. He helped his mother contain human emotions and later help to keep them intact. Seen mostly nude with magical flowers that can seduce anyone into loving the first object they set eyes on. His appearance is more flamboyant than his counterparts but in one story he is told to have had a magical sword that could fight without the help of anyone else.

name: Sport
description:
Rank: Spirits of Love

Sport baby like deities seen as infants with drapes wrapped around their lower torso and with wings of gold. They are the 101 children of Jessana and helped her bring the world back to normal after emotions were release. When seen they appear to be fallen stars because of their quick flights across the night skies. They are said to live on the moon and bless those who worship to them. With a prayer to these baby cupids, could grant someone a lifelong love. Their magical straws are placed on the doorsteps and bedsides of newlyweds for lifelong love. They attend weddings as floating angels blessing such events.

name: Vena
description:
Rank: Goddess of Enchantments & Eternal Love

Vena was the Goddess of Enchantments and Eternal Love and while asleep, Vena brought people together while they were asleep. Their love would be so beautiful and enchanting that it would bring them immortal love in the real world. To protect people while they are sleeping, Vena would visit each person and cover their eyes with sand. In modern times, Vena was the female form of the Sand Man.
